title: 四级核心词汇
subtitle: ECDICT cet4 标签词表，去除已收录词后按词频排序，覆盖四级高频

defsEn: s. coming at a subsequent time or stage
r. comparative of the adverb `late'
zh: adv. 以后, 随后
examples: He asked her to call him later.
Could you call again later, please?
exampleZh: 他要求她稍后打电话给他。
你可以晚点再打电话来吗？

defsEn: n. soft smooth leather from the hide of a young goat
n. young goat
v. be silly or tease one another
zh: n. 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗
a. 小山羊皮制的
v. 哄骗, 嘲弄
examples: We had a kid just last year.
Give my love to your kids.
exampleZh: 就在去年我们有了一个孩子。
替我向你的孩子们问好。

defsEn: v. let have
v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
v. allow or plan for a certain possibility
concede the truth or validity of something
v. grant as a discount or in exchange
zh: vt. 允许, 同意给予, 承认
vi. 容许, 猜想
examples: I will not allow you to use my pen.
My father does not allow me to have a dog.
exampleZh: 我不允许你用我的钢笔。
我父亲不允许我养狗。

defsEn: r on the inside
zh: n. 内部, 里头
adv. 在内部, 在内心里
prep. 在...之内
examples: I live within walking distance of school.
She will be back within a week.
exampleZh: 我学校离我家只是几步路的路程。
她一周之内会回来。

defsEn: n. the event of dying or departure from life
n. the permanent end of all life functions in an organism or part of an organism
n. the absence of life or state of being dead
n. the time when something ends
zh: n. 死亡
examples: The news of his death spread around.
It's a matter of life and death.
exampleZh: 他去世的消息传遍各地。
这是一个生和死的问题。

defsEn: r by chance
zh: adv. 也许, 大概
examples: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.
It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.
exampleZh: 要不我们找时间喝一顿。
是警察，也许我们应该让道。

defsEn: n. a person who rules or guides or inspires others
zh: n. 领导者, 社论, 指挥, 领袖, 领唱者, 前导字符
examples: Leader, you must think it through!
They looked up to him as their leader.
exampleZh: 帮主，你可要三思啊！
他们把他奉为领袖。

defsEn: r. after an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
zh: adv. 最后, 终于
examples: He finally found out how to make it.
Thank you for finally explaining to me why people take me for an idiot.
exampleZh: 他终于弄清楚怎么搞定这事了。
感谢您终于为我说明了为什么人们通通把我当傻瓜。

defsEn: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization
n. the fashionable elite
zh: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
examples: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
Society will be better if we work together.
exampleZh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

defsEn: s. definite but not specified or identified
a. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty
confident and assured
a. established beyond doubt or question
definitely known
a. certain to occur
destined or inevitable
zh: a. 确定的, 某一个的, 必然的
examples: I am certain that we will find a solution.
The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
exampleZh: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。
旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

defsEn: n. a member of the Republican Party
n. an advocate of a republic (usually in opposition to a monarchy)
n. a tributary of the Kansas River that flows from eastern Colorado eastward through Nebraska and Kansas
a. relating to or belonging to the Republican Party
zh: n. 共和主义者, 共和党员
a. 共和政体的, 共和国的, 共和主义的
examples: He was a member of the Republican Party.
He became active in the Republican Party.

defsEn: a. has a good chance of being the case or of coming about
s. expected to become or be
in prospect
s. within the realm of credibility
zh: a. 有可能的, 合适的, 前途有望的
adv. 或许, 可能
examples: I need to know what's likely to happen if we do that.
He is likely to be late for school.
exampleZh: 我需要知道如果我们这样做可能会发生什么。
他上学很可能会迟到。

defsEn: n. One taken at random rather than by selection
anybody.
[Commonly written as two words.]
zh: pron. 任何人
examples: If I can do it, anyone can.
Anyone can do it if they try.
exampleZh: 我若能，则谁都能。
如果进行尝试，任何人都可以做。

defsEn: prep. On
-- used in all the senses of that word, with which it
is interchangeable.
zh: prep. 在...之上, 迫近, 紧接着
examples: It fell upon me to take care of my mother.
I came upon an old friend of mine on the train.
exampleZh: 照顾母亲的责任落在了我身上。
我在火车上碰到老朋友。

defsEn: n. a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination
zh: n. 艺术家, 画家
examples: She will be a famous artist in the future.
I'm a make-up artist. I can turn any girl into a beautiful woman.
exampleZh: 她将来会是一个有名的艺术家。
我是个化妆师，每当我把一个姑娘变成大美女。

defsEn: r. in the way indicated
(`thusly' is a nonstandard variant)
zh: adv. 如此, 因此, 到如此程度
examples: Am I correct in thinking thus?
Thus I tell you don't just go alone.
exampleZh: 我这样想是对的吗？
因此我跟你说，你不要一个人去。

defsEn: r. farther along in space or time or degree
r. on the farther side from the observer
r. in addition
zh: prep. 超过, 在那一边, 迟于
adv. 在远处
n. 更远处
examples: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
The beauty of that country is beyond description.
exampleZh: 盖我自己的房子超出了我的能力范围。
那个国家的美是语言无法形容的。

defsEn: r indicating exactness or preciseness
r just as it should be
r in a precise manner
zh: adv. 确切地, 精确地, 恰好, 完全地, 确实, 恰恰正是, 确实如此
examples: I have exactly what you need.
You know exactly what I want.
exampleZh: 我正好有你需要的东西。
你很清楚我想要什么。

defsEn: n. an event that accomplishes its intended purpose
n. an attainment that is successful
n. a state of prosperity or fame
zh: n. 成功, 成就, 胜利
examples: I owe my success to him.
He owes his success both to working hard and to good luck.
exampleZh: 我把我的成功归功于他。
他的成功要归结于他的辛勤工作和好运气。

defsEn: r. to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
r. specifically or especially distinguished from others
zh: adv. 特别, 格外, 尤其, 详细地, 细致地
examples: I like music, particularly classical music.
This new word is particularly important for us.
exampleZh: 我很喜欢音乐，尤其是古典音乐。
这些生词对我们特别重要。

defsEn: s. pleasing by delicacy or grace
not imposing
s. (used ironically) unexpectedly bad
zh: a. 漂亮的, 优美的, 机灵的, 狡猾的, 恰当的
adv. 相当, 颇
examples: Pretty soon you will stop thinking of her.
I'm pretty sure that we have enough gas to get home.
exampleZh: 很快你就会不想她了。
我很确定我们有足够好的汽油回家。

defsEn: n. the experiencing of affective and emotional states
n. a physical sensation that you experience
n. an intuitive understanding of something
zh: n. 摸, 触觉, 知觉, 感觉, 情绪, 同情
a. 有同情心的, 有感觉的, 仁慈的, 动人的
examples: She can express her feelings when she feels happy or sad.
The longer you hide your feelings for someone, the more you fall for them.
exampleZh: 当感到高兴或悲伤时，她能表达感情。
对爱掩饰得越多，愈是证明你喜欢他。

defsEn: n. the state of being in effect or being operative
n. a business especially one run on a large scale
n. a planned activity involving many people performing various actions
n. (computer science) data processing in which the result is completely specified by a rule (especially the processing that results from a single instruction)
zh: n. 操作, 动作, 手术, 运算, 作用, 业务
examples: I had an operation for glaucoma last year.
I don't want to have an operation.
exampleZh: 我去年动了青光眼手术。
我不想接受手术。

defsEn: r. without doubt or question
r. in an easily perceptible manner
zh: adv. 清楚地
examples: You can see it clearly, right?
I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
exampleZh: 能看清吧？
我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

defsEn: r. in truth (often tends to intensify)
r. (used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism or irony etc.
zh: adv. 的确, 实在, 真正地, 甚至
examples: It may, indeed, be a mistake.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
exampleZh: 可能确实搞错了。
患难见真情。

defsEn: a. characterized by or advocating or based upon the principles of democracy or social equality
a. belong to or relating to the Democratic Party
s. representing or appealing to or adapted for the benefit of the people at large
zh: a. 民主的
examples: The United States of America is a democratic country.
We live in a democratic society.
exampleZh: 美国是一个民主国家。

defsEn: r. on the contrary
rather (or instead), he wrote her a letter"
r. to some (great or small) extent
zh: adv. 宁可, 稍微, 相当
examples: I would rather stay at home than go out.
I would rather not go there alone.
exampleZh: 比起出门，我更喜欢待在家。
我宁可不要单独去那里。

defsEn: s. constituting the full quantity or extent
complete
s. (of leaves or petals) having a smooth edge
not broken up into teeth or lobes
s. (used of domestic animals) sexually competent
zh: n. 整个, 全部
a. 全体的, 完全的, 全部的
examples: The entire world will find peace.
We spent the entire day on the beach.
exampleZh: 世界和平将会实现。
我们一整天在沙滩上。

defsEn: prep. On the top of
upon
on. See On to, under On, prep.
zh: prep. 在...之上
examples: The cat jumped onto his shoulder.
This child jumped onto the bed.
exampleZh: 这只猫跳上了他的肩膀。
这个孩子跳上了床。

defsEn: v. be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
zh: vi. 处理
vt. 管理, 控制, 维持, 达成, 经营, 运用
examples: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
You should be able to manage it.
exampleZh: 人们怎么能在飞机上睡觉？
你应该能解决。

defsEn: r. happening unexpectedly
zh: adv. 突然, 意外, 忽然, 迅速, 即席作成, 即刻, 急速
examples: I suddenly thought of my dead mother.
The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
exampleZh: 我忽然想起了我死去的妈妈。
公车突然在路中央停下来。

defsEn: n. the region that is inside of something
n. the inner or enclosed surface of something
a. relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space
s. being or applying to the inside of a building
zh: n. 内部, 内脏, 内幕
a. 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的
adv. 在里面
prep. 在...之内
examples: We should look inside this house as well.
Inside the room there is a smell of smoke.
exampleZh: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。
房间里一股烟味。

defsEn: n. an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole
n. an organization regarded as part of a larger social group
n. a single undivided whole
n. a single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else
zh: n. 单位, 分队, 部队, 单元, 部件, 装置
a. 单位的, 单元的
examples: Why would you appear in my unit?
At that moment, the telephone in the unit office rang.
exampleZh: 你为什么会出现在我工作单位？
那时，分队办公室里电话响了。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or characterized by sexuality
a. having or involving sex
zh: a. 性的, 性别的
examples: Have you and her had a sexual relationship?
I have a strong sexual appetite.
exampleZh: 你和她有过性关系吗？

defsEn: n. the state of being a married couple voluntarily joined for life (or until divorce)
n. two people who are married to each other
n. the act of marrying
the nuptial ceremony
n. a close and intimate union
zh: n. 婚姻, 结婚, 婚礼, 合并
examples: Should he hear of your marriage, he will be furious.
She was a Brown before her marriage.
exampleZh: 要是给他知道你要结婚的事，他肯定会大发雷霆。
她婚前是布朗家的。

defsEn: n. (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business
n. a person who owns something
zh: n. 拥有者, 物主, 所有人
examples: I'm the owner of this house.
Who is the owner of this house?
exampleZh: 我是这房子的主人。
谁是这间房子的主人？

defsEn: n. the state of being actual or real
n. the state of the world as it really is rather than as you might want it to be
n. the quality possessed by something that is real
zh: n. 实在, 事实, 实体, 逼真
examples: In reality black is not a color; it is the absence of color.
Your opinions are out of touch with reality.
exampleZh: 黑色其实不是一种颜色，而是一种没有颜色的状态。
你这些想法是与现实脱节的。

defsEn: n. any of the terminal members of the hand (sometimes excepting the thumb)
n. the length of breadth of a finger used as a linear measure
n. one of the parts of a glove that provides covering for a finger or thumb
v. feel or handle with the fingers
zh: n. 手指, 指状物, (手套的)手指部分, 指针
v. 用手指拨弄, 伸出
examples: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.
The fingers move fast on the keyboard.
exampleZh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
手指在键盘上快速的移动。

defsEn: n. a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
zh: n. 科学家
examples: He said, "I want to be a scientist."
I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
exampleZh: 他说：“我想成为科学家。”
真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。

defsEn: a. in or characteristic of a region of the United States south of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line
a. situated in or coming from regions of the south
zh: n. 南方人, 男风
a. 向南方的, 来自南方的
examples: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.
In Southern China, the qipao is also known as "changshan".
exampleZh: 我们的饭店在汽车南站的附近。
在中国南方，旗袍又称“长衫”。

defsEn: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together
n. an act of narration
n. (usually plural) mutual dealings or connections among persons or groups
zh: n. 关系, 联系, 叙述, 故事, 家属, 亲戚
examples: I had a lot to say in relation to that affair.
In relation to this, I am to blame.
exampleZh: 关于那件事我有很多话要说。
关于这件事，我必须负上责任。

defsEn: n. people living near one another
n. an area within a city or town that has some distinctive features (especially one forming a community)
zh: n. 附近, 邻近
examples: We live in the neighborhood of the school.
A fire broke out in my neighborhood last night.
exampleZh: 我们住在学校附近。
昨晚我邻居家着火了。

defsEn: r. without deviation
r. without anyone or anything intervening
r. in a forthright manner
candidly or frankly
zh: adv. 径直地, 直接地, 直率地, 正好地, 直截了当地, (非正式)立即, 马上
examples: I got the information from him directly.
You should talk directly to Tom.
exampleZh: 我直接从他那里得到讯息。
你应该直接跟汤姆说。

defsEn: a. having great power or force or potency or effect
zh: a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的
examples: Love is more powerful than death.
I know some powerful people in the government.
exampleZh: 爱情比死亡更强大。

defsEn: r. so as to be complete
with everything necessary
zh: adv. 完全地, 十分地, 圆满地
examples: I have a completely stupid question.
I want to completely understand you.
exampleZh: 我有一个挺蠢的问题。
想了解你的全部。

defsEn: n a scientist who devotes himself to doing research
zh: n. 研究人员
examples: He said, "I plan to become a researcher."
The researcher said that taking the red pill would send him to another universe.

defsEn: n the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
s denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
zh: n. 打, 十二个
a. 一打的
examples: Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
I want to buy a dozen donuts.
exampleZh: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。
我想买十二个甜甜圈。

defsEn: n. a future prospect or potential
n. capability of existing or happening or being true
n. a possible alternative
zh: n. 可能性, 可能的事
examples: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
exampleZh: 可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
你有可能不得不那么做。

defsEn: r. with ease (`easy' is sometimes used informally for `easily')
r. without question
zh: adv. 容易地, 轻易地, 流利地
examples: People can easily tell the difference between them.
To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
exampleZh: 人们可以很容易地看出其中的差别。
令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。

defsEn: r. without speed (`slow' is sometimes used informally for `slowly')
zh: adv. 慢慢地, 迟缓地
examples: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.
He told me to speak more slowly.
exampleZh: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。
他告诉我要说慢一点。

defsEn: v. cause to come to know personally
v. bring something new to an environment
v. bring in or establish in a new place or environment
v. bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.
zh: vt. 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入
examples: I would like to introduce you to my wife.
I want to introduce you to my friend here.
exampleZh: 让我向您介绍我的妻子。
我想给你介绍一下我身旁这位朋友。

defsEn: n. period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6
n. a Christian holiday celebrating the birth of Christ
a quarter day in England, Wales, and Ireland
zh: n. 圣诞节
examples: That would make a great Christmas present.
Thank you for the Christmas gift.
exampleZh: 那会是很棒的圣诞节礼物。
谢谢你的圣诞节礼物。

defsEn: n. an elected governmental council in a communist country (especially one that is a member of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics)
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the former Soviet Union or its people
zh: n. 代表会议, 苏维埃, 苏联
a. 苏维埃的, 苏联的
examples: The Soviet troops started to withdraw from Afghanistan.
In Soviet Russia, sentence writes you!
exampleZh: 苏联军队开始从阿富汗撤军了。
在苏联，句子写你！

defsEn: n. a person who enjoys reading
n. a person who can read
a literate person
n. one of a series of texts for students learning to read
zh: n. 读者, 读物, 文选, 校对人, 讲师
examples: Let the reader be the judge.
The reader can understand the text in his own way.
exampleZh: 让读者去评判。

defsEn: r. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
zh: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地
examples: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
This is obviously dependent on the relationship...
exampleZh: 他们很明显在嫉妒他的财富和地位。
这明显就是靠关系...

defsEn: n. a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories
zh: n. 记者, 报告者
examples: I want to be a sport reporter.
He is a reporter for Time magazine.
exampleZh: 我想当体育记者。
他是时代杂志的记者。

defsEn: n. the quality of having a superior or more favorable position
n. (tennis) first point scored after deuce
n. benefit resulting from some event or action
v. give an advantage to
zh: n. 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势
vt. 有助于
examples: You have the advantage of a good education.
What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?
exampleZh: 你受过良好教育，这是你的优势。
哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？

defsEn: r. to a high degree or extent
favorably or with much respect
r. at a high rate or wage
r. in a high position or level or rank
zh: adv. 非常, 非常赞许地
examples: I know you think highly of him.
History is a highly politicized subject.
exampleZh: 我知道你对他评价很高。
历史是一门高度政治化的学科。

defsEn: n. people who are still living
a. pertaining to living persons
s. true to life
lifelike
s. (informal) absolute
zh: n. 生活, 生计, 生存
a. 活的, 逼真的, 现存的
examples: What do you do for a living?
Do you eat in the living room?
exampleZh: 您做什么工作为生？
你在客厅吃饭吗？

defsEn: r used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement
anyhow, they're quiet"
anyway, it's gone"
in any case, there was a brief scuffle"
r in any way whatsoever
zh: adv. 无论如何, 至少
examples: Anyway the event has already passed, there is no point in mentioning it again.
I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
exampleZh: 反正事情已过去了，那不用再提了。
我没有 CD 播放机，但还是把唱片买下来了。

defsEn: n. slang term for a woman
s. not detailed or specific
s. lacking subtlety
obvious
s. being at a peak or culminating point
zh: a. 宽广的, 辽阔的, 广大的, 显著的
adv. 宽阔地
n. 宽阔部分
examples: Broad safety measures were put into effect.
I have to read in broad daylight.
exampleZh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。

defsEn: n. an idea evoked by some experience
n. a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some antecedent stimulus or agent
n. (mechanics) the equal and opposite force that is produced when any force is applied to a body
n. a response that reveals a person's feelings or attitude
zh: n. 反应, 反作用, 反动
examples: What kind of reaction did you have when he came looking for you?
Let's see what the reaction is.
exampleZh: 他来找你的时候，当时你是什么反应？
看看反应如何。

defsEn: n. fermented juice (of grapes especially)
n. a red as dark as red wine
v. drink wine
v. treat to wine
zh: n. 葡萄酒, 果酒, 暗红色
v. (请)喝酒
examples: I like red wine better than white wine.
I prefer red wine to white wine.
exampleZh: 我喜欢红葡萄酒胜过白葡萄酒。
我喜欢红葡萄酒胜过白葡萄酒。

defsEn: n. the cognitive process of acquiring skill or knowledge
zh: n. 学问, 学识, 学习
examples: You can continue learning the language over the internet.
I spend a lot of time learning a language.

defsEn: r. in a relative manner
by comparison to something else
zh: adv. 相对地, 比较地, 相当地, 相关地
examples: The sales floor was relatively uncrowded.
I live in a relatively safe neighborhood.
exampleZh: 销售区相对来说不算拥挤。

defsEn: n. a group of followers or enthusiasts
s. about to be mentioned or specified
s. immediately following in time or order
a. going or proceeding or coming after in the same direction
zh: n. 下列各项, 部下, 追随者
a. 下列的, 其次的
examples: He told me he would start the following day.
I imagine the whole thing in the following way: ...

defsEn: n. hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella
n. the part of a trouser leg that provides the cloth covering for the knee
zh: n. 膝, 膝盖
vt. 膝行, 用膝盖碰
examples: I played with the baby on my knee.
After his knee repair, he could walk without pain.
exampleZh: 我在膝盖上跟婴儿玩。

defsEn: n. a newly hired employee
n. the act of hiring something or someone
v. engage or hire for work
zh: n. 租金, 租用, 雇用
vt. 雇请, 出租
vi. 受雇
examples: I would like to hire a car.
That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.
exampleZh: 我想租一辆车。
这家公司不分种族、宗教或国籍雇用人。

defsEn: n. (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government
n. (United States) the largest administrative district within a state
zh: n. 县, 郡
examples: She met a boy at the county fair.
This is the best school in the county.

defsEn: n. a polite name for any woman
n. a woman of the peerage in Britain
zh: n. 淑女, 夫人, 女士, 贵妇
examples: I'm a serious office lady and a good wife and mother at home.
He helped an old lady to get up from her seat.
exampleZh: 我是一个认真的文员，在家里，我是一个好妻子兼好母亲。
他将一位老太太从位子上扶起来。

defsEn: n. the feelings expressed on a person's face
n. expression without words
n. the communication (in speech or writing) of your beliefs or opinions
n. (genetics) the process of expressing a gene
zh: n. 表达, 表现, 词语, 措辞
examples: He said with a perplexed expression, "I've heard nothing, so I can't say anything."
I believe in freedom of expression in any way.
exampleZh: 他的目光十分困惑：「我什么也没听过，所以什么也说不出来。」

defsEn: v. have in mind as a purpose
v. design or destine
zh: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是
examples: I do not intend to quit at all.
I intend to study abroad next year.
exampleZh: 我一点也没有要辞职的意思。
我打算明年出国留学。

defsEn: n. the flesh of a chicken used for food
n. a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs
believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl
n. a foolhardy competition
a dangerous activity that is continued until one competitor becomes afraid and stops
s. easily frightened
zh: n. 小鸡, 鸡肉
examples: She cooks chicken the way I like.
On the plate was a piece of chicken, a potato and some green peas.
exampleZh: 她用我喜欢的方式烹调鸡肉。
盘子上盛着一块鸡肉、一块马铃薯和一些青豆。

defsEn: n. a dialect of Middle English that developed into Scottish Lallans
a. in or characteristic of a region of the United States north of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line
a. situated in or coming from regions of the north
zh: n. 北方人
a. 北方的, 向北的, 自北方来的
examples: The city is at the northern end of Japan.
Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
exampleZh: 城市位于日本的最北端。
挪威位于北欧，是个高度发展的国家。

defsEn: n. the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
n. a sheet of any written or printed material (especially in a manuscript or book)
n. hinged or detachable flat section (as of a table or door)
v. turn over pages
zh: n. 叶, 树叶, 花瓣, 页
vi. 生叶, 翻书页
vt. 在...上长叶, 翻...的页
examples: A dead leaf fell to the ground.
I'll turn over a new leaf and study English very hard.
exampleZh: 一片枯叶落到了地上。
我会重新开始，努力学习英语。

defsEn: n. an excavation that is (usually) filled with water
n. an organization of people or resources that can be shared
n. any communal combination of funds
n. a small body of standing water (rainwater) or other liquid
zh: n. 池, 水塘, 石油层, 联营
vt. 合伙经营, 共享, 采掘, 汇聚成
vi. 汇合成塘, 淤积, 联营
examples: In the summer I go to the pool every day.
The swimming pool is used in common by all the children in the neighborhood.
exampleZh: 夏天的时候，我每天都去游泳池。
游泳池由住在附近的孩子们共同使用。

defsEn: n. the quality of being important and worthy of note
n. a prominent status
zh: n. 重要, 重要性, 重要地位, 自大
examples: This is a matter of great importance.
The matter is of no importance.
exampleZh: 这是一件十分重要的事。
这件事不重要。

defsEn: n. (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory
zh: n. 软件
examples: How can I update this software?
All of my software is open source.
exampleZh: 我如何才能更新这个软件呢？
我的软件全都是开源的。

defsEn: r. advancing in amount or intensity
zh: adv. 逐渐地, 渐增地
examples: Children seem increasingly unable to tolerate frustration.
It is increasingly common for people to purchase a second car.

defsEn: n. a person who operates a farm
n. United States civil rights leader who in 1942 founded the Congress of Racial Equality (born in 1920)
n. an expert on cooking whose cookbook has undergone many editions (1857-1915)
zh: n. 农夫, 农场主
examples: Farmers always complain about the weather.
But the farmer smiled at him.
exampleZh: 农民总是抱怨天气。
但是农夫对他笑了。

defsEn: n. a person who is married
a. joined in matrimony
zh: a. 已婚的, 婚姻的
examples: He married a very pretty girl.
They will get married next month.
exampleZh: 他娶了一个很漂亮的女孩。
他们将在下个月结婚。

defsEn: r. in a satisfactory or adequate manner
(`alright' is a nonstandard variant of `all right')
zh: a. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好
adv. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好
n. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可
vt. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可
examples: Okay, let's say no more about it.
Is it okay if I take a break?
exampleZh: 好了，不要再说了。
我休息一会没问题吧？

defsEn: n. the front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen
n. either of two soft fleshy milk-secreting glandular organs on the chest of a woman
n. meat carved from the breast of a fowl
n. the part of an animal's body that corresponds to a person's chest
zh: n. 胸部, 乳房, 胸怀
vt. 以胸对着, 面对
examples: He doesn't drink enough breast milk.
I have to breast-feed my baby.
exampleZh: 他母乳喝得不够。

defsEn: n. shade within clear boundaries
n. a premonition of something adverse
n. refuge from danger or observation
n. a dominating and pervasive presence
zh: n. 阴影, 荫, 影子, 影像, 阴暗, 幽灵, 少许, 隐蔽处, 庇护
vt. 遮蔽, 使朦胧, 预示, 尾随
vi. 渐变, 变阴暗
examples: He is afraid of his own shadow.
She is afraid of her own shadow.
exampleZh: 他是个胆小鬼。
她害怕自己的影子。

defsEn: n. the state or fact of existing
zh: n. 存在, 性质, 生命, 人, 生物, be的现在分词

defsEn: r. in essence
at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature
zh: adv. 基本上, 主要地
examples: Basically, I agree with your opinion.
Basically, a language is an agreement between the people who use it.
exampleZh: 基本上我赞同你的意见。

defsEn: r. by chance
r. to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means
zh: adv. 可能, 也许
examples: My father will possibly come on the next train.
Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
exampleZh: 我父亲可能会乘下一列火车来。
你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

defsEn: n. someone who visits
zh: n. 参观者, 游客, 访客
examples: The visitor sat across from me.
She showed the visitor her baby.
exampleZh: 访客坐在我的对面。
她给客人看了她的宝宝。

defsEn: v. like better
value more highly
v. promote over another
v. give preference to one creditor over another
zh: vt. 宁可, 较喜欢, 提出
examples: Which one do you prefer, this one or that one?
Do you prefer white rice or brown rice?
exampleZh: 你喜欢哪一块？这块还是那块？
你更喜欢白米还是糙米呢？

defsEn: r. in accordance with truth or fact or reality
zh: adv. 真实地, 不假
examples: I truly do not understand the question.
I swear, this time it's truly different.
exampleZh: 我真的不懂这个问题。
我发誓，这次真不一样。

defsEn: n. a public promotion of some product or service
r. in the Christian era
used before dates after the supposed year Christ was born
zh: n. 广告
examples: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
Please add my name to the list.
exampleZh: 请再在我的茶里加点牛奶。
请把我的名字加在名单上。

defsEn: n. & adv. See Aught.
imp., p. p., or auxi Was or were under obligation to pay
owed.
imp., p. p., or auxi Owned
possessed.
imp., p. p., or auxi To be bound in duty or by moral
obligation.
imp., p. p., or auxi To be necessary, fit, becoming, or
expedient
to behoove
-- in this sense formerly sometimes used
impersonally or without a subject expressed.
of Owe
zh: aux. 应该, 大概
n. 责任
examples: You ought to have come to see me yesterday.
You ought to get to work on time.
exampleZh: 你昨天应该来看我的。
你应该准时上班。

defsEn: r. to an extreme degree
zh: adv. 极端地, 非常地
examples: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
The octopus is an extremely intelligent sea creature.
exampleZh: 吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.
章鱼是一种非常聪明的海洋生物。

defsEn: n. a leader engaged in civil administration
n. a person active in party politics
n. a schemer who tries to gain advantage in an organization in sly or underhanded ways
zh: n. 政客, 政治家, 从事党派政治的人
examples: He is nothing more than a politician.
He is an author and a politician.
exampleZh: 他只不过是个政治家。
他是作家，还是政治人物。

defsEn: s. experiencing odd bodily sensations
zh: a. 好笑的, 有趣的, 滑稽的
n. 滑稽人物
examples: The teacher told us a funny story.
He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
exampleZh: 老师跟我们说了一个有趣的故事。
他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。

defsEn: a. of or relating to Jews or their culture or religion
zh: a. 犹太人的, 犹太族的
examples: The most important Jewish holiday happens once a week.
Is this a Jewish or a Catholic Bible?

defsEn: n. a series of things depending on each other as if linked together
n. (chemistry) a series of linked atoms (generally in an organic molecule)
n. a series of (usually metal) rings or links fitted into one another to make a flexible ligament
n. (business) a number of similar establishments (stores or restaurants or banks or hotels or theaters) under one ownership
zh: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚
vt. 用铁练锁住, 束缚, 囚禁
examples: In a horrifying chain of events, Christopher Columbus once bit his own lip.
Do you have a chain saw I could borrow?
exampleZh: 在一连串可怕的事件中, 哥伦布曾经咬紧牙关撑过去。

defsEn: r. many times at short intervals
zh: adv. 频繁, 经常地
examples: How frequently do you check your mail?
I have a friend who frequently travels without a ticket.
exampleZh: 你多久看一次邮箱？
我有一个经常不带票旅行的朋友。

defsEn: n. a person who makes use of a thing
someone who uses or employs something
zh: n. 使用者
examples: If only I read the user manual properly.
My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
exampleZh: 要是当时有好好读说明书就好了。
我的朋友正在为新的操作系统设计一个用户界面。

defsEn: n. how something is done or how it happens
n. a way of acting or behaving
n. a kind
zh: n. 样子, 礼貌, 风格
examples: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.
It is bad manners to make a noise while you eat.
exampleZh: 一个国家的风俗习惯反映了它的文化。
吃饭时发出声音是不礼貌的。

defsEn: s. marked by peace and prosperity
s. suggestive of gold
s. presaging or likely to bring good luck
zh: a. 金的, 含金的, 金色的, 贵重的, 繁盛的
examples: He received a golden watch as a prize.
Her golden hair floats in the summer breeze.
exampleZh: 他被奖励了一块金表。
她的一头金发在夏日的微风中飘荡。

defsEn: a. employed in accomplishing something
zh: a. 使用过的, 二手的, 习惯的
examples: You used to carry your child on your back.
You used to carry your son on your back.

defsEn: r. at the same time but in another place
r. during the intervening time
zh: n. 其时, 其间
adv. 同时, 于此时
examples: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
Meanwhile, many more people fell, one after the other.
exampleZh: 在这期间，情况发生了巨大变化。

defsEn: n. polished surface that forms images by reflecting light
n. a faithful depiction or reflection
v. reflect as if in a mirror
v. reflect or resemble
zh: n. 镜子, 写真, 典范
vt. 反映, 映出
examples: The eye is the mirror of the soul.
She stood in front of the mirror.
exampleZh: 眼睛是心灵的镜子。
她站在镜子前。

defsEn: n. a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage
r. on or to one side
r. out of the way (especially away from one's thoughts)
r. placed or kept separate and distinct as for a purpose
zh: n. 小声说的话, 旁白
adv. 在一边, 离开, 另外
examples: He pulled aside to let a truck pass.
She put aside the sewing and stood up.
exampleZh: 他移开，让卡车通过。
她放下手中的针线活，并站了起来。

defsEn: r. at or in or to any place
(`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')
zh: adv. 无论何处
examples: You may go anywhere you like.
You can go anywhere you want.
exampleZh: 你喜欢去哪儿就可以去哪儿。
你可以去任何你想去的地方。

defsEn: n. belief about (or mental picture of) the future
n. the feeling that something is about to happen
zh: n. 期待, 指望, 展望
examples: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
The result is opposite to our expectations.
exampleZh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。
结果与我们预期的相反。

defsEn: n. the contestant who wins the contest
n. a gambler who wins a bet
zh: n. 胜利者, 优胜者
examples: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
It is good to be a winner.
exampleZh: 这场四分之一决赛的胜者将晋级半决赛。
做个赢家很好。

defsEn: n. climber having dark red berries (peppercorns) when fully ripe
southern India and Sri Lanka
naturalized in northern Burma and Assam
n. pungent seasoning from the berry of the common pepper plant of East India
use whole or ground
n. sweet and hot varieties of fruits of plants of the genus Capsicum
v. add pepper to
zh: n. 胡椒粉, 胡椒, 辣椒
examples: Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
Could you please pass me the pepper?
exampleZh: 请把盐和胡椒粉拿给我。
能把胡椒递给我吗？

defsEn: n. piece of leather or synthetic material that forms the part of a shoe or boot above the sole that encases the foot
s. the topmost one of two
s. higher in place or position
s. superior in rank or accomplishment
zh: a. 上面的, 较高的, 上级的, 上院的, 穿在外面的, 北部的, 地表的, 后期的
n. 鞋帮, 上齿
examples: He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.
The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.
exampleZh: 他觉得自己占了上风，但我反过来扭转了局面。
河的上游很美。

defsEn: r. in an essential manner
r. as a highly likely consequence
zh: adv. 必然地, 必须地, 必要地
examples: What he says is not necessarily true.
This work is not necessarily easy.
exampleZh: 他说的不见得对。
这项工作未必容易。

defsEn: s. remote and separate physically or socially
s. having characteristics not shared by others
r. separated or at a distance in place or position or time
r. not taken into account or excluded from consideration
zh: adv. 成零碎, 成距离, 分别地, 分离着
a. 分离的
examples: Apart from the cost, it will take long to build the bridge.
However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.
exampleZh: 撇开费用不说，建这座桥也会耗费不少的时间。
不过，除了佛教者以外，没有任何人可以一直遵循这个原则。

defsEn: a. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth
or being a reason for pride
zh: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的
examples: I want to make her proud of me.
He can be proud of his father.
exampleZh: 我想让她以我为傲。
他可以为自己的父亲而骄傲。

defsEn: r. and nothing more
zh: adv. 只
examples: He said it merely as a joke.
Don't look down on him merely because he is poor.
exampleZh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
不要因为他穷就看不起他。

defsEn: n. the quality of a person's voice
n. (linguistics) a pitch or change in pitch of the voice that serves to distinguish words in tonal languages
n. a steady sound without overtones
n. a musical interval of two semitones
zh: n. 音调, 音质, 语调, 语气, 色调, 气氛, 状况, 思想状态
vt. 给...定色调, 增强, 使...的声调和谐, 定音调
vi. 颜色调和
examples: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
There was a sudden change in her tone.
exampleZh: 你有没有发现他说话的语气有点古怪？
她声调突然变了。

defsEn: prep. In the direction of
to.
prep. With direction to, in a moral sense
with respect or
reference to
regarding
concerning.
prep. Tending to
in the direction of
in behalf of.
prep. Near
about
approaching to.
adv. Near
at hand
in state of preparation.
prep. & adv. See Toward.
zh: prep. 向, 对于, 为了
examples: Even if you move back, you advance towards death.
I want to face towards the ocean and scream.

defsEn: r. in a close relation or position in time or space
r. in a close manner
zh: adv. 接近地
examples: If you listen closely enough you'll be able to hear it.
We observed this plant closely for a few weeks.
exampleZh: 靠近一点听，你就会听到了。
我们密切地关注这家工厂几个星期了.

defsEn: a. having the ability or power to create
s. promoting construction or creation
zh: a. 有创造力的, 创作的, 产生的
examples: Tom has a lot of creative ideas.
Try to be more creative next time.
exampleZh: 汤姆有很多有创意的主意。

defsEn: v. move something or somebody to a lower position
v. set lower
v. cause to drop or sink
zh: a. 低的, 下级的, 下层的
vi. 降低, 跌落, 减弱
vt. 放下, 降下, 减弱, 贬低
examples: I think we should lower the price.
Keep it at a lower temperature.
exampleZh: 我觉得我们得调低价格。
保持在较低的温度。

defsEn: n. a statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.
n. thought that makes something comprehensible
n. the act of explaining
making something plain or intelligible
zh: n. 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明
examples: I want an explanation and I want it now.
There is no time for explanation.
exampleZh: 我要一个解释，而且现在就要！
没时间解释。

defsEn: s. full of or showing high-spirited merriment
s. given to social pleasures often including dissipation
s. offering fun and gaiety
s. homosexual or arousing homosexual desires
zh: a. 欢快的, 艳丽的, 快乐的, 放荡的
examples: And if I were gay, would that be a crime?
For many gay men, coming out of the closet is a difficult experience.
exampleZh: 如果我是同志那又怎样？这能构成犯罪吗？
对许多男同性恋者来说，出柜是一个困难的经历。

defsEn: r. for a very long or seemingly endless time
zh: adv. 永远
examples: I want to be with you forever.
It would take forever for me to explain everything.
exampleZh: 我想永远跟你在一起。
要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。

defsEn: n. disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings
n. a serious examination and judgment of something
n. a written evaluation of a work of literature
zh: n. 批评, 评论, 非难
examples: His reply implied a criticism of our work.
Your way of looking at criticism and self-criticism is not right.
exampleZh: 他的回答暗含着对我们工作的批评。
你对批评和自我批评这两者的看法不对。

defsEn: n. the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving)
n. reverent petition to a deity
n. a fixed text used in praying
n. someone who prays to God
zh: n. 祈祷, 恳求, 祷辞, 祈祷者
examples: It's Friday, and so we have to perform our prayers.
Send her a prayer and God Bless you all.
exampleZh: 今天是星期五，所以我们需要祷告。

defsEn: n. the time of person's life when they are a child
n. the state of a child between infancy and adolescence
zh: n. 孩童时期
examples: I always got up early in my childhood.
Her story took me back to my childhood.
exampleZh: 我小时总是很早起床。
她的故事带我回到了童年。

defsEn: n. finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper
for smoking
zh: n. 香烟, 纸烟
examples: She stopped to smoke a cigarette.
Please put out your cigarettes before entering the museum.
exampleZh: 她停下来抽了根烟。
请你在进入博物馆之前先把烟弄熄。

defsEn: n. sharp piercing cry
v. make a loud, piercing sound
zh: n. 尖叫声
vi. 尖叫, 大笑, 尖啸, 令人震惊
vt. 尖叫着说, 大叫大嚷着要求
examples: This time, it was James who screamed.
You scream with joy upon learning the good news.
exampleZh: 这次换詹姆斯尖叫了。

defsEn: s. occurring by chance
a. having or bringing good fortune
zh: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的
examples: It was lucky for you that you found it.
You're lucky to have such a good job.
exampleZh: 你很幸运找到了它。
你很幸运能有这么好的工作。

defsEn: n. a hose that carries air under pressure
n. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
zh: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司
examples: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
I work for an airline company as a flight attendant.
exampleZh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？

defsEn: r. of primary import
zh: adv. 主要地, 首先地
examples: A happy life primarily consists of freedom from worry.
They were primarily interested in the creation of the universe.

defsEn: a. (usually followed by `to') not having the necessary means or skill or know-how
s. (usually followed by `to') lacking necessary physical or mental ability
zh: a. 不能的, 不会的
examples: The plane was unable to take off due to the storm.
I am unable to walk as fast as he can.
exampleZh: 由于暴风雨的关系，飞机没能起飞。
我走得没他快。

defsEn: n. amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)
n. a detriment or sacrifice
n. money spent to perform work and usually reimbursed by an employer
v. reduce the estimated value of something
zh: n. 费用, 代价, 开支, 损失
examples: He did it at the expense of his health.
I have to reduce my expenses this month.
exampleZh: 他以牺牲自己的健康为代价完成了这项工作。
我这个月要减少开支。

defsEn: r. to a great degree
r. so as to leave much space or distance between
zh: adv. 广泛地
examples: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.
The term "qipao" is widely used in Northern China.
exampleZh: 英语是目前在世界上使用最广泛的语言。
“旗袍”这个词语在中国北方广为使用。

defsEn: n. the text appearing in a book, newspaper, or other printed publication
n. a picture or design printed from an engraving
n. availability in printed form
n. a copy of a movie on film (especially a particular version of it)
zh: n. 打印, 版, 印刷物, 痕迹, 印刷业, 印刷字体, 图片, 印花布, 印章
v. 打印, 印刷, 铭记, 留印记于, 用印刷体写
examples: This book will be printed next year.
Printing ink is in short supply.
exampleZh: 这本书明年要出版。
油墨快没了。

defsEn: n. the speech act of continuing a conversational exchange
zh: n. 答复, 回答, 答辩
vi. 答复, 回答, 回击, 反响, 答辩
vt. 回答
examples: Should I reply to his letter?
Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
exampleZh: 我应该回信给他吗？
收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。

defsEn: a. of or related to genetically distinguished groups of people
a. of or characteristic of race or races or arising from differences among groups
zh: a. 人种的, 种族的
examples: Garvey speaks up for racial pride.
Racial discrimination and disadvantage can have severe consequences for health.
exampleZh: Garvey毫无保留地宣扬种族主义。

defsEn: n. a business engaged in manufacturing some product
n. someone who manufactures something
zh: n. 制造业者, 厂商
examples: Write to the manufacturer if the machine develops the same fault again.
The manufacturer of the television set is a Japanese company.

defsEn: n. a clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites
one of the Holy Orders
n. a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
zh: n. 祭司, 牧师, 神父, 神质人员, 僧侣, 泰斗
examples: The main duty of a priest is to preach in church.
My brother has become a priest.
exampleZh: 牧师的主要职责是在教堂里讲道。
我的兄弟已经成为了牧师。

defsEn: r. at an earlier time or formerly
zh: adv. 先, 先前, 以前, 前, (非正式)过早, 过急, 在前, 在...以前, 在先
examples: Previously people believed the earth was flat.
I would never use a previously used tissue again.
exampleZh: 以前的人以为地球是平的。

defsEn: adv. & conj. At whatever time.
zh: conj. 每当
adv. 不论何时, 每逢
examples: Come and see me whenever you like.
Come to my house whenever you like.
exampleZh: 你随时都可以来看我。
只要你喜欢，你随时可以来我家。

defsEn: n. a person responsible for hiring workers
n. a person who exercises control and makes decisions
s. exceptionally good
zh: n. 老板, 上司, 岩瘤, 浮雕, 母牛
vt. 指挥, 控制, 浮雕
examples: I want to talk to your boss.
I have no problem with my boss.
exampleZh: 我想跟你老板谈。
我和老板没有问题。

defsEn: r. to a considerable degree
r. in a heavy-footed manner
r. with great force
r. in a manner designed for heavy duty
zh: adv. 很重地, 严重地, 难以忍受地
examples: It was raining heavily when I got up this morning.
Tom was bleeding heavily from a gunshot wound.
exampleZh: 我今天早上起来的时候雨下得很大。
汤姆的枪伤伤口导致了大出血。

defsEn: n. either of two offspring born at the same time from the same pregnancy
n. a waterfall in the Snake River in southern Idaho
v. duplicate or match
v. grow as twins
zh: n. 双胞胎中一人, 一对非常相像的人(或物)中的一个
a. 双胞胎的, 成对的, 孪生的
vi. 生双胞胎, 成对
vt. 怀(双胞胎), 使成对
examples: We could not tell the twins one from the other.
He mistook me for my twin brother.
exampleZh: 我们不能分辨那对双胞胎。
他把我误认为我的双胞胎兄弟。

defsEn: r. with strength or in a strong manner
zh: adv. 强有力地, 坚强地, 激烈地
examples: I am strongly opposed to a compromise.
I'm strongly opposed to a compromise.
exampleZh: 我强烈反对妥协。
我强烈反对妥协。

defsEn: n. the act of traveling from one place to another
zh: n. 旅程, 旅行, 行程
vi. 旅行
vt. 游历
examples: I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
He made a journey around the world.
exampleZh: 如果可能的话我想去世界各地旅行。
他环游世界旅行。

defsEn: r. definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
zh: adv. 的确地, 安全地
examples: That is a criminal offense, and you will surely be punished!
So, it surely should be like white on rice!
exampleZh: 那是犯罪行为，你肯定会受到惩罚的!

defsEn: n. a person who is confined
especially a prisoner of war
zh: n. 囚犯, 犯人, 战俘
examples: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.
The prisoner escaped under cover of night.
exampleZh: 国王下令把囚犯释放。
犯人趁着夜晚逃走了。

defsEn: n. a member of a learned society
n. an informal form of address for a man
zh: n. 男人, 朋友, 同事
a. 同伴的, 同事的, 同道的
examples: What a disagreeable fellow he is!
He is hardly friendly with his fellow workers.
exampleZh: 他可真是个让人讨厌的家伙！
他几乎不和他的同僚友好相处。

defsEn: s. close at hand
r. not far away in relative terms
zh: a. 附近的, 近旁的
adv. 在附近, 近旁地
prep. 在...附近
examples: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
Excuse me, is there a toilet nearby?
exampleZh: 虽然我住在她家附近，可是也很少见到她。
请问这儿附近有没有厕所？

defsEn: n. a person related by blood or marriage
n. an animal or plant that bears a relationship to another (as related by common descent or by membership in the same genus)
a. estimated by comparison
not absolute or complete
zh: n. 亲戚, 关系词
a. 有关系的, 相对的, 比较的
examples: The poor man has no relatives.
I can't go. My relatives are visiting me that day.
exampleZh: 穷人无亲戚。
我去不了，因为那天我家人要来看我。

defsEn: r. in a perfect or faultless way
zh: adv. 完全地, 无瑕疵地, 完整地
examples: All that you say is perfectly correct.
You know perfectly well how I feel about you.
exampleZh: 你说得完全正确。

defsEn: n a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
zh: n. 十三岁到十九岁的少年
examples: I feel like I'm a teenager again.
Dan dated Linda when she was a teenager.
exampleZh: 我感觉又变成了少年。
丹在琳达十几岁的时候就与她交往过。

defsEn: n. return to an original state
n. the act of regaining or saving something lost (or in danger of becoming lost)
zh: n. 恢复, 复原, 痊愈, 重获
examples: There is no hope of his recovery.
He is beyond the chance of recovery.
exampleZh: 他没有希望痊愈了。
对于他的康复没有任何希望。

defsEn: n. a man of refinement
zh: n. 绅士, 先生
examples: He must be a gentleman to act that way.
I know that gentleman only by name.
exampleZh: 这样的举止只可能是个绅士。
我只知道那个绅士的名字。

defsEn: n. an expert who observes and comments on something
zh: n. 观察者, 遵守者, 观察员
examples: Observers generally describe the method as leading to a quick and peaceful death.
The author is an observer of his era.

defsEn: n. the yield from plants in a single growing season
n. a cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
n. a collection of people or things appearing together
n. the output of something in a season
zh: n. 农作物, 产量, 平头
vt. 收割, 修剪, 种植
vi. 收获
examples: We grow a variety of crops.
Without bee pollination, California's almond crop, for example, would be non-existent.
exampleZh: 我们种植各种的作物。
例如，如果没有蜜蜂授粉，加州的杏仁作物就不会存在。

defsEn: a. marked by dissimilarity
a. not equal in amount
zh: a. 不像的, 不同的
prep. 不像, 和...不同
examples: It's unlike him to get so angry.
The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
exampleZh: 这么生气不像他。
不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

defsEn: n the mother of your father or mother
zh: n. 祖母, 女祖先
examples: I love my grandmother very much.
She always takes her grandmother for a walk.
exampleZh: 我非常爱我的祖母。
她一直带奶奶去散步。

defsEn: s. made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood
s. lacking ease or grace
zh: a. 木制的, 呆笨的, 木然的
examples: A wooden building can easily catch fire.
How much does the wooden chair cost?
exampleZh: 木质房屋很容易着火。
那张木椅要多少钱？

defsEn: n. the activity of putting or setting in order in advance of some act or purpose
n. (music) a note that produces a dissonant chord is first heard in a consonant chord
zh: n. 准备, 预备, 预习
examples: They've sold their house and car in preparation for leaving the country.
The day before, they had made preparations.
exampleZh: 他们卖掉了房子和汽车准备出国.
他们前一天就作了准备。

defsEn: n. any dialect of the language of ancient Rome
n. an inhabitant of ancient Latium
n. a person who is a member of those peoples whose languages derived from Latin
zh: n. 拉丁人, 拉丁语
a. 拉丁人的, 拉丁语的
examples: Latin is not at all easy to learn.
He is absorbed in the study of Latin.
exampleZh: 拉丁语一点也不好学。
他专心致志地学习拉丁语。

defsEn: r with rapid movements
zh: adv. 飞快地, 迅速地, 赶紧地
examples: You'll get used to it rapidly.
I felt my heart beating rapidly.
exampleZh: 你很快就会习惯的。
我感觉我的心跳得很快。

defsEn: n. a block of solid substance (such as soap or wax)
n. baked goods made from or based on a mixture of flour, sugar, eggs, and fat
zh: n. 蛋糕, 块, 饼
vt. 使结块, 加块状物于
vi. 结块
examples: To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
Cut the cake with that knife.
exampleZh: 要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。
用那把刀把蛋糕切开。

defsEn: n. an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning
n. practices one branch of medicine
zh: n. 专门医师, 专家
a. 专业的, 专家的
examples: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
Legal terminology is usually incomprehensible to non-specialists.
exampleZh: 专家就好像一台只有一根弦的小提琴一样。
法律术语是大多数普通人无法理解的。

defsEn: n. the bulb of an onion plant
n. bulbous plant having hollow leaves cultivated worldwide for its rounded edible bulb
n. an aromatic flavorful vegetable
zh: n. 洋葱
vt. 因洋葱使掉泪
examples: I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
I can eat anything but onions.
exampleZh: 我在花园种了番茄和洋葱。
除了洋葱我什么都可以吃。

defsEn: s roused to anger
s affected with madness or insanity
s marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
s very foolish
zh: a. 疯狂的, 发疯的, 生气的, 愚蠢的, 狂欢的
n. 狂怒
examples: I know you're probably mad about what I said yesterday.
Your wife is mad at you.
exampleZh: 我知道我昨天说的那番话把你弄得很生气。
你太太在生你的气。

defsEn: n. a major road for any form of motor transport
zh: n. 公路, 大道, 捷径
examples: The accident took place on the highway.
Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
exampleZh: 事故发生在高速公路上。
今天早上高速公路上的交通状况正常。

defsEn: n. something of value
a. having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
s. having worth or merit or value
zh: a. 有价值的, 贵重的, 宝贵的, 可估价的
examples: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
Nothing is more valuable than good health.
exampleZh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
没有什么比健康更重要。

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Italy
n. the Romance language spoken in Italy
a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Italy or its people or culture or language
zh: n. 意大利人, 意大利语
a. 意大利的, 意大利语的
examples: Could you put this report into Italian for me?
How do you say that in Italian?
exampleZh: 你可以为我把这份报告翻译成意大利文吗？
那个词用意大利语怎么说？

defsEn: n. a round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes
n. any of various plant parts that resemble buttons
n. a round flat badge displaying information and suitable for pinning onto a garment
n. any artifact that resembles a button
zh: n. 钮扣, 按钮
vi. 扣住
vt. 钉钮扣于, 扣紧
examples: If you press this button the window opens automatically.
Push the red button if something strange happens.
exampleZh: 按下这个按钮, 窗口会自动打开。
发生意外的话按这个红按钮。

defsEn: s. including more than a specified category
s. extremely large
zh: n. 跑龙套角色, 冗员, 特级品, 特大号, 管理人
a. 上等的, 特大的, 超级的, 极好的, 十分的, 过分的
adv. 非常
examples: I only buy super soft toilet paper.
Teachers nowadays are super into testing. It seems that there's another test today.
exampleZh: 我只买超柔软的卫生纸。
现在的老师么，非常迷信考试，据说今天又要考试啦。

defsEn: n. either side of the face below the eyes
v. speak impudently to
zh: n. 颊, 厚颜, 脸蛋
examples: She kissed him on the cheek.
Tom has a scar on his cheek.
exampleZh: 她亲吻他的脸颊。
汤姆的脸颊上有一块伤痕。

defsEn: v. be of different opinions
v. be different from one another
zh: vi. 不一致, 不适宜
examples: I disagree with what you say.
They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
exampleZh: 我不同意你的说法。
他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。

defsEn: n. anyone who does not belong in the environment in which they are found
n. an individual that one is not acquainted with
zh: n. 陌生人, 门外汉
examples: I saw a stranger enter that house.
A stranger spoke to me on the bus.
exampleZh: 我看到一个陌生人进了那间屋子。
在公车上有个陌生人跟我说话。

defsEn: a. physically and forcibly separated into pieces or cracked or split
a. not continuous in space, time, or sequence or varying abruptly
s. subdued or brought low in condition or status
a. (especially of promises or contracts) having been violated or disregarded
zh: a. 坏掉的, 打破的, 断掉的
break的过去分词
examples: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
There was a broken cup on the table.
exampleZh: 请快点把碎了的那个换掉好吗？
桌上有个破杯子。

defsEn: n. a car that is powered by electricity
a. using or providing or producing or transmitting or operated by electricity
s. (of a situation) exceptionally tense
s. affected by emotion as if by electricity
thrilling
zh: a. 电的, 导电的, 电动的
examples: It is hot. Bring the electric fan.
My brother bought an electric guitar.
exampleZh: 天气很热，把电风扇拿来。
我的兄弟买了电子吉他。

defsEn: v. rub with a circular motion
zh: n. 擦拭, 用力打, 凸轮
vt. 擦, 揩, 消灭, 涂上, 拭去
vi. 擦, 打
examples: She wiped her wet hair with a towel.
He wiped the sweat from his face.
exampleZh: 她用毛巾把头发抹干了。
他擦去了脸上的汗水。

defsEn: n. the child of your aunt or uncle
zh: n. 堂兄弟姊妹, 表兄弟姊妹
examples: He went to stay with his cousin.
My cousin, who is a lawyer, is in France at present.
exampleZh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。
我的律师表哥现在在法国。

defsEn: v. restate (words) from one language into another language
v. change from one form or medium into another
v. bring to a certain spiritual state
v. change the position of (figures or bodies) in space without rotation
zh: vt. 翻译, 解释, 转化, 转变为, 调动
vi. 翻译, 被译
examples: Could you help me translate this into French?
Please translate this sentence into Japanese.
exampleZh: 你能帮我把这译成法语吗？
请把这句话翻译成日文。

defsEn: r. in a gradual manner
r. in a gentle manner
zh: adv. 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地
examples: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
He put a hand gently on her shoulder.
exampleZh: 护士轻柔地给我的头缠上绷带。
他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。

defsEn: n. the strength of a solution
number of molecules of a substance in a given volume
n. the spatial property of being crowded together
n. strengthening the concentration (as of a solute in a mixture) by removing diluting material
n. increase in density
zh: n. 集中, 专心
examples: She bit her lip in concentration.
This prison is not a prison but a concentration camp.

defsEn: n the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
zh: n. 一生, 终生
a. 一生的, 终生的
examples: It will take a lifetime to translate all this.
I wish you both a lifetime of happiness.

defsEn: n. a time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something
n. temporary inactivity
v. cease an action temporarily
zh: n. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 间歇, 踌躇, 休止符
vi. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 踌躇
examples: He paused to have a cigarette.
Let me pause for thought to think it through.
exampleZh: 他停下来抽根烟。

defsEn: n. a person who loves someone or is loved by someone
n. a significant other to whom you are not related by marriage
zh: n. 爱人, 爱好者
examples: My lover is great at cooking.
She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.
exampleZh: 我的爱人很会做饭。
有人看见他和情人在饭店吃饭。

defsEn: a. causing surprise or wonder or amazement
zh: a. 令人惊讶的
examples: It was all more and more surprising.
At the risk of surprising you, I happen to work.
exampleZh: 真是惊人至极。

defsEn: r. very recently
zh: adv. 重新, 最近
examples: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
The newly bought quilt is very warm when covered.
exampleZh: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？
新买的被子盖起来非常暖和。

defsEn: r. in like or similar manner
zh: adv. 相像地, 类似于
examples: They think similarly but come to different conclusions.
All of the men were dressed similarly to Tom.

defsEn: r. as might be expected
r. according to nature
by natural means
without artificial help
r. through inherent nature
r. in a natural or normal manner
zh: adv. 自然地, 以自然力, 天生地
examples: This forest fire was naturally caused.
Naturally we will be careful to avoid an accident.
exampleZh: 这场森林大火是自然引起的。

defsEn: r for the most part
zh: adv. 主要地, 大抵
examples: That company deals mainly in imported goods.
Scientists deal mainly with physical matters.
exampleZh: 这公司主要做进口货物的生意。
科学家处理大多数物理的事物。

defsEn: n. the emotion of great happiness
n. something or someone that provides a source of happiness
zh: n. 欢喜, 乐事, 高兴
vt. 使快乐, 令人高兴
vi. 欢喜
examples: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
exampleZh: 凡美的事物就是永恒的喜悦。
最后，他们感受到了胜利的喜悦。

defsEn: n. a person who sings
n. United States inventor of an improved chain-stitch sewing machine (1811-1875)
n. United States writer (born in Poland) of Yiddish stories and novels (1904-1991)
zh: n. 歌手
examples: His mother used to be a singer.
I hope to become a singer.
exampleZh: 他的妈妈以前是个歌手。
我希望成为一名歌手。

defsEn: r in part
in some degree
not wholly
zh: adv. 部分地, 在一定程度上
examples: What you say is partly true.
The wall is partly covered with ivy.
exampleZh: 你说的有几分是真实的。
墙被常青藤覆盖了一部分。

defsEn: n. an unknown and unexplored region
n. a variable whose values are solutions of an equation
a. not known
s. not known to exist
zh: a. 不知道的, 未知的, 陌生的
n. 未知物, 未知数
examples: The cause of the fire was unknown.
I embrace the unknown as a chance to grow.
exampleZh: 火灾的原因不明。

defsEn: r. for a short time
r. at a short distance
zh: adv. 不久, 简短, 唐突地
examples: Shortly before his wedding, he decided not to get married.
Shortly after the accident, the police came.
exampleZh: 他在要结婚之际决定还是不结婚了。
事故发生后不久，警察来了。

defsEn: n support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway
zh: n. 梯级, 楼梯, 阶梯
examples: I slipped and fell down the stairs.
I heard him go down the stairs.
exampleZh: 我滑了一交并从楼梯上摔下来。
我听见了他下楼。

defsEn: r. in the right manner
zh: adv. 适当地, 相当地
examples: Can you please properly study a foreign language?
If you understand, then do it properly.
exampleZh: 你能不能好好读外语？
懂了就正确做。

defsEn: n. a public or private structure (business or governmental or educational) including buildings and equipment for business or residence
n. any large organization
n. (ecology) the process by which a plant or animal becomes established in a new habitat
n. the cognitive process of establishing a valid proof
zh: n. 确立, 制定, 设施
examples: Why is it that at a bachelor's establishment the servants invariably drink the champagne?
This business establishment is run by an Algerian company.

defsEn: n. the formation of a mental image of something that is not perceived as real and is not present to the senses
n. the ability to form mental images of things or events
zh: n. 想像, 听觉, 想像力
examples: I want you to use your imagination.
Imagination is the root of all civilization.
exampleZh: 我想你用自己的想象力。
想像力是一切文明的根源。

defsEn: n. distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers
zh: n. 鹿
examples: The deer is three times as heavy as Jane.
The deer move around there in total freedom.
exampleZh: 鹿是简的三倍重。

defsEn: n an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future
n the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman)
n your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
v decree or designate beforehand
zh: n. 命运, 运气
vt. 注定
examples: God knows what their fate will be.
She had to accept her fate.
exampleZh: 天知道他们的命运到底是什么。
她该接受她的命运。

defsEn: n. a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain
n. a feeling of freedom from worry or disappointment
n. satisfaction or physical well-being provided by a person or thing
n. assistance, such as that provided to an enemy or to a known criminal
zh: n. 舒适, 安慰, 安慰者
vt. 安慰
examples: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
When her friend was sad, she comforted him.
exampleZh: 你需要离开你的舒适区。
朋友伤心时，她轻声安慰他。

defsEn: n. a sweet yellow liquid produced by bees
v. sweeten with honey
s. of something having the color of honey
zh: n. 蜂蜜, 甜蜜, 爱人
a. 蜂蜜似的, 甜蜜的, 甘美的
vt. 加蜜使甜, 对...说甜言蜜语
vi. 说甜言蜜语, 奉承
examples: Honey in the mouth and poison in the heart.
How much honey do you need?
exampleZh: 口中有蜜，心中有毒。
你要多少钱？

defsEn: n. someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)
n. artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
zh: n. 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家
examples: Do you know when the musician will come here?
Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
exampleZh: 你知道音乐家什么时候来这儿吗？
舞台上有著名音乐家吗？

defsEn: n. the father of your father or mother
zh: n. 祖父, 始祖
examples: I take care of my grandfather.
He went to see his grandfather off at the station.
exampleZh: 我照顾我的爷爷。
他去车站送爷爷了。

defsEn: n. literature in metrical form
n. any communication resembling poetry in beauty or the evocation of feeling
zh: n. 诗, 韵文, 诗歌艺术
examples: Wine is poetry put into a bottle.
They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
exampleZh: 酒是灌入瓶中的诗。
他们视乔叟为英诗之父。

defsEn: r. in a gradual manner
zh: adv. 逐渐地
examples: To be honest, I've gradually come to dislike the life here.
The population of this country is gradually diminishing.
exampleZh: 老实说, 我已经渐渐地不喜欢这里的生活。
这个国家的人口正在逐渐减少。

defsEn: s having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
zh: a. 富有的, 丰裕的, 充分的
examples: She married a wealthy old man.
He is the son of a wealthy family.
exampleZh: 她嫁给了个有钱老头。
他是有钱人家的儿子。

defsEn: n. narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow
v. move along on skis
zh: n. 滑雪橇
vi. 滑雪
examples: We can enjoy skiing here all the year round.
I want to go skiing with her.
exampleZh: 在这里我们整年都能享受到滑雪的乐趣。
我想和她去滑雪。

defsEn: v. give an education to
v. teach or refine to be discriminative in taste or judgment
zh: vt. 教育, 培养, 训练
examples: People are more educated now than they used to be.
Mr. Ito is a highly educated man.
exampleZh: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。
伊藤先生是一个受过高度教育的人。

defsEn: a. causing physical or psychological pain
zh: a. 痛苦的, 困难的, 令人烦恼的
examples: There's nothing more painful than losing one's child.
Getting kicked in the groin is painful.
exampleZh: 没有比失去孩子更伤心的事。
被踢裆是很痛的。

defsEn: n. the act of coercing someone into government service
v. impress positively
v. produce or try to produce a vivid impression of
v. mark or stamp with or as if with pressure
zh: n. 印象, 特征, 印记
vt. 使有印象, 印, 铭刻, 传送, 影响, 强征
vi. 给人印象
examples: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
His speech impressed us very much.
exampleZh: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。
他的话深深触动了我们。

defsEn: n. a portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs)
n. a web that resembles a tent or carpet
zh: n. 帐篷, 帷幕, 住处, 塞条, 塞子
vi. 住帐蓬, 宿营, 暂时居住
vt. 用帐篷遮盖, 使住帐篷, 用塞条嵌入
examples: A tent with a floor and a zipper is bug tight.
We set up the tent next to the river.
exampleZh: 有垫布与拉链的帐篷可以做到防虫密闭。

defsEn: a. in a state of sleep
s. lacking sensation
s. dead
r. into a sleeping state
zh: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的
adv. 熟睡地
examples: The dog fell asleep on top of the blanket.
I fell asleep while reading a book.
exampleZh: 狗在毯子上睡着了。
我看书的时候睡着了。

defsEn: n. handwear: covers the hand and wrist
zh: n. 手套
vt. 给...戴手套
examples: She left her gloves in the car.
My father bought a pair of gloves for me.
exampleZh: 她把她的手套留在车上了。
父亲买了一双手套给我。

defsEn: n. the act of punishing
zh: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 惩罚
examples: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
I think a punishment like that would be too harsh.
exampleZh: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

defsEn: r. to a severe or serious degree
r. evilly or wickedly
r. in a disobedient or naughty way
r. with great intensity (`bad' is a nonstandard variant for `badly')
zh: adv. 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地
examples: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
We are badly in need of food.
exampleZh: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。
我们非常需要食物。

defsEn: n. (Great Britain) a closed railroad car that carries baggage or freight
n. a camper equipped with living quarters
n. a truck with an enclosed cargo space
zh: n. 货车, 篷车, 先锋, 前驱, 前卫
vt. 用货车搬运
examples: A big van appeared on the street corner.
Don't you live in a van?
exampleZh: 街角出现了一辆大面包车。
你不是住在货车里吗？

defsEn: n a motor vehicle with four wheels
usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
zh: n. 汽车
pref. 表示"自己"、"本身", 表示"自己的", 表示"自动的"
examples: I work at an auto shop.
Do you trust your auto mechanic?

defsEn: n. a soulful or amorous idealist
a. belonging to or characteristic of Romanticism or the Romantic Movement in the arts
zh: a. 浪漫的, 风流的, 传奇性的, 夸大的, 空想的, 浪漫派的
examples: Did you have any romantic encounter at the bar last night?
Actually I find it quite romantic.
exampleZh: 昨天去酒吧有艳遇吗？
其实我还是觉得好浪漫哦。

defsEn: n. machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion
n. a nonspecific agent that imparts motion
zh: n. 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车
a. 马达的, 发动机的, 汽车的, 发动的
vt. 推动, 以汽车载运
vi. 乘汽车, 驾车
examples: Is there a problem with the motor?
The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
exampleZh: 发动机出问题了吗？
城市里的机动车数量增加了。

defsEn: n. an airplane powered by one or more jet engines
n. the occurrence of a sudden discharge (as of liquid)
n. a hard black form of lignite that takes a brilliant polish and is used in jewelry or ornamentation
n. atmospheric discharges (lasting 10 msec) bursting from the tops of giant storm clouds in blue cones that widen as they flash upward
zh: n. 喷射流, 喷嘴, 煤玉
v. 射出, 迸出, 喷射
a. 黑而发亮的, 墨黑的
examples: Actually, I still haven't gotten over my jet lag.
We saw a jet plane fly across the sky.
exampleZh: 我时差还没倒过来呢。

defsEn: r. with success
in a successful manner
zh: adv. 成功, 结果良好, 有成就
examples: She successfully got him to tell the truth.
This country successfully detonated a atomic bomb.
exampleZh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。
这个国家了成功试爆了原子弹。

defsEn: n. usually large hard-shelled seed
n. Egyptian goddess of the sky
n. a small (usually square or hexagonal) metal block with internal screw thread to be fitted onto a bolt
v. gather nuts
zh: n. 坚果, 核心, 螺帽
examples: He takes the nuts from the fire with the dog's foot.
The nut is round, but not everything round is a nut.
exampleZh: 他用狗爪子从火里取走坚果。
坚果是圆的，但不是光是圆的就是坚果。

defsEn: n. a female actor
zh: n. 女演员
examples: I hear that she's a famous actress.
I hear that she is a famous actress.
exampleZh: 我听说她是个有名的演员。
我听说她是个有名的演员。

defsEn: r. several time
zh: adv. 重复地, 再三地
examples: I'm tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about what happened today, deeply remorseful.
I've asked you repeatedly not to sing so late at night.
exampleZh: 我辗转反侧，反复思考着白天发生的事，后悔不已。

defsEn: n. a mental representation of some haunting experience
n. the visible disembodied soul of a dead person
v. move like a ghost
v. write for someone else
zh: n. 鬼, 灵魂, 幻影, 一丝, 一点
v. 鬼似地游荡
examples: It's a ghost, and only I can speak to him.
This castle also has a ghost.
exampleZh: 那是个幽灵，只有我能和它交谈。
这个城堡也有一个鬼。

defsEn: s. found in the ordinary course of events
s. commonplace and ordinary
zh: a. 每天的, 日常的, 平常的
examples: He goes to the market everyday.
Everyday, I eat ice-cream for breakfast.
exampleZh: 他每天去市场。

defsEn: n. large gallinaceous bird with fan-shaped tail
widely domesticated for food
n. a Eurasian republic in Asia Minor and the Balkans
on the collapse of the Ottoman Empire in 1918, the Young Turks, led by Kemal Ataturk, established a republic in 1923
n. flesh of large domesticated fowl usually roasted
n. an event that fails badly or is totally ineffectual
zh: n. 火鸡, 无用的家伙, 土耳其
examples: Where do you live in Turkey?
Where in Turkey do you live?
exampleZh: 你在土耳其哪儿生活?
你在土耳其哪儿生活?

defsEn: n. the heading or caption of a newspaper article
v. publicize widely or highly, as if with a headline
v. provide (a newspaper page or a story) with a headline
zh: n. 大标题, 新闻摘要
vt. 为...做标题, 写标题
examples: The headline caught my eye this morning.
The headlines often talk about this actor.
exampleZh: 大标题今天早上吸引了我的注意。

defsEn: n. the amount of energy transmitted (as by acoustic or electromagnetic radiation)
n. high level or degree
the property of being intense
zh: n. 强烈, 紧张, 强度
examples: The intensity of his embrace conveyed a deep connection and profound affection.
Try high-intensity interval training for quick workouts.

defsEn: n. (usually plural) consumer goods sold by a grocer
zh: n. 食品杂货店, 食品杂货业
examples: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
Want to come with me to the grocery store?
exampleZh: 请告诉我们哪儿有食品杂货店。

defsEn: n. any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails
n. person who is quiet or timid
n. a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad
on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad
v. manipulate the mouse of a computer
zh: n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标
vi. 捕鼠, 窥探
vt. 探出
examples: There is a mouse under the table.
If you have rat or mouse problems, you can scare them off with ultrasound.
exampleZh: 桌子下有老鼠。
你如果遭受老鼠困扰，可以使用超音波来吓跑牠们。

defsEn: n. an artist who paints
n. a worker who is employed to cover objects with paint
n. a line that is attached to the bow of a boat and used for tying up (as when docking or towing)
zh: n. 画家, 油漆匠
examples: He is a painter, but he can't paint in the traditional Chinese style.
He's a painter, but he doesn't do traditional Chinese painting.
exampleZh: 他是个画家，但他不会画国画。
他是个画家，但他不会画国画。

defsEn: n. a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
zh: n. 勇气, 胆量
examples: His courage will carry him through this difficult job.
You must build up your courage.
exampleZh: 他的勇气将帮助他度过这艰难的任务。
你一定要鼓起勇气。

defsEn: n. an officer holding a rank below a major but above a lieutenant
n. the naval officer in command of a military ship
n. a policeman in charge of a precinct
n. the leader of a group of people
zh: n. 船长, 指挥官, 海军上校, 首领
vt. 率领, 指挥
examples: We want you to be the team captain.
I'm the captain of this ship.
exampleZh: 我们要你做队长。
我是这船的船长。

defsEn: n. a challenge to do something dangerous or foolhardy
v. to be courageous enough to try or do something
zh: n. 挑战, 挑动, 大胆
v. 敢, 胆敢
examples: How dare you speak to me like that?
How dare you speak like that to me?
exampleZh: 你怎么敢这么跟我说话？
你竟敢这样和我说话？

defsEn: n. a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
zh: n. 英式足球
examples: I often play soccer after school.
We will play soccer after school.
exampleZh: 我常常在放学后踢足球。
我们放学后会去踢足球。

defsEn: r. in a surprising manner
zh: adv. 使人惊奇, 出人意外, 惊人, 令人惊讶
examples: Surprisingly, he did his last job in one-third the time it would take me.
I'm a surprisingly good listener, despite how I look.

defsEn: n. something that serves to indicate or suggest
n. the act of indicating or pointing out by name
n. (medicine) a reason to prescribe a drug or perform a procedure
n. something (as a course of action) that is indicated as expedient or necessary
zh: n. 指示, 象征, 暗示
examples: I see no indication of that ever happening.
There is no clear indication of when Islam first came to our region.

defsEn: r. without good reason
r. with few burdens
r. with little weight or force
r. indulging with temperance
zh: adv. 轻轻地, 少许, 不费力地
examples: The other team took us lightly.
I dress lightly all the time.
exampleZh: 另外一队轻视了我们。

defsEn: n. the activity of laughing
the manifestation of joy or mirth or scorn
zh: n. 笑, 笑声
examples: Is laughter a quality of man only?
Laughter is good for your health.
exampleZh: 笑是人类特有的吗？
笑一笑，十年少。

defsEn: n. the northwestern region of the United States
n. the direction corresponding to the northwestward compass point
n. the compass point midway between north and west
at 315 degrees
zh: n. 西北, 西北方
a. 西北的, 在西北的, 来自西北的
adv. 向西北
examples: They marched northwest into the Shenandoah Valley.
Ecuador is a country situated in the northwest part of South America.
exampleZh: 他们向西北方向进军，进入了谢南多厄河谷。

defsEn: a. worthy of acceptance or satisfactory
s. judged to be in conformity with approved usage
s. adequate for the purpose
zh: a. 可接受的, 合意的, 可忍受的
examples: Should it be acceptable to wish death on a bad person?
Would this be acceptable to you?

defsEn: r. to an extraordinary extent or degree
zh: adv. 很, 非常
examples: I greatly recommend reading it to anybody thinking of learning a craft.
This year, he improved greatly on the education front.
exampleZh: 我强烈推荐任何想学习一门手艺的人都去读这本书。
这一年他在学习上有很大的进步。

defsEn: n. the state of being acceptable and accepted
n. (contract law) words signifying consent to the terms of an offer (thereby creating a contract)
n. banking: a time draft drawn on and accepted by a bank
n. the act of taking something that is offered
zh: n. 接受, 接纳, 承认, 同意, 赞同, 容忍, 相信
examples: I want to read to you my acceptance speech.
Acceptance could pave the way for mutual respect.

defsEn: n. a rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts
zh: n. 糖果, 冰糖
vt. 用糖煮, 使结晶为砂糖
vi. 结晶为砂糖
examples: I want a piece of candy.
My son took a candy from the box.
exampleZh: 我想要一颗糖。
我的儿子从盒子里拿了一粒糖。

defsEn: v. express greetings upon meeting someone
v. send greetings to
v. react to in a certain way
v. be perceived by
zh: vt. 问候, 致敬, 欢迎, 映入眼帘
examples: I greet my teacher on the street.
Have you ever greeted the small peach tree in German?
exampleZh: 我在街上遇到我的老师。
你曾经用德语和那棵小桃树打过招呼吗？

defsEn: n. the property of lacking physical or mental strength
liability to failure under pressure or stress or strain
n. the condition of being financially weak
n. a penchant for something even though it might not be good for you
zh: n. 虚弱, 薄弱, 弱点
examples: The ability to show weakness is a strength.
Ann has a weakness for chocolate.
exampleZh: 示弱是一种力量。
安喜欢巧克力。

defsEn: n. a resident of modern Rome
n. an inhabitant of the ancient Roman Empire
n. a typeface used in ancient Roman inscriptions
zh: n. 罗马人
a. 罗马人的, 罗马的
examples: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
exampleZh: 罗马人的黄金时代已过去了。
入乡随俗。

defsEn: n. a periodical that is published every month (or 12 issues per year)
s. of or occurring or payable every month
r. occurring once a month
zh: n. 月刊
a. 每月的, 每月一次的
examples: How much is your monthly gas bill?
How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
exampleZh: 你每个月的瓦斯费多少钱？
这间游泳学校每个月的学费是多少？

defsEn: n. small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs
n. (cricket) a score of nothing by a batsman
n. flesh of a duck (domestic or wild)
n. a heavy cotton fabric of plain weave
used for clothing and tents
zh: n. 鸭子
vi. 没入水中, 闪避
vt. 猛按...入水, 躲避
examples: He has the walk of a duck.
Like water off a duck's back.
exampleZh: 他走路走得像只鸭子似的。
如水流过鸭背般毫无反应。

defsEn: n. the compass point midway between south and west
at 225 degrees
n. the southwestern region of the United States generally including New Mexico, Arizona, Texas, Nevada, California, and sometimes Utah and Colorado
n. the direction corresponding to the southwestward compass point
zh: n. 西南, 西南方, 西南地区
a. 西南的, 来自西南方的
adv. 往西南, 来自西南
examples: I go to the southwest of the village.
I live in the southwest of the United States.

defsEn: a. not expected or anticipated
