examples: Tessa shared her experience in a chapel assembly this April.
I saw you at the school assembly.
exampleZh: 今年四月，苔丝在教会集会上分享了她的经验。

defsEn: a. producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)
s. yielding positive results
zh: a. 能生产的, 有生产价值的, 多产的
examples: You are really very productive today.
It would be counter-productive to do such a thing.
exampleZh: 你今天真的很有生产力。

defsEn: n. a steep place (as on a hill)
v. devote (oneself) fully to
v. let sit in a liquid to extract a flavor or to cleanse
a. having a sharp inclination
zh: n. 浸渍, 悬崖
a. 险峻的, 陡峭的, 急剧升降的, 夸大的
v. 浸, 泡
examples: My cousin is so steeped in schoolwork that his friends call him bookworm.
The climb will be steep and difficult.
exampleZh: 我的表兄弟太过沉浸于学业，以致于他的朋友们唤他作书虫。

defsEn: n. spiritual being attendant upon God
n. invests in a theatrical production
n. the highest waterfall
has more than one leap
flow varies seasonally
zh: n. 天使, 守护神, 善人
examples: This morning, I saw an angel.
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
exampleZh: 我今晨看见一位天使。
初生之犊不畏虎。

defsEn: n. a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal
n. the act of regarding as equal
zh: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡
examples: What's the answer to this equation?
Find the roots of the equation.

defsEn: n. a room or building equipped with one or more toilets
n. a plumbing fixture for defecation and urination
n. the act of dressing and preparing yourself
zh: n. 厕所, 梳妆
vi. 梳妆, 打扮, 上厕所
vt. 给...梳妆打扮
examples: I have to go to the toilet.
I need to go to the toilet.
exampleZh: 我要上厕所。
我要去厕所。

defsEn: n. a state of extreme anger
n. something that is desired intensely
n. violent state of the elements
v. be violent
as of fires and storms
zh: n. 愤怒, 情绪激动, 狂暴
vi. 大怒, 狂吹, 流行
examples: I can feel your rage through the internet.
A cry of rage rose from his throat.

defsEn: s. of high worth or cost
r. extremely
zh: a. 宝贵的, 珍贵的, 过于精致的, 珍爱的
examples: There is no treasure more precious than a child.
Time is the most precious thing in the world.
exampleZh: 孩子是宝中之宝。
时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。

defsEn: v. register formally as a participant or member
zh: vt. 登记, 使加入
vi. 参军, 注册
examples: I want to enroll at graduate school.
We only enroll our children in French school.
exampleZh: 我想在研究生院注册。

defsEn: s. distinguished from others in excellence
s. having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
s. owed as a debt
zh: a. 杰出的, 突出的, 未偿付的, 未决定的
examples: He's a man of outstanding character.
He came across an outstanding young person.
exampleZh: 他的人品出众。
他遇到了一个优秀的年轻人。

defsEn: v. walk unsteadily
v. miss a step and fall or nearly fall
v. encounter by chance
v. make an error
zh: n. 绊倒, 蹒跚而行, 失足
vt. 使绊倒, 使困惑
vi. 绊倒, 失足, 失策, 犯错, 蹒跚, 踌躇
examples: The newborn giraffe stumbled around on rickety legs.
Why do I always stumble through life like this?
exampleZh: 新生的长颈鹿摇晃着腿跌跌撞撞地走。

defsEn: a. contrived by art rather than nature
s. artificially formal
s. not arising from natural growth or characterized by vital processes
zh: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地产的
examples: I found them lying on the artificial grass.
They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我发现他们正躺在人工草皮上。
明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。

defsEn: n. the first light of day
n. the earliest period
n. an opening time period
v. appear or develop
zh: n. 破晓, 黎明
vi. 破晓
examples: We must get up at dawn.
We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
exampleZh: 黎明时我们必须起床。
我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。

defsEn: v. move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way
zh: vi. 下降, 世代相传, 屈尊, 袭击
vt. 下降
examples: Most Americans are descended from immigrants.
I'm not sure I can descend from there.
exampleZh: 若追根溯源，绝大多数美国人都是移民。

defsEn: n. a word used for misbehaving children
zh: a. 愚蠢的, 糊涂的
examples: I need to ask you a silly question.
It would be silly to do that again.
exampleZh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。
再那样做就太蠢了。

defsEn: n. the periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon
n. something that may increase or decrease (like the tides of the sea)
n. there are usually two high and two low tides each day
v. rise or move forward
zh: n. 潮, 潮汐, 趋势, 潮流, 涨潮, 高潮
vt. 使随潮漂流
vi. 顺潮行驶
examples: You could walk to the island on no tide.
We rise with the tide, steady and strong.

defsEn: r. without much difficulty
zh: adv. 迅速地, 轻易地, 乐意地
examples: The noted diplomat readily participated in the committee.
The eloquent scholar readily participated in the debate.

defsEn: s. markedly new or introducing radical change
a. relating to or having the nature of a revolution
a. advocating or engaged in revolution
zh: n. 革命者, 革命党人
a. 革命的, 革命性的
examples: Without a revolutionary theory there can be no revolutionary movement.
The most radical revolutionary will become a conservative the day after the revolution.

defsEn: n. a cushion to support the head of a sleeping person
v. rest on or as if on a pillow
zh: n. 枕头, 靠垫, 枕状岩
vt. 作...的枕头, 垫, 枕于
vi. 靠在枕上
examples: Can you give me a pillow and a blanket?
Please bring me the pillow and the blanket.
exampleZh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？
请把枕头和毯子拿给我。

defsEn: n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile)
n. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal
n. (computer science) the mechanical, magnetic, electronic, and electrical components making up a computer system
zh: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件
examples: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
You will find this in a hardware store.
exampleZh: 由硬体到软体的转变是缓慢的。

defsEn: n. a device incised to make an impression
used to secure a closing or to authenticate documents
n. the pelt or fur (especially the underfur) of a seal
n. a stamp affixed to a document (as to attest to its authenticity or to seal it)
n. a finishing coat applied to exclude moisture
zh: n. 印章, 封条, 海豹, 海豹皮, 火漆, 封蜡, 玺, 保证, 批准, 象征, 标志
vt. 封闭, 盖印, 盖章
vi. 猎海豹
examples: This mask completely seals your face.
Make sure you seal food properly to avoid contamination.
exampleZh: 这个面具完全盖住了你的脸。

defsEn: n. an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow
n. an established itinerary of venues or events that a particular group of people travel to
n. (law) a judicial division of a state or the United States (so-called because originally judges traveled and held court in different locations)
one of the twelve groups of states in the United States that is covered by a particular circuit court of appeals
v. make a circuit
zh: n. 电路, 环(行)道, 巡回
examples: Because of a short circuit, we were suddenly in the dark.
A resistor fell off the circuit board.

defsEn: n the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
n an acute insufficiency
zh: n. 不足, 缺乏
examples: There is a shortage of good building wood.
Due to the water shortage, all the flowers in the garden have died.
exampleZh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。
由于缺水，花园里所有的花都死了。

defsEn: r in the recent past
zh: adv. 近来, 最近
examples: By the way, have you seen him lately?
I have seen much of him lately.
exampleZh: 顺便说一句，你最近见过他吗？
我最近老是见到他。

defsEn: n. the act of scanning
systematic examination of a prescribed region
n. an image produced by scanning
v. examine minutely or intensely
v. examine hastily
zh: n. 审视, 浏览, 扫描, 细查
vt. 细看, 浏览, 扫描, 详细调查, 标出格律
vi. 押韵, 扫描
examples: I want you to scan this book.
How do you scan French poetry?

defsEn: n. the back of a military formation or procession
n. the side of an object that is opposite its front
n. the side that goes last or is not normally seen
v. stand up on the hind legs, of quadrupeds
zh: n. 后面, 背后, 后方
a. 后面的, 背面的, 后方的
vt. 养育, 培养, 饲养, 举起, 树立, 栽种
vi. 高耸, 暴跳
examples: Look in the rear-view mirror before backing up.
The rear tire of my bicycle is flat.
exampleZh: 倒车前先看后视镜。
我的自行车的后轮爆胎了。

defsEn: r. with low volume
r. in a manner that is pleasing to the senses
zh: adv. 柔和地, 静静地, 温柔地
examples: You speak so softly that I cannot quite hear what you say.
Speak softly, no need to make a racket!
exampleZh: 你说得太轻了，以至于我没办法听清楚你在说什么。

defsEn: s inspiring scornful pity
s incongruous
inviting ridicule
s broadly or extravagantly humorous
resembling farce
zh: a. 荒谬的, 可笑的
examples: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
Upon seeing how ridiculous he looked, everyone could not help but laughing.
exampleZh: 花光他们所有的钱会很荒谬。
看到他那可笑的样子，大家忍不住笑了。

defsEn: n. a transparent piece of diamond that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem
n. very hard native crystalline carbon valued as a gem
n. a playing card in the minor suit that has one or more red rhombuses on it
zh: n. 钻石, 菱形
examples: This may not be a real diamond.
The diamond was set in a gold ring.
exampleZh: 这可能不是真的钻石。
钻石被镶在一个金戒指上。

defsEn: a. operating with minimal human intervention
independent of external control
s. resembling the unthinking functioning of a machine
s. without volition or conscious control
zh: n. 自动手枪, 自动机械
a. 自动的, 机械的, 必然的, 无意识的
examples: How can I turn off automatic renewal?
The lift has an automatic door.

defsEn: n. a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal
v. transport something in a cart
zh: n. 二轮运货马车
vi. 驾运货马车
vt. 用车装载
examples: A horse pulled the cart along the road.
Don't put the cart before the horse.
exampleZh: 一匹马拉着大车沿着大路走。
不要把本末倒置。

defsEn: n. a person who is older than you are
n. any of numerous shrubs or small trees of temperate and subtropical northern hemisphere having white flowers and berrylike fruit
n. any of various church officers
s. used of the older of two persons of the same name especially used to distinguish a father from his son
zh: n. 年长者, 老人, 前辈
a. 年长的, 资深的
examples: He is less clever than his elder brother.
His elder sister is older than my eldest brother.
exampleZh: 他没他哥哥聪明。
他姐姐比我哥哥大。

defsEn: n. an adequate or large amount
n. the concept that something has a magnitude and can be represented in mathematical expressions by a constant or a variable
zh: n. 量, 数量, 总量
examples: However, the quantity was not correct.
A large quantity of air-conditioners has been sold since the temperature is high.
exampleZh: 但是，数量不对。
因为气温很高，有大量空调售出。

defsEn: n. the Hellenic branch of the Indo-European family of languages
n. a native or inhabitant of Greece
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Greece or the Greeks or the Greek language
zh: n. 希腊人, 希腊语
a. 希腊的, 希腊人的
examples: That was all Greek to me.
It is all Greek to me.
exampleZh: 我完全看不懂。
看起来像天书。

defsEn: n. someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality
n. exceptional creative ability
zh: n. 天才, 天赋, 精神, 神魔
examples: He is not so much a genius as a hard worker.
He thought that he was a genius.
exampleZh: 他很勤奋但不是很有天赋。
他认为他是个天才。

defsEn: n. an important site that is marked and preserved as public property
zh: n. 纪念碑, 纪念物, 石碑
examples: If you seek his monument, look around.
There is a monument in the center of the city.

defsEn: n. a request (spoken or written) to participate or be present or take part in something
n. a tempting allurement
zh: n. 邀请, 请柬, 引诱
examples: If I were free, I would accept your invitation.
He did not accept their invitation.
exampleZh: 如果我当时有空，我一定会应邀的。
他没有接受他们的邀请。

defsEn: n. the quality of being near to the true value
n. (mathematics) the number of significant figures given in a number
zh: n. 精确, 正确
examples: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
Check up on the accuracy of this article.
exampleZh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。

defsEn: n. the quality of being loyal
n. feelings of allegiance
zh: n. 忠贞, 忠诚, 忠实
examples: How dare you question my loyalty!
Do you value loyalty above all?

defsEn: n. a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons (hexane and heptane and octane etc.) derived from petroleum
used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines
zh: n. 汽油
examples: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
The gasoline spread all over the floor.
exampleZh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。

defsEn: n. an ordinary man
s. not moving or operating freely
s. powerful
r. extremely
zh: a. 坚硬的, 严厉的, 呆板的, 生硬的, 刚强的, 强烈的, 粘的, 稠的, 艰难的
n. 死尸, 醉鬼, 钞票
vt. 不肯付...小费
examples: I think it would bore me stiff.
I have a bad stiff neck.

defsEn: n. the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth
n. the bones of the skull that frame the mouth and serve to open it
the bones that hold the teeth
n. holding device consisting of one or both of the opposing parts of a tool that close to hold an object
zh: n. 颚, 颌
v. 闲谈, 教训, 唠叨
examples: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
Ziri found the jaw bone of a human being.
exampleZh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。

defsEn: s. having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence
beyond ordinary understanding
zh: a. 神秘的, 难解的, 不可思议的
examples: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
This place has a mysterious atmosphere.
exampleZh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。
这个地方有一种神秘的气氛。

defsEn: n. a knot with two loops and loose ends
used to tie shoelaces
n. a slightly curved piece of resilient wood with taut horsehair strands
used in playing certain stringed instruments
n. front part of a vessel or aircraft
n. a weapon for shooting arrows, composed of a curved piece of resilient wood with a taut cord to propel the arrow
zh: n. 弓, 眼睛框
v. 用弓拉琴, 弯成弓形
n. 鞠躬, 屈服
examples: I walked up to her, bowed, and kissed her hand.
No one respectfully bowed towards him.
exampleZh: 我走到她身旁，鞠了个躬，亲吻她的手。
没有人向他恭敬地鞠躬。

defsEn: n. a hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)
n. an impracticable and illusory idea
n. a dome-shaped covering made of transparent glass or plastic
v. form, produce, or emit bubbles
zh: n. 泡沫
vi. 冒泡, 沸腾
vt. 使冒泡, 滔滔不绝地说
examples: Would you treat me to bubble tea later?
The bubble burst in the air.

defsEn: n. a cutting or thrusting weapon that has a long metal blade and a hilt with a hand guard
zh: n. 刀, 剑, 战争, 武力, 剑状物
examples: This sword has a strange history.
A woman's tongue is her sword.
exampleZh: 此剑际遇不凡。
女人的舌头是她的剑。

defsEn: n. an outlying farm building for storing grain or animal feed and housing farm animals
n. (physics) a unit of nuclear cross section
the effective circular area that one particle presents to another as a target for an encounter
zh: n. 谷仓
examples: When the heater in the barn fails, you get milk-flavoured ice cubes.
Get out of the bitter barn and play in the hay.
exampleZh: 当牛舍的暖气坏了, 你就会有牛奶味的冰块。

defsEn: v. become more focus on an area of activity or field of study
v. suit to a special purpose
v. devote oneself to a special area of work
zh: vt. 使特殊化, 列举, 特别指明, 限定...的范围
vi. 成为专家, 专攻
examples: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
She will specialize in American history.
exampleZh: 这家出版社专门出版儿童文学。

defsEn: n. a natural object that resembles or suggests a carpet
v. form a carpet-like cover (over)
v. cover completely, as if with a carpet
v. cover with a carpet
zh: n. 地毯, 地毯状物
vt. 铺以地毯, 铺盖
examples: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
White carpets are very hard to keep clean.
exampleZh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
白色的地毡很难保持干净。

defsEn: n. a state of high honor
n. brilliant radiant beauty
v. rejoice proudly
zh: n. 光荣, 荣耀, 荣誉, 壮丽, 繁荣
vi. 自豪
examples: His acts of courage brought him glory.
The religion was in its glory in those days.
exampleZh: 他英勇的行为带给了他光荣。
这个宗教当时处于全盛时期。

defsEn: a. intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind
s. showing care
s. (usually followed by `of') solicitously caring or mindful
zh: a. 给予保护的, 保护的
examples: This salve will act as a protective film over the burn.
When did Operation Protective Edge take place?

defsEn: n. eatables (especially sweets)
n. (sports) a bodily position adopted in some sports (such as diving or skiing) in which the knees are bent and the thighs are drawn close to the chest
n. a narrow flattened pleat or fold that is stitched in place
v. fit snugly into
zh: n. 缝褶, 活力, 鼓声, 船尾突出部, 食品
vt. 打褶, 卷起, 挤进, 塞, 收藏
vi. 缝褶裥, 缩拢
examples: Tuck the sheet under the edge of the mat.
I tuck my children into bed every night.

defsEn: n. a musical percussion instrument
usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end
n. the sound of a drum
n. a cylindrical metal container used for shipping or storage of liquids
n. small to medium-sized bottom-dwelling food and game fishes of shallow coastal and fresh waters that make a drumming noise
zh: n. 鼓, 鼓声
vi. 击鼓, 作鼓声
vt. 打鼓奏出
examples: I sent this drum to my father.
Jim likes to play the drum.
exampleZh: 我送了个长鼓给我父亲。
吉姆喜欢打鼓。

defsEn: n. a spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain
v. pass out from weakness, physical or emotional distress due to a loss of blood supply to the brain
s. deficient in magnitude
barely perceptible
lacking clarity or brightness or loudness etc
s. lacking strength or vigor
zh: n. 昏厥, 昏倒
a. 模糊的, 微弱的, 无力的
vi. 昏倒, 变得微弱
examples: Faint heart never won fair lady.
She fainted when she saw blood.
exampleZh: 懦夫难赢美女心。
她看见血就晕了。

defsEn: n. the compass point midway between north and east
at 45 degrees
n. the northeastern region of the United States
n. the direction corresponding to the northeastward compass point
zh: n. 东北
a. 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的
adv. 向东北, 来自东北
examples: He lives in the northeast of the country.
I live in the northeast of Brazil.

defsEn: v. make shallow
v. become shallow
a. lacking physical depth
having little spatial extension downward or inward from an outer surface or backward or outward from a center
a. not deep or strong
not affecting one deeply
zh: n. 水浅的地方, 浅滩
a. 浅的, 肤浅的
v. (使)变浅
examples: Between you and me, he has a shallow way of thinking.
Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.
exampleZh: 他思考的方式缺乏深度，这个我们知道就好。
他思想肤浅，这个我们知道就好。

defsEn: n. a businessperson engaged in retail trade
zh: n. 商人, 店主
a. 商业的, 商人的
examples: Merchants only look at the profits.
One night a merchant was walking up the slope on his way home.
exampleZh: 商人们只看中利益。

defsEn: n. a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments
zh: n. 露天大型运动场
examples: Last night I went to the stadium.
The stadium is adjacent to the school.
exampleZh: 昨晚我去了体育场。
体育场毗邻学校。

defsEn: n. a structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young
n. a kind of gun emplacement
n. a cosy or secluded retreat
n. a gang of people (criminals or spies or terrorists) assembled in one locality
zh: n. 巢, 窝, 休息所, 隐匿处
vi. 筑巢, 找鸟巢
vt. 为...设窝, 使套叠
examples: Apparently, they nest in a tree in front of the house.
Little by little, the bird made his nest.
exampleZh: 很明显的，牠们在房前的树上筑巢。
鸟一点一点地筑巢。

defsEn: n. white goods in which food can be stored at low temperatures
zh: n. 电冰箱, 冷藏库
examples: I have to repair the refrigerator.
There's nothing in the refrigerator except milk.
exampleZh: 我要修冰箱。
冰箱里只有牛奶哦。

defsEn: n. a narrow way or road
n. a well-defined track or path
for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
zh: n. 小路, 巷, 弄, 单行道
examples: Are there any bike lanes in Algiers?
From our lane to the market is a long distance.
exampleZh: 阿尔及尔有自行车道吗？

defsEn: n. distinctive manner of oral expression
n. a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation
zh: n. 重音, 口音, 特点, 注重点
vt. 重读, 加重音号于, 强调
examples: Do you speak with an accent?
The accent in "guitar" falls on the second syllable.
exampleZh: 你说话带口音吗？
「Guitar」一字的重音在第二音节。

examples: I used to keep a diary when I was at high school.
I used to keep a diary every day when I was young.
exampleZh: 我上中学的时候有写日记的习惯。
我小时候每天都写日记。

defsEn: n. a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle
used to stir or serve or take up food

n. formerly a golfing wood with an elevated face

vt. 以匙舀起, 调情, 使成匙状
examples: I'd like to have a spoon.
The baby cannot use a spoon yet.
exampleZh: 我想要一把汤匙。
宝宝还不会使用勺子。

defsEn: n. the location of something surrounded by other things
zh: n. 中间
prep. 在...中间
examples: Algeria is in the midst of a political crisis.
Algeria is in the midst of an economic crisis.
exampleZh: 阿尔及利亚正处于政治危机中。
阿尔及利亚正处于经济危机中。

defsEn: n. a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats
n. money offered as a bribe
n. street names for gamma hydroxybutyrate
v. rub soap all over, usually with the purpose of cleaning

vt. 以肥皂洗, 阿谀
examples: They wash their hands with soap.
This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
exampleZh: 他们用肥皂洗手。
这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。

defsEn: n. the contestant you hope to defeat
v. be the rival of, be in competition with
zh: n. 对手, 竞争者
a. 竞争的
examples: He was hired away by a rival company.
My rival I embrace, only but to choke him.
exampleZh: 他被竞争公司挖去了。

defsEn: n. a piece of jewelry that is pinned onto the wearer's garment
n. informal terms for the leg
n. cylindrical tumblers consisting of two parts that are held in place by springs
when they are aligned with a key the bolt can be thrown
n. flagpole used to mark the position of the hole on a golf green
zh: n. 大头针, 针, 别针, 栓, 销子, 图钉, 插头, 管脚, 品(液量单位)
vt. 将...用针别住, 钉住, 压住, 牵制, 使不能动, 归罪于
a. 针的, 销子的, 闩的
examples: He pinned the badge on his vest.
She pines for the days of her youth.
exampleZh: 他把徽章别在马甲上。
她怀念自己的青春岁月。

defsEn: n. (boxing) a blow with the fist
n. an iced mixed drink usually containing alcohol and prepared for multiple servings
normally served in a punch bowl
n. a tool for making holes or indentations
v. deliver a quick blow to
zh: n. 打洞器, 钻孔机, 冲压机, 冲床, 潘趣酒
vt. 以拳重击, 开洞, 冲压
vi. 用拳猛击
examples: A punch is just a punch. A kick is just a kick.
You make me want to punch you in the face.
exampleZh: 出拳就是出拳。出脚就是出脚。

defsEn: n. five-toed pachyderm
n. the symbol of the Republican Party
introduced in cartoons by Thomas Nast in 1874
zh: n. 象
examples: Have you ever seen an elephant fly?
Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
exampleZh: 你看过大象飞吗？
没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

defsEn: n. an outbuilding with a single story
used for shelter or storage
v. get rid of
v. cast off hair, skin, horn, or feathers
zh: n. 车棚, 小屋, 脱落之物, 分水岭
vt. 使流出, 放射, 脱落, 散发, 摆脱
vi. 流出, 散布, 脱落
examples: You need to shed some pounds.
Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
exampleZh: 你需要甩掉几磅。
没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

defsEn: n. a sum of money spoken of as the contents of a money purse
n. a small bag for carrying money
n. a sum of money offered as a prize
v. contract one's lips into a rounded shape
zh: n. 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物
v. 缩拢, 皱起
examples: She found her purse under the desk.
It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
exampleZh: 她发现她的钱包在桌子底下。
我突然想起钱包好像放在家中，忘了带了。

defsEn: r. (sentence connectors) because of the reason given
r. as a consequence
zh: adv. 所以
examples: She said she was tired and consequently would go home so early.
Consequently, people prefer not to live in the centre because it's simply not convenient.

defsEn: n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
v. ride a bicycle
zh: n. 自行车
examples: I could not afford to buy a bicycle.
Please move your bicycle out of here.
exampleZh: 我买不起自行车。
请将您的自行车移出这里。

defsEn: n. device that removes something from whatever passes through it
n. an electrical device that alters the frequency spectrum of signals passing through it
v. remove by passing through a filter
zh: n. 滤波器, 过滤器, 滤光器, 过滤嘴, 去尘器
vt. 过滤, 渗透, 走漏
vi. 滤过, 渗入
examples: He has no filter for what he says.
How do you change the filter?
exampleZh: 他说话很没分寸。

defsEn: n. a rise in the temperature of the body
frequently a symptom of infection
n. intense nervous anticipation
zh: n. 发烧, 发热, 热病
examples: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
I think you have a fever.
exampleZh: 你发烧和喉咙痛吗?
我觉得你发烧了。

defsEn: n. any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails
some domesticated and raised for pets or food
n. flesh of any of various rabbits or hares (wild or domesticated) eaten as food
v. hunt rabbits
zh: n. 兔子
vi. 猎兔
vt. 让...见鬼去
examples: It's difficult to catch a rabbit by hand.
It is difficult to catch a rabbit by hand.
exampleZh: 徒手逮兔挺难。
徒手逮兔挺难。

defsEn: n. a flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money
v. make up
zh: n. 硬币, 金钱, 货币
vt. 铸币, 创造, 杜撰
examples: The value of a coin depends on the weight of the metal used.
He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
exampleZh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
他偶然在古董店里发现了这个旧硬币。

defsEn: r. in part
in some degree
not wholly
zh: adv. 部分地, 一部分地, 不公平地
examples: I feel partially responsible for that.
I partially understand what he means.

defsEn: n. the part of a building above the ground floor
a. on or of upper floors of a building
r. on a floor above
r. with respect to the mind
zh: a. 楼上的
adv. 在楼上, 向楼上, 处于更高地位
n. 楼层
examples: Go upstairs and bring down my trunk.
Would you carry my luggage upstairs?
exampleZh: 上楼把我的旅行箱拿下来。
你可以把我的行李拿到楼上吗?

defsEn: a. having the same or similar characteristics
r. equally
r. in a like manner
zh: a. 相似的, 同样的
adv. 一样, 以同样的方式
examples: They look alike except for the color of their hair.
They all look alike to me.

defsEn: n. a quick throw
v. start suddenly, as from fright
v. throw quickly
s. short
zh: n. 惊跳, 惊避
a. 胆怯的, 畏缩的, 迟疑的, 羞怯的
vi. 惊退, 乱投, 乱掷, 厌恶, 避开
vt. 乱投, 乱掷
examples: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
I was too shy to look her in the face.
exampleZh: 她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。
我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。

defsEn: n. twelve dozen
n. the entire amount of income before any deductions are made
v. earn before taxes, expenses, etc.
a. before any deductions
zh: n. 总数, 总量
a. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的
vt. 总共收入
examples: I feel gross on the inside.
Gross National Product is not the same as Net National Product.

defsEn: n. a wilderness at the edge of a settled area of a country
n. an international boundary or the area (often fortified) immediately inside the boundary
n. an undeveloped field of study
a topic inviting research and development
zh: n. 边界, 边境
examples: Frontier justice is a rough, arbitrary justice driven by necessity rather than legal procedure.
Where the frontier of science once was is now the centre.

defsEn: n. a pesticide in suspension or solution
intended for spraying
n. a quantity of small objects flying through the air
n. flower arrangement consisting of a single branch or shoot bearing flowers and foliage
n. water in small drops in the atmosphere
blown from waves or thrown up by a waterfall
zh: n. 水沫, 浪花, 水花, 喷雾, 喷雾器, 小树枝
vt. 喷雾, 扫射, 喷射
vi. 喷, 溅开
examples: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
We must spray them with cold water.
exampleZh: 玛丽的包里有辣椒喷雾。

defsEn: v. disclose to view as by removing a cover
zh: vt. 揭露, 透露
examples: You ought not to have disclosed the secret.
We do not disclose the situation.
exampleZh: 你本不该透露秘密的。

defsEn: n. a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda
n. a small compact portable computer
zh: n. 笔记本, 手册, 期票簿
examples: I have a separate notebook for each class.
Put your name on the notebook in case you forget it.
exampleZh: 每堂课我都分别有一本笔记。
在笔记本上写上你的名字吧，这样就不怕弄不见了。

zh: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性
examples: You filthy beast, get out of here!
The lion is the king of the beasts.
exampleZh: 你这个畜牲，给我滚开！
狮子是百兽之王。

defsEn: n. the line that appears to bound an object
n. a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory
n. a schematic or preliminary plan

vt. 描画轮廓, 描述要点
n. 大纲, 分级, 轮廓
examples: I need to trace the outline.
This document outlined the structure and purpose of the organization.

defsEn: n. a branch of an umbel or an umbelliform inflorescence
n. (mathematics) a straight line extending from a point

most swim by moving the pectoral fins

vi. 射出光线, 浮现, 放射光线
vt. 放射, 显出
examples: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.
The X-ray showed two broken fingers.
exampleZh: 医生用X光检查我的胃。
X光片显示两根手指断了。

defsEn: v. make visible
v. remove all or part of one's clothes to show one's body

We need to uncover her secret life.

father of John Stuart Mill (1773-1836)

usually arranged systematically

v. necessitate or exact

exampleZh: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。
因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

Right at that instant, the bus stopped.

of titles

She's a professor whose works you could stack up to head height.
exampleZh: 喂，请问现在能给我马上送一叠稿子吗？
那位是一个著作等身的教授。

It's time to hit the sack.

睡觉时间到了。

exampleZh: 雅马哈先生在客厅里的大托盘里装满了核桃。

v. receive from a predecessor
v. receive by genetic transmission

That textbook is out of date.
exampleZh: 这本教科书对我来说太深了。
这本教科书不合时了。

n. a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand

exampleZh: 她每次看见我都给露出厌恶的眼神。

All those dots are viral focuses.

这些点都是病毒集中的地方。

exampleZh: 疾病使他一天比一天虚弱。

n. the domain ruled by a king or queen
n. a monarchy with a king or queen as head of state
zh: n. 王国, 领域

Kingdom Phylum Class Order Family Genus Species.
exampleZh: 伦敦是英国的首都。

defsEn: r without any others being included or involved

defsEn: a. not fair
marked by injustice or partiality or deception
zh: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的
examples: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
He was unfair when he said that word about him.

exampleZh: 她不自豪她所有的优点。

v. give a reduction in price on

vi. 贴现

Can you give me a discount?

能给我打个折么？

examples: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
The lion is the king of the jungle.

狮子是丛林之王。

examples: Japan has a high population density.

exampleZh: 日本的人口密度很高。

zh: vt. 分类, 归类, 分等
examples: We should classify them before throwing them out.

我感觉像羽毛一样轻飘。
