n. tasty mixture or liquid into which bite-sized foods are dipped
n. a brief immersion
zh: v. 浸, 降下, 把(手、勺等)伸入, 舀取
n. 浸, 涉猎
examples: He dipped his spoon into the soup.
Dip into it and the piranhas will eat you.
exampleZh: 他把他的汤匙浸入汤里。

defsEn: n. speaking of yourself in superlatives
v. show off
zh: n. 吹牛
vi. 吹牛, 自夸
vt. 夸口说, 自恃有
examples: She always boasts of being a good swimmer.
He boasted of having won the first prize.
exampleZh: 她老是吹嘘自己是个游泳健将。
他赢了冠军就自吹自擂了起来。

defsEn: n. the sound made by a gentle blow
s. exactly suited to the occasion
r. completely or perfectly
zh: n. 轻拍
v. 轻拍
adv. 适时, 正好, 恰好, 毫不迟疑, 熟记地
a. 恰好的, 合适的, 熟练的, 坚定的, 人为的
examples: She patted her son on the shoulder.
She patted her hair into place.
exampleZh: 她拍拍她儿子的肩膀。
她把头发拍整齐了。

defsEn: r. restricted to something
r. in a stringent manner
zh: adv. 严格地, 确实地
examples: My relationship with him is strictly professional.
What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.
exampleZh: 我与他之间只有纯粹的工作关系。
我要说的只能是你知我知。

defsEn: n. any plant that crowds out cultivated plants
n. a black band worn by a man (on the arm or hat) as a sign of mourning
v. clear of weeds
zh: n. 杂草, 野草
vi. 除草
vt. 除...的草, 剔除
examples: We have to pull the weeds.
Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?
exampleZh: 我们必须拔除杂草。
你可不可以帮忙除草浇花？

defsEn: s. being or affecting only a part
not total
a. showing favoritism
zh: a. 部分的, 偏袒的, 偏爱的
n. 分音
examples: Departure is a partial death but death in essence is not only departure.
It was only a partial success.
exampleZh: 离开是部分的死亡，而死亡不仅仅是离开。
那只是部分的成功。

defsEn: n. a band that fits around the neck and is usually folded over
n. (zoology) an encircling band or marking around the neck of any animal
n. anything worn or placed about the neck
n. a short ring fastened over a rod or shaft to limit, guide, or secure a machine part
zh: n. 衣领, 颈圈
vt. 控制, 扭住衣领, 给...装上领子
examples: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
I need to by a new collar for my dog.
exampleZh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

defsEn: n. a brief or incomplete view
n. a vague indication
v. catch a glimpse of or see briefly
zh: n. 一瞥, 一闪
vi. 投以一瞥, 闪烁不定
vt. 瞥见
examples: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
You get a glimpse of the plain from this window.
exampleZh: 我从火车车窗瞥见了富士山。

defsEn: n. any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)
zh: n. 猴子, 猿, 打桩锤
vi. 淘气, 胡闹
vt. 嘲弄
examples: The monkey fell from the tree.
It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
exampleZh: 猴子从树上掉了下来。
对猴子来说，爬树很容易。

defsEn: n someone who listens attentively
zh: n. 收听者, 听众
examples: Be a good listener and pay attention.
I want to be a good listener.

defsEn: s. beyond normal limits
s. unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
zh: a. 过度的, 过多的, 极端的
examples: Excessive use of the Internet is not a medical or psychiatric issue.
Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
exampleZh: 过于上网不是跟医学或精神病有关的事情。
选择太多导致无法选择。

defsEn: v. move deeply
v. damage as if by shaking or jarring
zh: vt. 扰乱, 妨碍, 使不安
examples: I will try not to disturb you while you are studying.
I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
exampleZh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
我会尽量不打扰你复习。

defsEn: n. the part of a garment that is attached at the armhole and that provides a cloth covering for the arm
n. small case into which an object fits
zh: n. 袖子, 套管
vt. 缝上袖子
examples: Long-sleeved shirts are good for cold weather.
You're wearing short sleeves... aren't you cold?
exampleZh: 长袖比较适合冷的天气。
你穿短袖不冷吗?

defsEn: n. support resembling the rib of an animal
n. any of the 12 pairs of curved arches of bone extending from the spine to or toward the sternum in humans (and similar bones in most vertebrates)
n. cut of meat including one or more ribs
n. a teasing remark
zh: n. 肋骨, 肋状物, 笑话
vt. 装肋状物于, 戏弄
examples: I'll have the prime rib dinner.
Our neighbor has broken a rib.

defsEn: a. capable of or reflecting the capability for correct and valid reasoning
zh: a. 合乎逻辑的, 合理的
examples: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
It would be very logical to do that.
exampleZh: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。

defsEn: n. the practice of owning slaves
n. work done under harsh conditions for little or no pay
zh: n. 奴隶的身分, 奴隶状态, 奴隶制度
examples: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
Do not yield to the slavery of pleasure.
exampleZh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

defsEn: n. a long thin implement made of metal or wood
n. any rod-shaped bacterium
n. a visual receptor cell that is sensitive to dim light
zh: n. 竿, 笞鞭, 小枝
examples: Fortune is the rod of the weak, and the staff of the brave.
He knows how to fish with a fishing rod.

defsEn: n. a piece of material ready to be made into something
n. a cartridge containing an explosive charge but no bullet
v. keep the opposing (baseball) team from winning
s. (of a surface) not written or printed on
zh: n. 空格, 空白
a. 空白的, 空虚的, 完全的, 无色的
vi. 消失, 成为空白
vt. 使无效, 取消, 封锁
examples: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
He asked me point-blank to help him.
exampleZh: 请在空格上填上适当的字词。

defsEn: a. in or associated with the process of passing from life or ceasing to be
zh: a. 垂死的
examples: I'm dying for a cold drink.
I am dying for a cold drink.
exampleZh: 我迫切需要冷饮。
我迫切需要冷饮。

defsEn: n. a person who has died and has been declared a saint by canonization
n. person of exceptional holiness
zh: n. 圣徒, 圣人
a. 神圣的
examples: Pray to God and not to His saint.
You have the patience of a saint.

defsEn: n. the quality of being the same in quantity or measure or value or status
n. a state of being essentially equal or equivalent
equally balanced
zh: n. 平等, 均匀, 相等
examples: The love of democracy is that of equality.
He was in favor of equality for all.
exampleZh: 爱民主就是爱平等。

defsEn: r with intention
in an intentional manner
r in a deliberate unhurried manner
zh: adv. 故意地
examples: He deliberately exposed her to danger.
She deliberately folded her arms across her chest.
exampleZh: 他故意令她陷入险境。

defsEn: n. the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
n. favorable public reputation
zh: n. 名望, 名声, 传说
examples: He entered the hall of fame.
Above all, fame means dying at the right time.
exampleZh: 他进入了名人堂。

defsEn: n. the probability of a specified outcome
zh: n. 可能, 可能性
examples: In all likelihood, this means war.
In all likelihood, the president will serve a second term.
exampleZh: 这很可能意味着战争。

defsEn: n. deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant
n. perennial plant widely cultivated as an annual in many varieties for its long conical orange edible roots
temperate and tropical regions
n. orange root
important source of carotene
n. promise of reward as in "carrot and stick"
zh: n. 胡萝卜
examples: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.
How much do the carrots cost?
exampleZh: 胡萝卜中含有大量的维生素A。
胡萝卜多少钱？

defsEn: s openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
s not as expected
zh: a. 可疑的, 多疑的, 怀疑的
examples: The police are suspicious of my alibi.
The police were suspicious of his movements.
exampleZh: 警察觉得我的不在场证明可疑。
警察对他的行踪感到怀疑。

defsEn: n. a steep and rapid fall
v. dash violently or with great speed or impetuosity
v. begin with vigor
v. cause to be immersed
zh: n. 钻进, 跳进, 跳水, 跳水池, 猛跌, 落下, 投入, 开始从事, 盲目投资
vi. 投入, 投身于, 跳进, 陷入, 下降
vt. 使投入, 使插入, 使陷入, 使遭受
examples: Stock prices plunged to a record low.
He plunged into the lake fully clothed.
exampleZh: 股票价格跌至历史新低。
他连衣服也没有脱就跳进了湖里。

defsEn: n. a shelter from danger or hardship
zh: n. 避难所, 安全地带, 避难, 庇护
vi. 躲避
vt. 给予...庇护
examples: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.
Refugees poured in from all over the country.
exampleZh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
难民从整个国家涌来。

defsEn: n. coldness due to a cold environment
n. a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever
n. a sudden numbing dread
v. depress or discourage
zh: n. 寒冷, 寒意, 失意
a. 寒冷的, 冷漠的
vt. 使寒心, 冷冻
vi. 变冷
examples: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
He was chilled to the bone.
exampleZh: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。
他感到寒气刺骨。

defsEn: v. direct the course
determine the direction of travelling
v. direct (oneself) somewhere
zh: vt. 引导, 驾驶, 航行, 控制
vi. 驾驶, 掌舵, 行驶
n. 驾驶指示, 劝告
examples: Japanese cars' steering wheels are on the right.
You must steer clear of that gang.
exampleZh: 日本车的方向盘在右边。

defsEn: n a place of business for retailing goods
n receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices
n an opening that permits escape or release
n activity that frees or expresses creative energy or emotion
zh: n. 出口, 发泄方法, 市场
examples: Where can I find an outlet for all my anger?
If you need an outlet, I will always be there to listen.

defsEn: v. make steady progress
be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance
zh: vi. 繁荣, 兴旺, 茁壮成长
examples: He that will thrive must ask leave of his wife.
You deserve to thrive in your career.
exampleZh: 会成功的男人必须请求妻子让他离开出外打拼。

defsEn: v. add details, as to an account or idea
clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
v. produce from basic elements or sources
change into a more developed product
v. work out in detail
s. marked by complexity and richness of detail
zh: a. 精细的, 详尽的, 精心计划(或制作)的
vt. 详细地说明, 用心地制作, 发挥
vi. 变复杂, 作详细说明
examples: The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.
She made elaborate preparations for the party.
exampleZh: 报告者详尽地说明了他的研究方法。
她精心筹备了这个派对。

defsEn: n. a wad of something chewable as tobacco
n. biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow
v. chew (food)
to bite and grind with the teeth
zh: vt. 咀嚼, 嚼碎
vi. 咀嚼, 细想
n. 咀嚼, 咀嚼物
examples: It is hard for me to chew.
Food should be chewed before being swallowed.
exampleZh: 我不太能嚼东西。
食物在吞咽前要经过咀嚼。

defsEn: n. the exultation of victory
zh: n. 凯旋, 胜利, 欢欣
vi. 得胜, 成功
examples: It is said that truth always triumphs.
The second marriage is the triumph of hope over experience.
exampleZh: 有人说，真理必胜。

defsEn: a. able to be compared or worthy of comparison
s. conforming in every respect
zh: a. 可比较的, 比得上的
examples: As you know, life is comparable to a voyage.
A comparable car would cost far more in Japan.

defsEn: n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions
n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct
n. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral
zh: n. 良心
examples: His conscience suddenly awoke in him.
I could not do this with an easy conscience.
exampleZh: 他突然良心发现。

defsEn: n. the procedure of calculating
determining something by mathematical or logical methods
n. problem solving that involves numbers or quantities
n. planning something carefully and intentionally
zh: n. 计算, 考虑, 计算的结果
examples: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.
exampleZh: 根据我的估计，她现在应该在印度了。
算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。

defsEn: n. a competitor who has withdrawn from competition
n. (golf) a handicap of zero strokes
n. an indication of damage
v. cut the surface of
wear away the surface of
zh: n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦伤, 刮擦声, 乱写, 零分, 起跑线
vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉
vi. 搔, 抓, 发刮擦声, 勉强糊口
a. 碰巧的, 凑合的, 打草稿用的
examples: I asked him if he would scratch my back.
The cat will scratch you if you provoke it.

defsEn: n. transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services)
n. social exchange, especially of opinions, attitudes, etc.
zh: n. 商业, 商务, 贸易
examples: Osaka is the center of commerce in Japan.
I'm out for commerce, not conquest!
exampleZh: 大坂是日本的商业中心。

defsEn: n. a movable top or cover (hinged or separate) for closing the opening at the top of a box, chest, jar, pan, etc.
zh: n. 盖子, 限制, 眼睑
vt. 给...盖盖子
examples: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
I just opened the lid, and a foul smell filled my nose.
exampleZh: 生产日期在盖子上。
我刚打开锅盖，一股恶臭就扑鼻而来。

defsEn: s. lacking the power of human speech
s. unable to speak because of hereditary deafness
zh: a. 哑的, 不说话的, 无声音的
examples: The world is full of dumb people.
She was blind, deaf, and dumb.
exampleZh: 世界上都是白痴。
她又盲又聋又哑。

defsEn: n. the act of sprinkling or splashing water
v. cause (a liquid) to spatter about, especially with force
v. rain gently
v. scatter with liquid
wet lightly
zh: vt. 洒, 散置, 撒, 点缀
vi. 洒, 撒, 下小雨
n. 洒, 撒, 散置, 小雨, 少量
examples: The stage was sprinkled with flower petals.
Sprinkle plenty of flour on to the work surface.
exampleZh: 舞台上撒了花瓣。

defsEn: n. an event that results in a transformation
n. a change in the units or form of an expression: "conversion from Fahrenheit to Centigrade"
n. a successful free throw or try for point after a touchdown
n. a spiritual enlightenment causing a person to lead a new life
zh: n. 转变, 转换, 改变宗教信仰, 换位法
examples: Sami's conversion to Islam was a life-changing thing.
How would people react to his conversion to Islam?
exampleZh: 萨米皈依伊斯兰教对他的人生产生了深远的影响。

defsEn: n. large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity
secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat
synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood
synthesizes vitamin A
detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes
n. liver of an animal used as meat
n. a person who has a special life style
n. someone who lives in a place
zh: n. 肝脏, 生活者, 居民
examples: I have a corner in my liver just for you, alcohol.
Would it kill you to give me your liver?
exampleZh: 我在肝里给你留了个地方，酒精啊。

defsEn: n. compatibility in opinion and action
n. the structure of music with respect to the composition and progression of chords
n. a harmonious state of things in general and of their properties (as of colors and sounds)
congruity of parts with one another and with the whole
n. agreement of opinions
zh: n. 协调, 和睦, 调和
examples: Together, you represent the harmony between tradition and progress.
Harmony in the family leads to success in everything.
exampleZh: 你们共同代表着传统与进步之间的和谐。
家和万事兴。

defsEn: n. the power or capacity of an organism to tolerate unfavorable environmental conditions
n. the act of tolerating something
n. willingness to recognize and respect the beliefs or practices of others
zh: n. 宽容, 忍受, 容忍, 容许量, 公差
examples: I have a low tolerance for pain.
In the name of tolerance, we should reserve the right not to tolerate intolerance.

defsEn: r without any others being included or involved
zh: adv. 仅仅, 单独地
examples: Victory and defeat aren't solely decided by the size of your army.
One cannot live solely on air and love.
exampleZh: 胜败不能单靠兵力多少。

defsEn: n. any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns
zh: n. 山羊, 替罪羊, 色鬼
examples: Mr. Goat Butt never told me there would be a partner.
The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
exampleZh: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。
马克卖的羊奶在当地人中很受欢迎。

defsEn: n. a country person
n. one of a (chiefly European) class of agricultural laborers
n. a crude uncouth ill-bred person lacking culture or refinement
zh: n. 农夫, 乡下人
examples: As usual the peasants are busy scattering grain seeds.
The peasant will come back soon.
exampleZh: 农民们如常在忙着播种。

defsEn: s. clean or organized
s. showing care in execution
s. free from what is tawdry or unbecoming
s. without water
zh: a. 整洁的, 巧妙的, 匀称的, 简洁的
n. 牛
examples: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.
He took a drink of whiskey neat.
exampleZh: 房间的角落里整整齐齐地放着一叠书。
他喝了一杯纯威士忌酒。

defsEn: n. a river in southwestern Alabama
flows into Mobile Bay
n. a port in southwestern Alabama on Mobile Bay
n. sculpture suspended in midair whose delicately balanced parts can be set in motion by air currents
s. migratory
zh: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的
n. 活动物体
examples: I need to charge my mobile phone.
Do you have a mobile phone?
exampleZh: 我需要给手机充电。
您有手机吗？

defsEn: n. a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year
n. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc)
n. a tabular array of the days (usually for one year)
v. enter into a calendar
zh: n. 日历, 日程表
vt. 列入表中
examples: I hang the calendar on the wall.
She hung the calendar on the wall.
exampleZh: 我把日历挂在墙上。
她把日历挂在墙上了。

defsEn: n. the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face
n. a tuft or growth of hairs or bristles on certain plants such as iris or grasses
n. a person who diverts suspicion from someone (especially a woman who accompanies a male homosexual in order to conceal his homosexuality)
n. hairy growth on or near the face of certain mammals
zh: n. 胡须
vt. 抓住胡须, 公开反对
examples: Let us stroke our beards for a moment.
Dwarf goat's beards have a nice color.

defsEn: n. a woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried
v. cause to be without a spouse
zh: n. 寡妇, 孀妇
vt. 使成寡妇
examples: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
There's a huge black widow spider in my room!
exampleZh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

defsEn: n. the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating
n. money deposited in a bank or some similar institution
n. money given as security for an article acquired for temporary use
n. a payment given as a guarantee that an obligation will be met
zh: n. 存款, 定金, 堆积物
vt. 存放, 堆积
vi. 沉淀
examples: Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?
He deposited the prize money in the bank.
exampleZh: 先生，我要存钱，怎么存？
他把奖金存到银行了。

defsEn: n. a restraint used to slow or stop a vehicle
n. any of various ferns of the genus Pteris having pinnately compound leaves and including several popular houseplants
n. an area thickly overgrown usually with one kind of plant
n. anything that slows or hinders a process
zh: n. 刹车, 阻碍, 丛林
v. 刹车
examples: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
There's something wrong with the brakes.
exampleZh: 刹车的功能是使车停下。
刹车出了问题。

defsEn: v. command against
zh: vt. 禁止, 不准, 妨碍
examples: Who would forbid such a thing?
The Old Testament forbids eating shellfish.
exampleZh: 谁会禁止这样的事情呢？
旧约书中禁止食用贝类等有壳的水生动物。

defsEn: n. the dressed hairy coat of a mammal
n. dense coat of fine silky hairs on mammals (e.g., cat or seal or weasel)
n. a garment made of the dressed hairy coat of a mammal
zh: n. 毛皮
vt. 以毛皮制作, 使生苔, 使生水垢
vi. 生苔, 积水垢
examples: Her coat is fur on the inside.
The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
exampleZh: 他/她的大衣内衬是用皮毛做的。
那个玩具绒毛摸起来很柔软，让人感到舒适。

defsEn: n. tall coarse perennial American herb having small white flowers followed by blackish-red berries on long drooping racemes
young fleshy stems are edible
berries and root are poisonous
v. stir by poking
v. make a hole by poking
zh: n. 刺, 戳, 袋子
vt. 戳, 捅, 拨弄, 刺
vi. 戳, 刺, 捅, 搜索, 伸出, 行动散慢
examples: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
It's best if you don't poke your nose into other people's business.
exampleZh: 你的铅笔差点戳到我的眼睛了。
你最好不要插手别人的事务。

defsEn: n. the act of removing
n. dismissal from office
zh: n. 移动, 移居, 迁移, 排除, 切除
examples: Early removal of the placenta is very dangerous.
The removal of the load-bearing beam compromised the structure of the building.
exampleZh: 胎盘早剥很危险。

defsEn: n. a fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving
v. pass a thread through
v. remove facial hair by tying a fine string around it and pulling at the string
v. pass through or into
zh: n. 线, 丝, 纤维, 线索
vt. 穿线于, 穿过, 通过, 用线穿成
vi. 穿过
examples: Which is better, red thread or white thread?
I sewed the dress with silk thread.
exampleZh: 哪个更好，红线呢还是白线？
我用丝线缝了这条裙子。

defsEn: a. experiencing or marked by or causing sadness or sorrow or discontent
s. causing discomfort
zh: a. 不快乐的, 不幸的, 不适当的
examples: He is a little bit unhappy today.
The unhappy event made him put an end to himself.
exampleZh: 他今天有点不开心。
那件不幸的事故使他自杀身亡。

defsEn: n. a component of a mixture that has been separated by a fractional process
n. a small part or item forming a piece of a whole
n. the quotient of two rational numbers
zh: n. 小部分, 破片, 分数
examples: He hesitated for a fraction of a second too long.
He did it in only a fraction of a second.

defsEn: n. plant fiber used e.g. for making baskets and hats or as fodder
n. a thin paper or plastic tube used to suck liquids into the mouth
v. cover or provide with or as if with straw
s. of a pale yellow color like straw
straw-colored
zh: n. 稻草, 麦管, 吸管, 一文不值的东西, 草帽
a. 稻草的, 稻草色的, 琐碎的, 无价值的
examples: You need a lot of straw to stuff an elephant.
I wear a straw hat in summer.

defsEn: n. gases ejected from an engine as waste products
n. system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged
v. wear out completely
v. use up the whole supply of
zh: n. 排气, 排气装置, 废气
vt. 抽完, 用尽, 耗尽, 使精疲力尽
vi. 排气
examples: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.
Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.
exampleZh: 我因为时差而感到疲惫。
汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。

defsEn: n. the speech act of objecting

n. (law) a procedure whereby a party to a suit says that a particular line of questioning or a particular witness or a piece of evidence or other matter is improper and should not be continued and asks the court to rule on its impropriety or illegality
zh: n. 异议, 反对, 不喜欢, 缺点, 缺陷, 妨碍, 拒绝之理由
examples: I have no objection to your plan.
As for me, I have no objection.
exampleZh: 我不反对你的计划。
对于我，我不反对。

defsEn: n. a very long fly ball
n. an explosion (as of dynamite)
v. make a strident sound
v. use explosives on
zh: n. 一阵风, 爆炸, 枯萎病
vt. 炸, 使枯萎
vi. 炸, 猛攻, 猛烈抨击, 枯萎
examples: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
A blast of cold air swept through the house.
exampleZh: 冰冷的疾风吹到我骨子里去了。
冷空气疾风席卷整栋房子。

defsEn: v. be valid, applicable, or true
v. continue to exist
v. prove superior
v. use persuasion successfully
zh: vi. 获胜, 流行, 盛行
examples: Justice will prevail in the end.
I prevail on her to have a date with me.
exampleZh: 正义终将胜利。

defsEn: r. during or for the length of one night
r. happening in a short time or with great speed
zh: n. 前一天晚上, 一夜的逗留
a. 通宵的, 晚上的, 前夜的
adv. 在前一夜, 整夜, 昨晚一晚上
examples: I know staying up overnight is bad for the body.
Can I stay overnight at your house?
exampleZh: 我知道熬夜对身体不好。

defsEn: n. a piece broken off or cut off of something else
n. an incomplete piece
zh: n. 碎片, 破片, 片段
examples: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.
Donald went to clean up the mirror fragments.
exampleZh: 池塘里漂浮着零星的几片落叶。
唐纳德去清理镜子碎片。

defsEn: n. pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
zh: n. 头痛, 令人头痛之事
examples: I have a bit of a headache today.
I have a slight headache now.
exampleZh: 有今天有点头疼。
现在我有些许头痛。

defsEn: n. the quality of having a moderate degree of heat
zh: n. 温暖, 温情, 暖和, 激动, 生气
examples: He was bathed in the warmth of the kind light.
I miss the warmth and affection I used to feel.
exampleZh: 亲切的灯光让他的身上充满了温暖的感觉。

defsEn: n. a simple machine of the inclined-plane type consisting of a spirally threaded cylindrical rod that engages with a similarly threaded hole
n. a propeller with several angled blades that rotates to push against water or air
n. a fastener with a tapered threaded shank and a slotted head
v. turn like a screw
zh: n. 螺旋, 螺杆, 螺钉, 螺旋桨, 吝啬鬼
vt. 调节, 扭紧, 旋, 拧, 加强, 压榨, 勒索
vi. 转动, 旋, 拧
examples: I screwed up the very first note.
To loosen a screw, turn it to the left.
exampleZh: 我搞砸了第一个音符。

defsEn: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
zh: n. 大学本科生, 大学肄业生
a. 大学生的
examples: He is an undergraduate in the law department.
Undergraduate students should speak out for justice.

defsEn: s. meant or adapted for an occasion or use
zh: a. 适当的, 相配的
examples: That piece of furniture is not suitable for the living room.
It's hard to find a suitable translation.
exampleZh: 那件家具不适合摆在客厅。
很难找到合适的翻译。

defsEn: n. a tool with a sharp point and cutting edges for making holes in hard materials (usually rotating rapidly or by repeated blows)
n. similar to the mandrill but smaller and less brightly colored
n. (military) the training of soldiers to march (as in ceremonial parades) or to perform the manual of arms
v. train in the military, e.g., in the use of weapons
zh: n. 钻孔机, 钻子, 播种机, 粗斜纹布
v. 训练, 钻孔
examples: We had a fire drill yesterday.
I need a drill to install the towel rack.
exampleZh: 我们昨天进行了火警演习。

defsEn: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
zh: a. 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的
examples: How can you be so cruel?
It is cruel of him to say such things to her.
exampleZh: 你怎么能如此狠毒？
他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。

defsEn: n. any of various juicy fruit of the genus Vitis with green or purple skins
grow in clusters
n. any of numerous woody vines of genus Vitis bearing clusters of edible berries
zh: n. 葡萄, 葡萄树
examples: I'll eat two grapes and leave the rest for you.
I like grapes, but I can't eat so many.
exampleZh: 我吃两颗葡萄，剩下的留给你。
我虽然喜欢吃葡萄，但是我吃不了那么多。

defsEn: n a small house with a single story
zh: n. 小屋, 茅舍
examples: I saw a cottage in the distance.
There was a cottage on the side of the hill.
exampleZh: 我看见远处有一间小屋。
山坡上有一个茅屋。

defsEn: n. a very fine-grained soil that is plastic when moist but hard when fired
n. United States general who commanded United States forces in Europe from 1945 to 1949 and who oversaw the Berlin airlift (1897-1978)
n. United States politician responsible for the Missouri Compromise between free and slave states (1777-1852)
zh: n. 泥土, 肉体, 黏土
examples: Tom worked the clay into a vase.
You need to hit the clay pigeon.
exampleZh: 汤姆把黏土塑成了一个花瓶。

defsEn: n. the creation of something in the mind
n. a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation
n. the act of inventing
zh: n. 发明, 创作能力, 虚构的故事
examples: The invention of TV caused a drastic change in our daily life.
The computer is a recent invention.
exampleZh: 电视的发明为我们的生活模式带来了巨大的变化。
电脑是最近才发明的。

defsEn: n. the sum charged for riding in a public conveyance
n. a paying (taxi) passenger
n. the food and drink that are regularly served or consumed
v. eat well
zh: n. 费用, 旅客, 食物
vi. 进展, 进步, 经营, 过活
examples: How much is the bus fare?
What is the fare from Osaka to Akita?
exampleZh: 公车票价多少？
从大坂到秋田的车费是多少？

defsEn: n. a male member of a royal family other than the sovereign (especially the son of a sovereign)
zh: n. 王子, 亲王, 国君, 贵族, 诸侯, 有权势的大人物
examples: Prince Charles will be the next British king.
The prince fell in love with a woodcutter's daughter.
exampleZh: 查尔斯王子将会是下一任英国国王。
王子爱上了一个樵夫的女儿。

defsEn: n. a facial expression of dislike or displeasure
v. look angry or sullen, wrinkle one's forehead, as if to signal disapproval
zh: n. 皱眉
vi. 皱眉头
vt. 皱眉表示
examples: My friend frowned as she read the letter.
The boss seemed to frown on my method.

defsEn: n. (military) withdrawal of troops to a more favorable position to escape the enemy's superior forces or after a defeat
n. a place of privacy
a place affording peace and quiet
n. (military) a signal to begin a withdrawal from a dangerous position
n. (military) a bugle call signaling the lowering of the flag at sunset
zh: n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隐居, 退避
vi. 撤退, 隐退, 向后倾
vt. 退(棋)
examples: They had no alternative but to retreat.
The soldiers retreated from their positions.
exampleZh: 他们不得不后撤。
士兵们撤离了他们的阵地。

defsEn: n. a crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body
zh: n. 毛衣, 毛线衫, 运动衫, 出汗者
examples: What do you think of this sweater?
You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.
exampleZh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
您最好在外衣里穿一件套衫。

defsEn: a. encouraging or approving or pleasing
a. (of winds or weather) tending to promote or facilitate
s. occurring at a convenient or suitable time
zh: a. 有利的, 赞许的, 良好的
examples: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.
Circumstances are entirely favorable to us.
exampleZh: 多亏了顺风，我们很快就到了那个小岛。
环境完全对我们有利。

defsEn: r. in a free manner
zh: adv. 自由地, 随意地, 无拘束地, 直率地, 坦白地, 慷慨地, 免费地, 大量地
examples: The deer roam freely inside the park.
You can freely enter the library.

defsEn: r. at a steady rate or pace
r. in a steady manner
zh: adv. 稳定地, 无变化地, 有规则地
examples: She looked him steadily in the eye from the first word on.
I believe steadily that a new beginning is possible.

defsEn: n a young person of either sex
zh: n. 小孩, 年轻人, 少年
examples: There is nothing that a bunch of youngsters like you could do.
Now youngsters are beginning to stay to cater to the unexpected wave of tourism.

defsEn: n. a small but noticeable trace of some quality that might become stronger
n. Scottish writer of satirical novels (born in 1918)
n. a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction
v. emit or produce sparks
zh: n. 火花, 火星, 闪光, 无线电报务员, 瞬间放电, 活力, 朝气, 花花公子, 情郎
vi. 闪光, 发火花, 求婚
vt. 发动, 鼓舞, 使有朝气, 求婚
examples: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
The dog was frightened by the sparks.
exampleZh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
狗被火花吓到了。

defsEn: n. temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work
n. used of materials (especially metals) in a weakened state caused by long stress
n. (always used with a modifier) boredom resulting from overexposure to something
zh: n. 疲乏, 疲劳
vt. 使疲劳, 使心智衰弱
vi. 疲劳
a. 疲劳的
examples: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.
What with fatigue and hunger, he fell down as if he were dead.
exampleZh: 他疲劳过度，又睡眠不足，最后便病倒了。

defsEn: n. a roughly cylindrical vessel that is open at the top
n. the quantity contained in a bucket
v. put into a bucket
v. carry in a bucket
zh: n. 桶
examples: Bring me a bucket of water.
Please fill this bucket with water.
exampleZh: 给我一桶水。
请把这个桶子装满水。

defsEn: n the time between one event, process, or period and another
r during the intervening time
zh: n. 间隔时间, 其时
adv. 其间
examples: What would you like to do in the meantime?
So, what do we do in the meantime?

defsEn: n. a hard crystalline metamorphic rock that takes a high polish
used for sculpture and as building material
n. a small ball of glass that is used in various games
n. a sculpture carved from marble
v. paint or stain like marble
zh: n. 大理石, 石弹, 雕刻品
a. 大理石的, 冷酷无情的, 有大理石花纹的
examples: There's a big marble fountain in the courtyard of that mosque.
What sculpture is to a block of marble, education is to a human soul.

defsEn: v. leave
v. go away or leave
zh: vi. 离开, 出发, 背离, 违反, 去世
examples: He departed for London the day before yesterday.
He departed without so much as saying good bye.
exampleZh: 他前天去伦敦。
他连再见也不说就走了。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or caused by magnetism
a. having the properties of a magnet
i.e. of attracting iron or steel
a. capable of being magnetized
a. determined by earth's magnetic fields
zh: a. 有磁性的, 有吸引力的, 催眠术的
examples: Can we create a magnetic field on Mars?
Mars has no magnetic field to protect it from the solar wind.

defsEn: n. someone whose occupation involves training in a specific technical process
n. someone known for high skill in some intellectual or artistic technique
zh: n. 技师
examples: A technician will come to your house the day after tomorrow.
They asked the technician to make a vessel protected from light.

defsEn: n. a mark to indicate a direction or relation
n. a projectile with a straight thin shaft and an arrowhead on one end and stabilizing vanes on the other
intended to be shot from a bow
zh: n. 箭, 箭状物, 箭头记号
examples: He shot an arrow at the deer.
Not a single arrow hit the target.
exampleZh: 他射了鹿一箭。

defsEn: n. the process of becoming softened and saturated as a consequence of being immersed in water (or other liquid)
n. washing something by allowing it to soak
v. submerge in a liquid
v. beat severely
zh: n. 浸, 湿透, 大雨
vt. 使上下湿透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉
vi. 浸泡, 渗透
examples: The rain soaked me on my way home.
I got soaked by the rain on the way home.
exampleZh: 我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。
我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

defsEn: n. a low continuous indistinct sound
often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech
zh: n. 喃喃低语
vi. 喃喃自语, 作低沉声
vt. 出怨言, 抱怨地说
examples: He muttered something under his breath.
I heard Tom muttering something in French.
exampleZh: 他压低声线，喃喃自语地说了些话。
我听到汤姆在用法语嘀咕些什么。

defsEn: n. any long object resembling a thin line
n. a long strip of inked material for making characters on paper with a typewriter
n. notion consisting of a narrow strip of fine material used for trimming
zh: n. 缎带, 色带, 带状物
vt. 用丝带装饰, 把...撕成条状
vi. 形成带状
examples: I used a ribbon to tie my hair into a ponytail.
The cat had a ribbon around its neck.
exampleZh: 我用丝带在头上扎了一个马尾辫。
小猫的脖子上系着一条丝带。

defsEn: r to a severe or serious degree
r with sternness
in a severe manner
r causing great damage or hardship
zh: adv. 严格, 尖锐, 严肃, 严重, 严厉, 朴素
examples: The principal severely reproved the students whenever they made a mess in the hallway.
I got scolded severely by that teacher.
exampleZh: 每次学生把走廊弄得一团糟的时候，校长都会严厉地训斥他们。
我被那位老师严厉斥责了。

defsEn: n. a long narrow natural elevation or striation
n. any long raised strip
n. a long narrow natural elevation on the floor of the ocean
n. a long narrow range of hills
zh: n. 脊, 山脊, 山脉
examples: We have a small ridge of high pressure at the moment.
The wind tore the ridge tile from me.

defsEn: v hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
v treat cruelly
zh: vt. 挫败, 击败, 破坏
a. 无益的, 挫败的, 挫折的
examples: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?
The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
exampleZh: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
画家失望地践踏失败之作，留下一片混乱的色彩。

defsEn: n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas
n. a course offered for a small group of advanced students
zh: n. 研究班, 专题讨论会
examples: I have to take an introductory seminar next year.
Why did you attend that seminar?

defsEn: n. the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
zh: n. 电子学
examples: I used to work in an electronics store.
I went to the electronics store to buy a new refrigerator.

defsEn: n. the undulating movement of the surface of the open sea
n. a rounded elevation (especially one on an ocean floor)
n. a crescendo followed by a decrescendo
v. increase in size, magnitude, number, or intensity
zh: n. 增大, 隆起的部分, 巨浪, 肿胀
a. 优秀的, 一流的
vi. 增大, 膨胀, 肿胀, 增强, 骄傲
vt. 使膨胀, 使增大, 使上涨, 使骄傲
examples: The river swelled rapidly because of the heavy rain.
The ocean swells like an undulating mirror of the bowl of heaven.

defsEn: n. an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech
n. sports implement consisting of a tapering rod used to strike a cue ball in pool or billiards
zh: n. 提示, 线索
vt. 给...暗示(或提示)
examples: I'll take my cue from you.
When I cough twice, that's your cue to come into the room.

defsEn: n. a source of danger
a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
n. an obstacle on a golf course
zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 机会
vt. 冒...的危险, 赌运气, 使冒危险
examples: This could become an environmental hazard.
Put on the hazard warning light before you get out to change the tire.

defsEn: r not often
zh: a. 不常的, 稀少的
adv. 很少, 不常
examples: I can seldom find time for reading.
He seldom, if ever, goes to church.
exampleZh: 我很少能抽出时间看书。
他很少，如果有的话，去教堂。

defsEn: s not clearly understood or expressed
a not precisely limited, determined, or distinguished
s lacking clarity or distinctness
zh: a. 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的
examples: She gave us a vague answer.
I have a vague memory of that meeting.
exampleZh: 她给了我们一个模糊的答案。

defsEn: n. a person who comes from a foreign country
someone who does not owe allegiance to your country
n. someone who is excluded from or is not a member of a group
zh: n. 外国人, 外地人
examples: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.
A foreigner came up to me and asked me for money.
exampleZh: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。
一个外国人找到我，管我要钱。

defsEn: n. a feeling of extreme pleasure or satisfaction
v. take delight in
zh: n. 高兴, 愉快
vt. 使高兴, 乐于
vi. 感到高兴(或愉快、快乐)
examples: I'd be delighted if you could come with us.
The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
exampleZh: 你能来的话我会很开心。
发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

defsEn: n. the state of being suitable or opportune
n. the quality of being useful and convenient
zh: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的时候
examples: The convenience store ran out of business.
There's a convenience store diagonally across the street.
exampleZh: 便利店出兑。
有一家便利店在马路斜对面。

defsEn: n. pattern of weaving or structure of a fabric
v. interlace by or as if by weaving
v. create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton
v. to move or cause to move in a sinuous, spiral, or circular course
zh: n. 编法, 织法, 编织式样
vt. 编织, 组合, 编排, 使迂回前进
vi. 纺织, 迂回行进
examples: Few people weave their own fabric on a loom these days.
Have each of your wives weave a rug by tomorrow.

defsEn: n. a beam made of wood
n. a post made of wood
zh: n. 木材, 木料
vt. 用木材建造
examples: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
Load the timber into the pickup truck.
exampleZh: 燔柴祭天是一种古老的仪式。

defsEn: n. a sliding bar in a breech-loading firearm that ejects an empty cartridge and replaces it and closes the breech
n. the part of a lock that is engaged or withdrawn with a key
n. a roll of cloth or wallpaper of a definite length
n. a screw that screws into a nut to form a fastener
zh: n. 门闩, 螺钉, 筛子, 闪电, 意外事件
vt. 闩住, 发射, 脱口而出, 筛, 囫囵吞下
vi. 囫囵吞枣, 射箭, 脱缰, 退出党派
adv. 突然
examples: It was like a bolt out of the blue.
The dog bolted away like a bullet.
exampleZh: 晴天霹雳。
那只狗像子弹飞走了。

defsEn: n. a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure
n. a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end)
n. anything with a round shape resembling a teardrop
n. a rounded dilation or expansion in a canal or vessel or organ
zh: n. 球茎, 电灯泡
examples: Yanni put the light bulb in a box.
Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
exampleZh: 雅尼将灯泡放入箱子。
爱迪生发明了电灯炮。

defsEn: a. having or showing or requiring special skill
zh: a. 熟练的
examples: We do not have a skilled doctor.
She's skilled enough that she very well might start her own business.

defsEn: n. goods carried by a large vehicle
zh: n. 货物
examples: Khaki shorts with cargo pockets do not make you an adventurer.
The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
exampleZh: 单有卡其裤，还成不了冒险家。
货船早到了四小时。

defsEn: n. an evil supernatural being
n. a word used in exclamations of confusion
v. coat or stuff with a spicy paste
zh: n. 魔鬼
vt. 折磨, 戏弄
examples: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
Speak of the Devil and he doth appear.
exampleZh: 说曹操，曹操就到。
说曹操，曹操就到。

defsEn: n. someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
zh: n. 销售者
examples: The seller over there sells milk and cheese.
The Bible is a best-seller book.

defsEn: n. an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial
n. any of certain coarse weedy plants with long taproots, sometimes used as table greens or in folk medicine
n. a platform where trucks or trains can be loaded or unloaded
n. landing in a harbor next to a pier where ships are loaded and unloaded or repaired
may have gates to let water in or out
zh: n. 码头, 船坞, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分
vt. 使靠码头, 使(船)进港, 剪短
vi. 进港
examples: There was no one on the dock.
He cleaned the boat at the dock.

defsEn: r. at some indefinite or unstated time
zh: a. 以前的, 某一时间的
adv. 改天, 来日
examples: There must sometimes be some fun between two people.
Sometimes I see him at the club.
exampleZh: 两个人之间，有时候需要一点情趣。
我偶尔会在具乐部碰到他。

defsEn: n. a member of the United States Marine Corps
n. a soldier who serves both on shipboard and on land
a. of or relating to the sea
a. of or relating to military personnel who serve both on land and at sea (specifically the U.S. Marine Corps)
zh: n. 舰队, 水兵, 海景画
a. 海的, 海产的, 海底的, 船舶的, 海运的
examples: Tom is studying to become a marine biologist.
The oil-covered marine and coastal birds have left their mark on our collective memory.
exampleZh: 汤姆为了当海洋生物学家学习。

defsEn: n. a state of arrangement or appearance
n. attitude of an aircraft in flight when allowed to take its own orientation
n. cutting down to the desired size or shape
v. decorate, as with ornaments
zh: n. 整齐, 情形, 修剪
a. 整齐的
vt. 使整齐, 整理, 修剪
vi. 调整, 见风使舵
examples: Trim the fat off the meat.
Did you trim the apple trees?
exampleZh: 切除这块肉的脂肪。
你修剪过苹果树吗？

defsEn: a. bringing death
s. controlled or decreed by fate
predetermined
zh: a. 致命的, 重大的, 命运注定的, 粗心的, 不幸的
examples: As long as it's not a fatal mistake, it is ok to fail.
You might contract a fatal disease if you're not careful.
exampleZh: 只要不是致命性的错误，失败也没关系。

defsEn: n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings
n. a swimming stroke in which the arms are thrown forward together out of the water while the feet kick up and down
v. flutter like a butterfly
v. cut and spread open, as in preparation for cooking
zh: n. 蝴蝶
examples: There is a butterfly in the kitchen.
Is it a butterfly or a moth?
exampleZh: 有只蝴蝶在厨房里。
这是一只蝴蝶还是一只飞蛾？

defsEn: v. move faster
v. cause to move faster
zh: v. 加速, 促进
examples: Accelerate a bit, otherwise the car will stop on this hill.
What should we do to accelerate it?

defsEn: n. an alloy of copper and tin and sometimes other elements
also any copper-base alloy containing other elements in place of tin
n. a sculpture made of bronze
v. give the color and appearance of bronze to something
s. of the color of bronze
zh: n. 青铜, 铜像
a. 青铜色的
examples: They set up a bronze statue of the hero.
They cast bronze into a statue.

defsEn: n. the absence of matter
n. a region that is devoid of matter
n. an electrical home appliance that cleans by suction
v. clean with a vacuum cleaner
zh: n. 真空, 空间, 真空吸尘器
a. 真空的, 产生真空的, 利用真空的
vt. 用吸尘器打扫
examples: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
Every Tuesday morning the housekeeper vacuums.
exampleZh: 我免费得到了这个吸尘器。
每周二早上主妇用吸尘器清扫。

defsEn: n. a narrow strip of land that juts out into the sea
n. a skewer for holding meat over a fire
n. the act of spitting (forcefully expelling saliva)
v. expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth
zh: n. 唾液, 唾吐, 小雨, 炙叉, 一铲的深度
vt. 唾吐, 吐出, 降小雨, 用炙叉穿过
vi. 吐唾沫, 吐痰, 唾弃, 飘霏霏细雨
examples: In Singapore, it is a crime to spit on the ground.
He has the habit of spitting on the ground.
exampleZh: 随地吐痰在新加坡算是犯罪行为。
他有个随地吐痰的习惯。

defsEn: n. an authoritative rule
n. a guiding principle
v. say out loud for the purpose of recording
v. rule as a dictator
zh: vi. 听写, 口述, 口授
vt. 口述, 使听写, 命令
n. 命令, 指挥, 指令
examples: I will not be dictated to by some idiot in the personnel department.
The right wants to dictate every aspect of your life.

defsEn: n. supporting yourself on your knees
v. rest one's weight on one's knees
zh: vi. 跪下
examples: I would like it if you kneel for me.
Why do people kneel down to pray?

defsEn: n. garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering
n. workplace where clothes are washed and ironed
zh: n. 洗衣店, 洗好的衣服, 洗涤
examples: Where should I put my laundry?
Do you have laundry to do?
exampleZh: 我应该把我要洗的衣服放在哪里?
你有要洗的衣服吗？

defsEn: a. connected with or belonging to or used in a navy
zh: a. 海军的, 军舰的, 有舰队的
examples: I went to the Naval Academy.
Algeria has a large naval base in the west of the country.

defsEn: n. a firearm that is held and fired with one hand
zh: n. 手枪, 信号枪
vt. 以手枪杀死(或伤害)
examples: A pistol lay on the floor next to the body.
Put your pistol in your pocket.

defsEn: n. an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone
n. a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly
n. a poor example
zh: n. 道歉, 辩护
examples: You owe me an apology for that.
I must make an apology to her.
exampleZh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
我必须向她道歉。

defsEn: n. a person who evokes boredom
n. diameter of a tube or gun barrel
n. a hole or passage made by a drill
usually made for exploratory purposes
v. cause to be bored
zh: n. 令人讨厌的人, 激浪, 枪膛, 孔
vt. 使烦扰, 钻孔
vi. 钻孔
bear的过去式
examples: I'm bored and I have nothing to do.
If you're bored, I suggest you go to the cinema.
exampleZh: 实在闲得没事干。
如果你感到无聊，我建议你去电影院。

defsEn: n. a beloved person
used as terms of endearment
s. dearly loved
zh: a. 心爱的
n. 心爱的人
examples: He lost his most beloved son.
My beloved is white and ruddy, chosen out of thousands.
exampleZh: 他失去了最爱的儿子。
我所爱的是白皙红润，千里挑一的。

defsEn: v. provide entertainment for
v. take into consideration, have in view
zh: vt. 娱乐, 招待, 怀抱
vi. 款待
examples: They entertained us at dinner last night.
He entertained us with jokes all evening.
exampleZh: 他们昨晚设宴招待了我们。
整个晚上他都在开玩笑逗我们开心。

defsEn: v. go for and bring back
v. run after, pick up, and bring to the master
zh: vt. 取回, 挽回, 弥补, 恢复, 补偿, 回忆, 检索
vi. 找回猎物
n. 取回, 恢复, 救险球
examples: I will retrieve them tomorrow if I have time.
Ziri asked his dog to retrieve the ball.

defsEn: n. a will disposing of real property
n. (law) a gift of real property by will
v. give by will, especially real property
zh: vt. 设计, 发明, 图谋, 遗赠给
n. 遗赠
examples: We must devise some means of escape.
We need to devise a plan.

defsEn: n. a mechanical device that prevents a vessel from moving
n. a central cohesive source of support and stability
n. a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute
v. fix firmly and stably
zh: n. 锚
vt. 抛锚停泊, 使固定
examples: That anchor alone must weigh a ton!
They usually use an anchor to hold a yacht in place.

defsEn: n. an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each
n. an advantageous purchase
v. come to terms
arrive at an agreement
zh: n. 交易, 买卖协定, 特价商品
v. 讲价, 交易
examples: This dress is a good bargain.
The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
exampleZh: 这条连衣裙很便宜。
这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

defsEn: n. an alloy of copper and zinc
n. a wind instrument that consists of a brass tube (usually of variable length) that is blown by means of a cup-shaped or funnel-shaped mouthpiece
n. an ornament or utensil made of brass
n. a memorial made of brass
zh: n. 黄铜, 黄铜制品
a. 黄铜的, 铜管乐器的
v. 镀以黄铜, 支付
examples: A brass band is marching along the street.
I like my old brass tea pot.
exampleZh: 一个铜管乐队沿着路前进。

defsEn: n. a person who suffers misfortune
a. not favored by fortune
marked or accompanied by or resulting in ill fortune
s. unsuitable or regrettable
zh: a. 不幸的, 不合适的, 不吉利的
examples: Yesterday there was an unfortunate accident.
Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.
exampleZh: 昨天发生了一个不幸的事故。
由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。

defsEn: s. characterized by a high degree or intensity
often used as a combining form
a. tending to give force or emphasis
a. of agriculture
intended to increase productivity of a fixed area by expending more capital and labor
zh: a. 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的
n. 加强器
examples: Intensive communication between teacher and student is the key to effective teaching.
He is in hospital in intensive care.

defsEn: s. showing inventiveness and skill
zh: a. 聪明的, 精明的
examples: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
He is a clever boy, to be sure.
exampleZh: 他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。
他确实是个聪明的小孩。

defsEn: r. on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
r. on first or second or third base
r. side by side
r. part of a group
zh: adv. 在船上, 在火车上, 在飞机上
prep. 在...之上
examples: How many people were aboard that ship?
The passengers all went aboard the ship.
exampleZh: 那艘船上有多少人？
乘客全都登上了船。

defsEn: n. variety of sweet eating apples
zh: a. 美味的
examples: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.
My father made me a delicious lunch.
exampleZh: 谢谢你烤的美味蛋糕。
我父亲为我做了一顿美味的午餐。

defsEn: v. make a copy or equivalent of
v. have offspring or produce more individuals of a given animal or plant
v. recreate a sound, image, idea, mood, atmosphere, etc.
zh: v. 繁殖, 再生, 复制, 生殖
examples: Try to reproduce the music in your mind.
Bacteria do not reproduce in alcohol.

defsEn: s. promoting or enhancing well-being
zh: a. 有益的, 受益的
examples: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
That would be beneficial to us.
exampleZh: 多运动有益健康。

defsEn: s. causing inconvenience
a. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
s. difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s. not elegant or graceful in expression
zh: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的
examples: The girl made an awkward bow.
He is awkward in his movements.
exampleZh: 这个女孩做了一把不称手的弓。
他笨手笨脚的。

defsEn: n. any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes
also many insect larvae
n. a person who has a nasty or unethical character undeserving of respect
n. a software program capable of reproducing itself that can spread from one computer to the next over a network
n. screw thread on a gear with the teeth of a worm wheel or rack
zh: n. 虫, 蠕虫, 小人物, 螺纹, 蜗杆
vi. 蠕行, 慢慢前进
vt. 使蠕行, 慢慢地走, 除虫
examples: The mother bird brought worms for her young ones.
How many worms did you find?
exampleZh: 母鸟叼来虫子喂幼鸟。
你找到几只虫子？

defsEn: n. a criminal who takes property belonging to someone else with the intention of keeping it or selling it
zh: n. 小偷, 贼
examples: The thief entered the house at the back door by the open window.
The thief ran off as soon as he saw the police car.
exampleZh: 小偷从后门爬窗走进了房子里。
小偷一看到警车就跑走了。

defsEn: a. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives
a. relating to or characteristic of an editor
zh: n. 社论, 评论
a. 编辑的, 主笔的, 社论的
examples: Bill is on the editorial staff.
How involved are you in the editorial process?
exampleZh: 比尔在编辑部工作。

defsEn: n. any loyal and steadfast following
a. steadfast in affection or allegiance
a. not having sexual relations with anyone except your husband or wife, or your boyfriend or girlfriend
zh: a. 忠实的, 详确的, 可靠的
n. 信徒
examples: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
I aim to be faithful to only one man.
exampleZh: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

defsEn: s. not carefully or expertly made
s. conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
s. belonging to an early stage of technical development
characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
s. not processed or subjected to analysis
zh: a. 天然的, 未成熟的, 粗糙的, 粗鲁的
n. 天然的物质
examples: The method was crude, but very effective.
The method was crude but effective.

defsEn: n. the delivery of a principal into lawful custody
v. give up or agree to forgo to the power or possession of another
v. relinquish possession or control over
zh: vt. 交出, 放弃, 使投降, 让与
vi. 投降, 自首
n. 交出, 放弃, 投降
examples: I would rather die than surrender.
Sami had no choice but to surrender.
exampleZh: 我宁死不降。
萨米只有投降一途

defsEn: n. a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue
v. mark with a scar
zh: n. 疤痕, 伤痕, 悬崖
vi. 结疤, 愈合, 痊愈
vt. 使有伤痕
examples: The scars of your love remind me of us.
I'll still have a scar from that accident.
exampleZh: 你的爱情留下的疤痕使我想起我们。
我还留着那起事故的伤疤。

defsEn: n. preliminary drawing for later elaboration
n. a brief literary description
n. short descriptive summary (of events)
v. make a sketch of
zh: n. 素描, 草图, 小品
v. 描绘略图, 画素描或速写
examples: Can you sketch it for me on this piece of paper please?
Tom sketched a picture of an elephant for Mary.
exampleZh: 请你帮我在这张纸上画个草图。
汤姆给玛丽画了大象的素描。

defsEn: n. a ductile malleable reddish-brown corrosion-resistant diamagnetic metallic element
occurs in various minerals but is the only metal that occurs abundantly in large masses
used as an electrical and thermal conductor
n. a copper penny
n. a reddish-brown color resembling the color of polished copper
n. any of various small butterflies of the family Lycaenidae having coppery wings
zh: n. 铜, 警察
examples: This spoon is made of copper.
Copper and silver are both metals.
exampleZh: 这把汤匙是铜制的。
铜和银都是金属。

defsEn: n. the state of something that has been unused and neglected
v. leave undone or leave out
v. fail to attend to
v. give little or no attention to
zh: n. 疏忽, 忽略, 漏做
vt. 疏忽, 忽视, 不顾
examples: You are not to neglect your duty.
Those people did not neglect their child because they used the Internet too much.
exampleZh: 你不能漠视你的责任。
那两个人不是因为过于上网而忽视他们的孩子。

defsEn: n. a sudden very loud noise
n. a border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead
n. the swift release of a store of affective force
v. to produce a sharp often metallic explosive or percussive sound
zh: n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海
v. 发巨响, 重击
adv. 砰然地, 突然巨响地, 直接地
examples: She banged the table with her fist.
You get more bang for your buck that way.
exampleZh: 她用拳头拍了桌子。

defsEn: n. a tight cluster of people or things
n. any of various fastenings formed by looping and tying a rope (or cord) upon itself or to another rope or to another object
n. a hard cross-grained round piece of wood in a board where a branch emerged
n. something twisted and tight and swollen
zh: n. 结, 群, 难题
v. 打结, (使)纠缠
examples: Tom still hasn't tied the knot.
You have to tighten the knot.
exampleZh: 汤姆还是未婚。

defsEn: n. an economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment
n. the condition of prospering
having good fortune
zh: n. 繁荣, 茂盛, 成功
examples: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
It will threaten the prosperity of the town.
exampleZh: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

defsEn: n. a creature of Teutonic mythology
usually represented as breathing fire and having a reptilian body and sometimes wings
n. a fiercely vigilant and unpleasant woman
n. any of several small tropical Asian lizards capable of gliding by spreading winglike membranes on each side of the body
zh: n. 龙, 凶暴的人
examples: During the Dragon Boat Festival, there needs to be a dragon boat race.
The year of the dragon has ended.
exampleZh: 端午节要赛龙舟。
龙年结束了。

defsEn: n. a feeling of considerable warmth
n. a steady even light without flames
v. emit a steady even light without flames
v. have a complexion with a strong bright color, such as red or pink
zh: n. 赤热, 光辉, 热情, 热烈, 红光
vi. 发红光, 红光焕发, 发热, 洋溢, 激动
examples: At dusk, the sky glows with a purple light.
You could see the glow of the fire for miles.
exampleZh: 傍晚时分，天空泛着紫色的光。

defsEn: v. make dull in appearance
v. become dull or lusterless in appearance
lose shine or brightness
v. make dull or blunt
v. make less lively or vigorous
zh: a. 钝的, 无趣的, 呆滞的, 阴暗的
vt. 使迟钝, 使阴暗, 缓和
vi. 变迟钝, 减少
examples: I used to feel it dull.
The point of the pencil has become dull.
exampleZh: 我以前觉得这很无趣。
铅笔头钝了。

defsEn: n. floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)
zh: n. 小块地毯, 揭露某人
examples: He never stepped on that rug.
I need to buy a rug for my room.
exampleZh: 他从未踩过那块地毯。

defsEn: n. the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy
n. the part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel
n. a wreath or garland worn on the head to signify victory
n. an ornamental jeweled headdress signifying sovereignty
zh: n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点
vt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之顶
examples: The Queen's crown was made of gold.
The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.
exampleZh: 皇后的后冠是用黄金铸成的。
王冠上镶嵌着数十颗光彩夺目的宝石。

defsEn: n. someone unpleasantly strange or eccentric
n. a slow longitudinal movement or deformation
n. a pen that is fenced so that young animals can enter but adults cannot
v. grow or spread, often in such a way as to cover (a surface)
zh: n. 爬, 徐行, 蠕动
vi. 爬, 蔓延, 潜行
examples: Sometimes it's fun to creep yourself out thinking about it.
Back off, you creep! Never touch me again!
exampleZh: 偶尔偷偷地去想这个问题，还是很有意思的。

defsEn: n. an important, honorable person (word is often used humorously)
a. having worth or merit or value
being honorable or admirable
s. having qualities or abilities that merit recognition in some way
zh: n. 杰出人物
a. 有价值的, 可敬的, 值得的
examples: His behavior is worthy of respect.
Your proposal is worthy of being considered.
exampleZh: 他的行为值得尊重。
你的提议值得考虑。

defsEn: n. a nonmetallic univalent element that is normally a colorless and odorless highly flammable diatomic gas
the simplest and lightest and most abundant element in the universe
zh: n. 氢
examples: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
Water is made up of oxygen and hydrogen.
exampleZh: 水是由氢和氧组成的。
氧和氢组成了水。

defsEn: n. a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur
a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible
n. the quality of being probable
a probable event or the most probable event
zh: n. 可能性, 或然率, 几率, 概率
examples: Tomorrow there's a high probability it will rain.
In all probability, the cabinet will fall.
exampleZh: 明天很有可能下雨。

defsEn: n. sour-tasting liquid produced usually by oxidation of the alcohol in wine or cider and used as a condiment or food preservative
n. dilute acetic acid
zh: n. 醋, 尖酸刻薄
vt. 加醋于
examples: Bring me the vinegar and oil, please.
Bring me vinegar and oil, please.

defsEn: n. a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain
v. provide relief for
zh: n. 药物, 治疗法, 治疗, 补救, 赔偿
vt. 治疗, 补救, 矫正, 改善, 修补, 修缮
examples: Smiling is the best remedy for negative emotions.
Remind me about my remedy or I might forget.
exampleZh: 笑容是坏心情的最佳药方。

defsEn: a. having or manifesting hope
zh: n. 有希望之人, 有前途之人
a. 有希望的, 怀抱希望的, 保持乐观的
examples: I feel hopeful about the future.

The murderer is still at large.

凶手还没有抓到。

Be careful not to trip on that tin of paint.

defsEn: n. a state in which all hope is lost or absent

give up hope
lose heart

She was in despair when her husband died.
exampleZh: 充满希望比绝望好。
丈夫去世时她十分绝望。

defsEn: n. any of various related trees bearing limes
n. the green acidic fruit of any of various lime trees
v. cover with lime so as to induce growth

vt. 以石灰处理, 粘鸟胶于, 撒石灰
examples: I spread lime on the wall.
He held a sword and a lime-wood shield.

defsEn: n. sweet fleshy red fruit
n. any of various low perennial herbs with many runners and bearing white flowers followed by edible fruits having many small achenes scattered on the surface of an enlarged red pulpy berry
n. a soft red birthmark
zh: n. 草莓
examples: I have strawberries. Do you want to eat some?
Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
exampleZh: 我有草莓，你想吃吗？
草莓在冬天售价高。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or comprising atoms
s. immeasurably small

examples: They know how to make an atomic bomb.
The scientist is working on atomic energy.
exampleZh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
这个科学家正在研究原子能。

defsEn: n. a small light typewriter
usually with a case in which it can be carried
a. easily or conveniently transported
s. of a motor designed to be attached to the outside of a boat's hull

examples: I buy a portable music player.
The reception on this portable TV is terrible.

examples: Moisture can lead to bacteria growth.
Yes, it is. There's a lot of moisture in the air.

n. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false
n. the speech act of contradicting someone
zh: n. 反驳, 矛盾
examples: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
Contradiction is always a sign of recognition.

defsEn: n. a sudden involuntary movement
v. to stimulate to action
v. move or jump suddenly, as if in surprise or alarm

vt. 吃惊, 使惊愕

examples: The phone startled us in our sleep at the crack of dawn this morning.
The sudden noise startled the old man.

defsEn: v. become broader or wider or more extensive
v. make wider
v. extend in scope or range or area

vi. 变宽, 扩大
examples: They need to widen the road.
Television helps us widen our knowledge.

defsEn: n. a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)
n. a person who waits or awaits

examples: I need a waiter to help me order.
Waiter, please give us the menu.

服务员，请给我们菜单。

defsEn: r apart from others

分离地

I need to talk to you separately.
exampleZh: 请你分开包装好吗？

defsEn: n. one of two divisions of an academic year
n. half a year
a period of 6 months

The end of the semester will come soon.

This cartographer is famous for the precision in his maps.
exampleZh: 不要把精确和准确搞错。
此制图员出名于其制图的精准性。

defsEn: a. on or of lower floors of a building
r. on a floor below

adv. 在楼下

Someone is waiting for you downstairs.

楼下有人在等您。

v. crush or bruise

She used apples to do the jam.

她用苹果做了果酱。

She came to Tokyo when she was eighteen years old.

Today the weather is magnificent and the children play in the fields.

今天天气晴朗，孩子们在田野里玩耍。

汤姆买了一辆旧救护车，并把它改装成露营车。

distinctive or special

她帮助他平抚了他的悲伤。

老板在的时候他就装成一副很热心的样子。

s. lost in thought
showing preoccupation

We need you to tell us why you were absent all last week.

我们要你告诉我们你为什么整个上周都缺勤。

vi. 告密, 检举

certainly

vt. 保护, 遮蔽, 屏蔽, 庇护, 挡开, 避开
vi. 起保护作用
examples: I want my boss to shield me from unnecessary stuff.
He used the book as a shield.

defsEn: n. any informal meal eaten outside or on an excursion
v. eat alfresco, in the open air
zh: n. 野餐, 远足, 愉快的经历
vi. 去野餐, 远足
examples: We will go on a picnic tomorrow.
I want to have a picnic.
exampleZh: 我们明天要去野餐。
我想去郊游。

defsEn: a. of or relating to fabrics or fabric making
zh: n. 纺织品, 纺织业
a. 织的, 纺织的
examples: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
The textile industry was the most important part of the city's economy.
exampleZh: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。

defsEn: n. someone who mediates between speakers of different languages
n. someone who uses art to represent something
n. (computer science) a program that translates and executes source language statements one line at a time
zh: n. 直译程序, 解释者, 口译者, 注释器
examples: The interpreter tries to give the most detail and information possible.
He's an interpreter in an international bank.
exampleZh: 翻译正在试图给尽可能多的细节和消息。
他是个国际银行的翻译。

defsEn: n. a child's room for a baby
zh: n. 托儿所, 苗圃, 温床
examples: What is the way to get to the nursery?
Can you remember your nursery teacher's name?

defsEn: n. (physics) a brief event in which two or more bodies come together
n. an accident resulting from violent impact of a moving object
n. a conflict of opposed ideas or attitudes or goals
zh: n. 碰撞, 冲突, 抵触
examples: We may be on a collision course.
The military plane was on a collision course with a passenger plane.

defsEn: v. confirm the truth of
v. attach or append a legal verification to (a pleading or petition)
zh: vt. 证明, 查证, 证实, 检验, 校验
examples: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
How do you verify your bank account?
exampleZh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。

defsEn: n. a thick flat pad used as a floor covering
n. mounting consisting of a border or background for a picture
n. sports equipment consisting of a piece of thick padding on the floor for gymnastic sports
n. a mass that is densely tangled or interwoven
zh: n. 垫, 丛, 衬边
a. 粗糙的, 无光泽的
vi. 纠缠在一起
vt. 铺席于...上, 使无光泽, 使缠结
examples: The dog was sleeping on the mat.
During mating season many animals exude strong fragrances.
exampleZh: 狗在地毯上睡觉。
很多动物会在交配季节释放出很强的气味。

defsEn: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six
s. being ten more than fifty
zh: num. 六十, 六十个
examples: Why did my sixty-year-old landlord buy a trampoline?
There are sixty seconds in a minute.
exampleZh: 我的六十岁的房东为什么买了一个蹦床？
一分钟有六十秒。

defsEn: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
zh: a. 极广大的, 无边的, 非常好的
examples: He left an immense fortune to his children.
I drink to forget my immense pain.

defsEn: a. feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
zh: a. 惭愧的, 羞耻的
examples: A man of sense would be ashamed to do so.
You have no need to be ashamed.
exampleZh: 聪明人会羞于干这种事。
你不需要害羞。

defsEn: a. having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
zh: a. 无用的, 无效的, 无益的
examples: Threatening me is useless, I won't say anything.
My life would be useless without you.
exampleZh: 威胁我也没用，我什么都不会说的。

defsEn: n. the outer layer of the Earth
n. a hard outer layer that covers something
n. the trait of being rude and impertinent
inclined to take liberties
v. form a crust or form into a crust
zh: n. 外壳, 坚硬外皮, 面包皮
vt. 盖以硬皮
vi. 结硬皮
examples: I cut the crust off the bread.
He eats a crust of bread every morning.

defsEn: n. a short labored intake of breath with the mouth open
zh: n. 喘气
vi. 喘气, 喘息, 渴望
vt. 气喘吁吁地说
examples: They all gasped at the same time.
This is the last gasp of summer.

defsEn: n an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease
zh: n. 流感, 流行性感冒
examples: We all caught flu, and so did the teacher.
I've got a touch of the flu.
exampleZh: 我们全都染上了流感，连老师也不例外。
我有点流感。

defsEn: n. two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals
zh: n. 蚊子
examples: I got a lot of mosquito bites.
I just got bitten by a mosquito.
exampleZh: 我被很多的蚊子叮了。
我刚刚被蚊子咬了。

defsEn: a. not conscious
lacking awareness and the capacity for sensory perception as if asleep or dead
s. without conscious volition
s. (followed by `of') not knowing or perceiving
zh: a. 未意识到的, 无意识的, 无知觉的
examples: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
exampleZh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。
他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

defsEn: s. having intellectual depth
a. exhibiting or characterized by careful thought
s. acting with or showing thought and good sense
s. considerate of the feelings or well-being of others
zh: a. 深思的, 体贴的
examples: He is a very thoughtful person.
She is very thoughtful and patient.
exampleZh: 他是个很体贴的人。
她非常周到和耐心。

defsEn: n. a plant with a weak stem that derives support from climbing, twining, or creeping along a surface
zh: n. 藤本植物, 葡萄, 藤, 蔓
vi. 形成藤蔓
examples: English ivy is a climbing vine.
Ziri cut the vine at this exact spot.
exampleZh: 西洋常春藤是攀缘藤本植物。

defsEn: r. for a long time without essential change
zh: adv. 永久, 不变, 持久
examples: You're still young, but not permanently.
I have permanently changed for the worse.
exampleZh: 你还年轻，可是没有永久。

defsEn: a. possible but not necessary
left to personal choice
zh: a. 可选择的, 随意的
examples: The word "the" is optional in this sentence.
In Lojban, tense and aspect are optional and comprehensive.

defsEn: n. laborer who works in a mine
zh: n. 矿工, 开矿机, 坑道工兵
examples: The miner asked the lamp spirit for a happy life.
I used to be a coal miner.

defsEn: r. using the voice
not silently
zh: adv. 出声地, 大声地
examples: He thought to himself, "No!" Aloud he said, "Yes."
She read a book aloud to her children.
exampleZh: 他心里对自己说“不！”。他大声说出“是。”。

defsEn: n a group of representatives or delegates
n authorizing subordinates to make certain decisions
zh: n. 代表团, 派遣代表团, 代表的地位(或权力)
examples: The delegations of both countries met in Geneva.
Many delegations left the meeting room as a sign of protest.
exampleZh: 两国代表团在日内瓦会面。

defsEn: n. a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
n. a special type
v. copulate with a female, used especially of horses
v. cause to procreate (animals)
zh: n. 种类, 品种
v. 养育, 引起, 饲养, 繁殖
examples: He learned how to breed cattle.
Bacteria will not breed in alcohol.

defsEn: v shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
zh: n. 哭, 哭泣
vi. 哭泣, 流泪, 哀悼, 滴落
vt. 哭着使..., 悲叹, 滴下
examples: My mother did nothing but weep.
The cut is no longer weeping and is starting to heal.
exampleZh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。
伤口已不流脓, 渐渐愈合了

defsEn: n. an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented
n. a liquid substance that is a solution (or emulsion or suspension) used or obtained in an industrial process
n. the liquid in which vegetables or meat have be cooked
zh: n. 酒, 液体, 汁, 溶液
vt. 浸水
vi. 喝酒
examples: Lips that touch liquor shall not touch mine.
Every Friday night they went and got liquored up.
exampleZh: 碰过酒的嘴唇就别想碰我的唇。
他们星期五每晚都去喝酒。

defsEn: r. in an unfortunate way
r. with sadness
in a sad manner
zh: adv. 悲痛地, 悲惨地, 悲伤地, 说来遗憾
examples: Sadly, most young people speak dialect only rarely.
He told me sadly, "I'm not sure whether I should be alive."
exampleZh: 不幸的是，大多数年轻人都不常说方言了。
他难过的对我说: "我很犹豫我是否应该活下来".

defsEn: n. the complete duration of something
n. the distance or interval between two points
n. a unit of length based on the width of the expanded human hand (usually taken as 9 inches)
zh: n. 指距, 全长, 跨距, 一段时间, 小范围
vt. 以手指测量, 跨越, 架设, 持续
examples: The life span of a butterfly is short.
The average life span of the Japanese has lengthened to a great extent.
exampleZh: 蝴蝶的寿命短。

defsEn: n. a hexahedron with six equal squares as faces
n. the product of three equal terms
n. any of several tropical American woody plants of the genus Lonchocarpus whose roots are used locally as a fish poison and commercially as a source of rotenone
n. a block in the (approximate) shape of a cube
zh: n. 立方体, 立方
examples: I want to cube the cheese for the salad.
The ice cube will melt in a little bit.

defsEn: n. the natives or inhabitants of Switzerland
a. of or relating to Switzerland or its people or culture
zh: n. 瑞士人, 瑞士腔调
a. 瑞士的, 瑞士风格的
examples: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
Swiss chocolate really melts in your mouth.
exampleZh: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
瑞士巧克力真的在你嘴里融化。

defsEn: v. send something via a facsimile machine
zh: n. 传真
vt. 发传真
examples: Please send it to me by fax.
I got your fax the other day.
exampleZh: 请把它传真给我。
我前几天收到了你的传真。

defsEn: r. on the lower or downward side
on the underside of
r. under or below an object or a surface
at a lower place or level
directly beneath
zh: adv. 在下面
prep. 在...的下面
examples: I found the key underneath the mat.
Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
exampleZh: 我在擦鞋垫下面发现了这把钥匙。
下面写上我们班同学的名字。

defsEn: v. switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam
v. become dim or lusterless
v. make dim or lusterless
s. lacking in light
not bright or harsh
zh: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的
vt. 使暗淡
examples: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
The light is too dim for me to read easily.
exampleZh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。
灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。

defsEn: n. the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure
n. any solution that is injected (as into the skin)
n. the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe
zh: n. 注射, 注射剂
examples: I need to give you an injection.
The nurse gave me a glucose injection.
exampleZh: 我得给你打一针。
护士给我打了葡萄糖。

defsEn: n. an estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)
n. a newly established colony (especially in the colonization of North America)
zh: n. 种植园, 大农场, 植树造林, 新开垦地
examples: Nothing remains of the Ziri plantation.
There was a sugarcane plantation in the area.

defsEn: n. the time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon
n. atmospheric phenomena accompanying the daily disappearance of the sun
n. the daily event of the sun sinking below the horizon
s. of a declining industry or technology
zh: n. 日落, 晚年
examples: We could see the sunset from the window.
Even after sunset there was little moderation in the temperature.
exampleZh: 我们能从窗户看到日落。
甚至在日落之后，气温也不见降低。

defsEn: n. a quantity much larger than is needed
n. immoderation as a consequence of going beyond sufficient or permitted limits
s. more than is needed, desired, or required
zh: n. 过度, 剩于, 超过, 超额
a. 过量的, 额外的
examples: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
Never spend in excess of your income.
exampleZh: 货车的载货量超过了三吨。

defsEn: n. the property of being smooth and shiny
n. a highly developed state of perfection
having a flawless or impeccable quality
n. a preparation used in polishing
n. the Slavic language of Poland
zh: a. 波兰的
n. 波兰人, 上光剂, 光泽, 优雅
vt. 擦亮, 擦去, 使完美
vi. 擦亮, 变得光亮
examples: Jane could not believe it when her date polished off an entire chocolate cake.
Try to polish up your English.
exampleZh: 珍的男朋友一口气把整个巧克力蛋糕吃得一干二净，把珍看得目瞪口呆。
努力提升英文能力。

defsEn: n. a farm where dairy products are produced
zh: n. 牛奶公司, 乳品店, 乳牛场
examples: He used to work in a dairy.
Cheese and other dairy products do not agree with me.

defsEn: n. someone who takes care of a garden
n. someone employed to work in a garden
zh: n. 园丁, 花匠, 园艺家
examples: The gardener planted a rose tree in the middle of the garden.
I used to be a gardener.
exampleZh: 园丁在花园的中央种了一棵玫瑰树。

defsEn: n. a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
zh: n. 机智, 智力, 头脑, 理智, 妙语, 机智的人
examples: I was at my wit's end when I heard the news.
A lot of wit, but nothing to show for it.
exampleZh: 当我听到这个消息时, 我束手无策。

defsEn: n. sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs
n. large edible rays having a long snout and thick tail with pectoral fins continuous with the head
swim by undulating the edges of the pectoral fins
v. move along on skates
zh: n. 溜冰, 冰鞋
vi. 滑冰, 滑过
examples: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
I got the roller skates for nothing.
exampleZh: 在这个湖上滑冰安全吗？
我免费得到溜冰鞋。

defsEn: n. profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger
n. a severe affliction
v. utter obscenities or profanities
v. heap obscenities upon
zh: n. 咒骂, 诅咒
vt. 诅咒, 咒骂
examples: Yes, people usually curse at someone they are acquainted with.
I curse the day I married my husband.
exampleZh: 对，人通常会对自己的熟人口出恶言。

defsEn: n. acceptance of despair
n. the act of giving up (a claim or office or possession etc.)
n. a formal document giving notice of your intention to resign
zh: n. 辞职, 辞呈, 听从
examples: Resignation is the first lesson of life.
He said it in a tone of resignation.
exampleZh: 辞职是人生的第一课。

defsEn: n. a legal document signed and sealed and delivered to effect a transfer of property and to show the legal right to possess it
zh: n. 行为, 实行, 契约
vt. 立契转让
examples: His brave deed earned him respect.
His words and deeds do not match.
exampleZh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。
他言行不一。

defsEn: s. very unhappy
full of misery
s. characterized by physical misery
zh: a. 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
examples: I hate to see you so miserable.
If you want to be miserable, that's your choice.

defsEn: a. full of life and energy
s. full of zest or vigor
s. filled with events or activity
zh: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的
examples: There isn't a place in this market that isn't lively.
This village isn't big, but it's quite lively.
exampleZh: 市场上到处都很热闹。
这个小镇不大,可是很热闹.

defsEn: n. station where transport vehicles load or unload passengers or goods
n. a contact on an electrical device (such as a battery) at which electric current enters or leaves
n. electronic equipment consisting of a device providing access to a computer
has a keyboard and display
a. of or relating to or situated at the ends of a delivery route
zh: n. 终端机, 终点, 末端, 极限, 终点站
a. 终点的, 定期的, 致死的, 结尾的, 末端的, 晚期的
examples: Life is a sexually transmitted terminal disease.
We hit on them at the bus terminal.
exampleZh: 生命是一种致命的性传染病。

defsEn: n. the act of removing hair with a razor
v. remove body hair with a razor
v. cut closely
v. cut the price of
zh: n. 修面, 刮胡子, 幸免, 剃刀
vt. 修面, 剃, 修剪, 掠过
vi. 刮脸, 勉强通过
examples: It is pleasant to shave off my beard.
I got a shave and a haircut.
exampleZh: 刮完胡子感觉很舒服。
我刮了胡子并理了发。

defsEn: a. devoid of good sense or judgment
zh: a. 愚蠢的, 傻的
examples: It was foolish of her to ask him for help.
It is foolish of him to pay for it again.
exampleZh: 她去找他帮忙，实在不是一个明智之举。
这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。

defsEn: n. yard consisting of an outdoor area for children's play
zh: n. 运动场, 操场, 度假胜地, 活动场所
examples: I fell over in the school playground.
He fell over in the school playground.

defsEn: a. properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient
s. adequate for the purpose
a. legally qualified or sufficient
zh: a. 能干的, 胜任的, 有效的, 足够的
examples: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
They are both very competent judges.
exampleZh: 有人说你是个很有能力的人。
他们俩都是很称职的法官。

defsEn: n. a person who belongs to an early stage of civilization
n. a mathematical expression from which another expression is derived
n. a word serving as the basis for inflected or derived forms
s. used of preliterate or tribal or nonindustrial societies
zh: n. 原始人, 早期艺术家
a. 原始的, 上古的
examples: At that time a primitive people lived there.
This is a very primitive scheme.

defsEn: n. an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium
n. a platform projecting from the wall of a building and surrounded by a balustrade or railing or parapet
zh: n. 阳台, 戏院楼厅
examples: Why don't you go out on the balcony and get some sun?
I ate breakfast on my balcony.
exampleZh: 去阳台上晒晒太阳怎么样？
我在阳台上吃的早饭。

defsEn: n. the part of the face above the eyes
zh: n. 眉毛, 额
examples: On hearing that, he knitted his brow.
A drop of sweat ran down her brow.
exampleZh: 他听到那个时，皱起了眉头。

defsEn: n. the activity of worshipping
n. a feeling of profound love and admiration
v. show devotion to (a deity)
v. attend religious services
zh: n. 崇拜, 礼拜, 尊敬
vi. 参加礼拜
vt. 崇拜, 尊敬
examples: The Greeks used to worship several gods.
Many people worship you. Do not disappoint them.
exampleZh: 希腊人以前是信奉多神的民族。

defsEn: a. causing or capable of causing harm
zh: a. 有害的, 伤害的
examples: Fear is more harmful than the sharpest of swords.
Smoking is harmful to your health.
exampleZh: 恐惧比利剑更伤人。
吸烟有害健康。

defsEn: n. social insect living in organized colonies
characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season
wingless sterile females are the workers
zh: n. 蚂蚁
examples: There's a row of ants coming in and out of the kitchen.
Vladimir found ants in his bathtub.
exampleZh: 有一排蚂蚁在厨房里进进出出。
弗拉基米尔在浴缸里发现了蚂蚁。

defsEn: n. a fee paid for instruction (especially for higher education)
zh: n. 学费, 讲授
examples: He put the tuition in full.
I got a grant for my tuition.

defsEn: a. causing destruction or much damage
zh: a. 毁灭性的, 破坏的, 有害的
examples: How did you manage to overcome this destructive habit?
You end up being self-destructive or depressed.

defsEn: n. the act of doing or performing again
n. the repeated use of the same word or word pattern as a rhetorical device
zh: n. 重复, 背诵, 循环, 复制品, 副本
examples: Repetition is the mother of memory.
A spaced repetition system can help reinforce long-term memory.
exampleZh: 重复是记忆之母。

defsEn: a relatively low in price or charging low prices
zh: a. 便宜的, 不贵重的
examples: Do you know if there's an inexpensive hotel near here?
I know an inexpensive place we could eat at.
exampleZh: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？

defsEn: n. tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants
n. a noise resembling the bark of a dog
n. a sailing ship with 3 (or more) masts
n. the sound made by a dog
zh: n. 树皮, 吠声
vi. 吠, 叫骂
vt. 喊出, 剥树皮
examples: A dog will bark at strangers.
The dog barked at the stranger.
exampleZh: 狗会对陌生人叫。
这只狗对着陌生人叫。

defsEn: n. an apparatus that produces a vapor or gas
n. engine that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by electromagnetic induction
n. someone who originates or causes or initiates something
n. an electronic device for producing a signal voltage
zh: n. 产生器, 发电机, 生产者
examples: He set fire to the generator.
The power is out, but we have a generator.

defsEn: n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
zh: n. 咖啡馆, 酒店
examples: I drink coffee in a cafe.
I had a cup of coffee at the cafe.
exampleZh: 我在咖啡厅里喝咖啡。
我在咖啡店里喝了一杯咖啡。

defsEn: n. a large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack
n. (chess) the piece that can move any number of unoccupied squares in a direction parallel to the sides of the chessboard
n. interchanging the positions of the king and a rook
v. move the king two squares toward a rook and in the same move the rook to the square next past the king
zh: n. 城堡, 象棋中的车
vt. 置于城堡中, 盘踞于
examples: Give me the key to this castle!
There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
exampleZh: 给我这座城堡的钥匙!
山脚下有一座古老的城堡。

defsEn: v put in effect
v fill or meet a want or need
v meet the requirements or expectations of
zh: vt. 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足
examples: I want to see you fulfilled.
Try to have a fulfilling career.

defsEn: n. an example regarded as typical of its class
n. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes

The police conducted a thorough search of the building.

defsEn: v. make less visible or unclear
v. make obscure or unclear
v. reduce a vowel to a neutral one, such as a schwa
v. make undecipherable or imperceptible by obscuring or concealing

The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.

两位学者为一句意思含糊的藏文句子争论了一番。

defsEn: n. something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight)

defsEn: n. something that causes you to experience a sudden intense feeling or sensation
v. cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input

examples: I'd be thrilled to do that.
Fred was thrilled to buy the car.
exampleZh: 我很乐意这么做。
弗雷德非常兴奋地买了这辆车。

defsEn: n a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations
n belief about (or mental picture of) the future
n the act of looking out
zh: n. 观点, 景色, 前途, 了望

defsEn: n an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates

activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
