defsEn: n. a common nonmetallic element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless inert diatomic gas
constitutes 78 percent of the atmosphere by volume
a constituent of all living tissues

defsEn: s. considered individually

It's my goal to be as transparent as possible.

v. cause be distributed

v. cause to move in a circuit or system

He circulated from table to table at the reception.

defsEn: v. predict in advance

vt. 预想, 预测, 预报

According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
exampleZh: 根据气象预报，明天会是晴天。
天气预报说明天会下雪。

defsEn: n. a group of people or things arranged by class or category
n. the basic cognitive process of arranging into classes or categories
n. restriction imposed by the government on documents or weapons that are available only to certain authorized people

The first biologists worked hard towards the classification of living things.

v. push forcefully
v. press or force
v. force (molten rock) into pre-existing rock

The boy thrust the coin into his pocket.

defsEn: n. something that seduces or has the quality to seduce
n. the desire to have or do something that you know you should avoid

She gave in to the temptation.

她屈服于诱惑了。

defsEn: n. a fierce or audacious person

endangered

If a tiger suddenly appeared in front of me, I'd be scared to death.
exampleZh: 男人戴了一个老虎面具。
如果一只老虎突然出现在我面前，我肯定吓死了。

defsEn: n. something experienced with great delight

v. provide a feast or banquet for

Feast all night and fight all day!

The conductor of this orchestra is a fine musician.

defsEn: n. a person who inhabits a particular place

I am an inhabitant of planet Earth.

defsEn: n. controlling influence

vi. 摇动, 摇摆, 倾斜, 动摇, 统治, 转向
examples: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
They saw the branch sway gently.
exampleZh: 柳枝在微风中轻轻荡悠。

n. a message refusing to accept something that is offered

examples: Tom's bout with diarrhea was foreordained due to Mary's refusal to clean any cookware.
You set me up with your refusal.
exampleZh: 玛丽拒绝洗炊具，汤姆注定会闹肚子。

defsEn: n. a poker hand with all 5 cards in the same suit
n. a sudden rapid flow (as of water)
v. flow freely
v. glow or cause to glow with warm color or light

adv. 齐平地, 直接地

exampleZh: 使用厕所后请冲水。
别忘了冲厕。

Kissing a smoker is like licking an ashtray.

亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。

defsEn: n. an imperfection in a bodily system
n. a failing or deficiency
n. an imperfection in an object or machine
v. desert (a cause, a country or an army), often in order to join the opposing cause, country, or army

examples: This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.
What defect can you find in the present system of education?
exampleZh: 这个系统存在着许多缺陷和不尽完善的地方。

examples: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
He uses a spatula to scrape off advertisements that were stuck on the ground.
exampleZh: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。
他用铲子刮掉黏在地上的广告单。

n. angry criticism
s. showing little if any change

setting right

I suggest a correction to this sentence.

v. become covered with mist

vi. 变模糊, 下雾

不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！

那个谦逊的男人跟邻里相处得很好。

defsEn: n. bedding made of two layers of cloth filled with stuffing and stitched together
v. stitch or sew together
v. create by stitching together
zh: n. 棉被
vt. 加软衬料后缝制, 东拼西凑地编
vi. 缝被子
examples: In winter, I cover myself with a quilt.
My quilt is made of down.
exampleZh: 冬天我盖一条被子。
我的被子是羽绒的。

defsEn: a. able to feel or perceive
s. readily perceived by the senses
s. aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed
zh: a. 有感觉的, 敏感的, 明智的
examples: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
A sensible man wouldn't say such a thing in public.
exampleZh: 你听从她的忠告是明智的。
稍有头脑的人都不会在公众场合里说出这种话来。

defsEn: n. a man who has never been married
v. lead a bachelor's existence
zh: n. 单身汉, 学士
examples: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.
I know Tom is a bachelor.
exampleZh: 汤姆终身未娶。
我知道汤姆是单身。

defsEn: a. pertaining to a process or series of actions for achieving a result
a. (military) of or intended for or involved in military operations
s. being in effect or operation
zh: a. 操作的, 运作的
examples: Can you work on improving operational efficiency?
When will be the El Hamdania seaport operational?

defsEn: v. put together indiscriminately
zh: n. 块, 瘤, 很多, 肿块, 笨人
vt. 使成块状, 混在一起
vi. 结块
examples: That boy threw a lump of rock.
He is a lump of selfishness.
exampleZh: 那个男孩抛了一块石头。
他是个极其自私自利的人。

defsEn: n. a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration
v. masturbate while strangling oneself
v. unite by a scarf joint
v. wrap in or adorn with a scarf
zh: n. 围巾, 头巾, 领带, 领巾, 嵌接
vt. 用围巾围, 嵌接
examples: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
Don't you like my yellow scarf?
exampleZh: 女孩的脖子上围着一条长长的围巾。
你不喜欢我的黄围巾吗？

defsEn: s. directed up
zh: a. 向上的
adv. 以上
examples: The smoke went upward through the chimney.
He was looking upward to the sky.
exampleZh: 烟从烟囱里冒了出来。
他抬头望着天空。

defsEn: v. combine by multiplication
v. combine or increase by multiplication
r. in several ways
in a multiple manner
zh: v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加
examples: Six multiplied by three is eighteen.
Four multiplied by two is eight.
exampleZh: 六乘三等于十八。
四乘以二等于八。

defsEn: v. reproduce someone's behavior or looks
v. appear like, as in behavior or appearance
v. make a reproduction or copy of
zh: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
examples: A parrot can imitate the human voice.
A parrot can imitate human speech.
exampleZh: 鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。
鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。

defsEn: n. a silky densely piled fabric with a plain back
s. smooth and soft to sight or hearing or touch or taste
s. resembling velvet in having a smooth soft surface
zh: n. 天鹅绒
a. 天鹅绒的
examples: If you pick up the velvet, you can feel how soft it is.
The feel of velvet makes me sick to my stomach.

defsEn: n. a sudden noisy expulsion of air from the lungs that clears the air passages
a common symptom of upper respiratory infection or bronchitis or pneumonia or tuberculosis
v. exhale abruptly, as when one has a chest cold or congestion
zh: n. 咳嗽
vi. 咳嗽
vt. 咳出
examples: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
I have a cough and a little fever.
exampleZh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
我咳嗽，还有点发烧。

defsEn: n. a grounder that rolls along the infield
n. a long heavy sea wave as it advances towards the shore
n. a small wheel without spokes (as on a roller skate)
n. a cylinder that revolves
zh: n. 滚筒, 滚轴, 压路机
examples: Can we roller-skate in this park?
The shop's roller door is already shut.
exampleZh: 我们可以在这个公园里玩四轮溜冰吗?
商店的卷帘门已经关上了。

defsEn: n. slices of bread that have been toasted
n. a celebrity who receives much acclaim and attention
v. propose a toast to
zh: n. 吐司, 烤面包, 干杯
vt. 敬酒, 烤, 使暖和
vi. 烤, 烘
examples: Would you like me to butter your toast?
I only had a piece of toast and a cup of coffee this morning.
exampleZh: 你想让我在你的吐司上涂黄油吗？
我今天早上只吃了一块吐司和喝了一杯咖啡。

defsEn: r. with no problems or difficulties
r. in a smooth and diplomatic manner
zh: adv. 平滑地, 流畅地, 流利地
examples: Our journey went smoothly until we ran into a blizzard.
This may not go as smoothly as you hope, Tom.
exampleZh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

defsEn: n. any animals kept for use or profit
zh: n. 家畜
examples: We have ten head of livestock.
Corn is a primary livestock feed.

defsEn: n. a bowl-shaped vessel
usually used for holding food or liquids
n. the quantity that a basin will hold
n. a natural depression in the surface of the land often with a lake at the bottom of it
zh: n. 盆, 盆地
examples: We use basins to hold water and food.
He filled the basin on the washstand with cold water to wash his face.

defsEn: a. relating to or characteristic of heroes of antiquity
s. having or displaying qualities appropriate for heroes
zh: a. 英勇的, 英雄式的, 壮丽雄伟的
n. 英雄诗, 史诗, 英勇行为
examples: It was heroic of them to oppose the enemy.
He is a very heroic figure.

defsEn: n. a person who is entitled by law or by the terms of a will to inherit the estate of another
zh: n. 继承人, 嗣子, 后嗣
examples: Which prince is the legitimate heir to the throne?
Tom is the son and heir to the traditional Japanese inn.

defsEn: v. take out insurance for
zh: vt. 保险, 确保
vi. 投保
examples: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
I would like to insure this package.
exampleZh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。

defsEn: n a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
zh: n. 坟墓, 死亡
vt. 埋葬
examples: In this tomb from the Han dynasty, a book was found.
I fear tomorrow, I fear the tomb, I fear what cannot come back.
exampleZh: 这个汉墓中发现了帛书。

defsEn: a. having or deserving or conferring glory
s. having great beauty and splendor
zh: a. 光荣的
examples: A glorious sight burst on our view.
It's a glorious day. Too good to stay inside.

defsEn: n. the quality of being honest
n. southeastern European plant cultivated for its fragrant purplish flowers and round flat papery silver-white seedpods that are used for indoor decoration
zh: n. 诚实, 公正, 正直
examples: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
Honesty is not always the best policy.
exampleZh: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。
诚实不总是最好的策略。

defsEn: s. experiencing or showing fear
s. extremely distressing
s. timid by nature or revealing timidity
zh: a. 可怕的, 恐怕的, 担心的
examples: What a fearful waste of money!
As I know he is a fearful person.

defsEn: n. highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings
zh: n. 香肠, 腊肠
examples: Have you ever seen sausage being made?
He let the sausage fall to the floor.
exampleZh: 你见过做香肠吗？

defsEn: n a mental position from which things are viewed
zh: n. 立场, 观点
examples: From the standpoint of the law, he is free.
From a grammatical standpoint, that sentence is incorrect.

defsEn: n. the main land mass of a country or continent
as distinguished from an island or peninsula
zh: n. 大陆, 本土
examples: All communication with the mainland was cut off by the typhoon.
There was an epidemic in the mainland.

defsEn: n. a showy gesture
n. an ornamental embellishment in writing
n. a display of ornamental speech or language
n. the act of waving
zh: vi. 繁荣, 茂盛, 活跃, 手舞足蹈
vt. 挥舞, 夸耀
n. 挥舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 兴旺, 华丽词藻
examples: Literature flourishes best when it is half a trade and half an art.
Beauty flourishes in a peaceful heart.

defsEn: v. shake, as from cold
zh: vi. 颤抖, 哆嗦, 被打碎
vt. 使迎风飘动, 粉碎
n. 战栗, 碎块
examples: I shiver just thinking about snakes.
The terrible scene sent shivers down his spine.
exampleZh: 一想到蛇就发颤。
恐怖的场面让了他颤抖。

defsEn: n. the sudden giving off of energy
n. the act of venting
n. a substance that is emitted or released
n. any of several bodily processes by which substances go out of the body
zh: vt. 卸下, 放出, 解雇, 拔染, 履行, 放电
vi. 卸货, 流出
n. 卸货, 流出, 放电
examples: Your honor, I would like to discharge counsel.
I have to discharge my duty.

defsEn: n. act of changing in practice or custom
n. a shaving created when something is produced by turning it on a lathe
n. a movement in a new direction
n. the end-product created by shaping something on a lathe
zh: n. 旋转, 转弯处, 车削工作
examples: Would you mind turning the light down a bit?
Turning to the right, you will find the hospital.

defsEn: n. the perception that something has occurred or some state exists
n. the act of detecting something
catching sight of something
n. a police investigation to determine the perpetrator
zh: n. 发现, 察觉, 探测
examples: Early detection is the key to achieving favourable outcomes in the treatment of disease.
Fake news detection uses natural language processing.

defsEn: n. a seat for the rider of a horse or camel
n. cut of meat (especially mutton or lamb) consisting of part of the backbone and both loins
n. a piece of leather across the instep of a shoe
n. posterior part of the back of a domestic fowl
zh: n. 鞍, 马鞍, 车座, 鞍状物
vt. 装以马鞍, 使负担
vi. 跨上马鞍
examples: She saddled him with the work.
You should learn how to saddle a horse.
exampleZh: 她强迫他做这个工作。

defsEn: n. an instance of something occurring
zh: n. 发生, 事件, 出现
examples: He's comfortable with this kind of occurrence.
The occurrence of the disease is very rare.

defsEn: a. present in great quantity
zh: a. 丰富的, 充分的, 大量的
examples: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.
The United States is abundant in natural resources.
exampleZh: 粮食供应十分充足。
美国的自然资源很丰富。

defsEn: n. the act of liberating someone or something
n. the attempt to achieve equal rights or status
zh: n. 释放, 解放
examples: The National Liberation Front party has no clear ideology.
The Algerian war of liberation killed over a million and a half people.

defsEn: n. the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled
n. a hand tool with a heavy rigid head and a handle
used to deliver an impulsive force by striking
n. a heavy metal sphere attached to a flexible wire
used in the hammer throw
n. a striker that is covered in felt and that causes the piano strings to vibrate
zh: n. 锤, 铁锤, 钉锤
vt. 锤打, 敲打, 钉
vi. 连续锤打
examples: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?
The hammer and sickle stand for communism.
exampleZh: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。
锤子与镰刀代表共产主义。

defsEn: s. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity
s. strong and active physically or mentally
zh: a. 精力充沛的, 元气旺盛的, 茁壮的, 有力的
examples: You will be more vigorous if you exercise.
No matter how vigorous the lie, you cannot escape the truth.

defsEn: a. not disposed or inclined toward
s. in spite of contrary volition
zh: a. 不愿意的, 勉强的
examples: You seem to be unwilling to do that.
You appear unwilling to do that.

defsEn: s. moving slowly and gently
zh: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的
vi. 懒散
examples: As far as I know he is not lazy.
He is very hard on lazy people.
exampleZh: 就我所知，他不懒。
他对懒惰的人很严厉。

defsEn: n. (computer science) a message or message fragment
n. a small package or bundle
zh: n. 小包, 一批信件, 大量, 信息包
vt. 打包, 装进小包
examples: I'd like a packet of aspirin.
I bought two packets of pistachios.
exampleZh: 我要一盒阿司匹林。
买了两包开心果。

defsEn: s. (followed by `of' or `to') having a strong preference or liking for
s. absurd or silly because unlikely
zh: a. 喜欢的, 宠爱的, 温柔的
examples: I'm not fond of the customer service industry.
I'm not fond of the customer service business.
exampleZh: 我不喜欢客服业。
我不喜欢客服业。

defsEn: a. relating to photography or obtained by using photography
s. representing people or nature with the exactness and fidelity of a photograph
zh: a. 照相的, 摄影用的, 详细记录的, 逼真的, 酷似的
examples: Her photographic memory makes her a great witness.
You don't need a photographic memory if you study hard.

defsEn: n the environmental condition
n the area in which something exists or lives
v extend on all sides of simultaneously
encircle
v envelop completely
v surround so as to force to give up
v surround with a wall in order to fortify
zh: n. 环境, 周围的事物
examples: No sign of the enemy in our surroundings.
He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
exampleZh: 在我们的周围没有敌人的迹象。
他很快就适应了新环境。

defsEn: s of hair color
pale yellowish to yellowish brown
a resembling or containing or abounding in sand
or growing in sandy areas
zh: a. 沙的, 沙地的, 多沙的
examples: The town has a long sandy beach.
The white sandy beach is very beautiful.

defsEn: n. the comparative form of an adjective or adverb
a. relating to or based on or involving comparison
zh: a. 比较的, 相对的
n. 对手
examples: I study comparative religion in the arts faculty of the University of Turku.
Comparative language study is perhaps the best method of learning foreign languages.
exampleZh: 我在图尔库大学文化系学习宗教比较学。

defsEn: n. time available for ease and relaxation
n. freedom to choose a pastime or enjoyable activity
zh: n. 空闲, 闲暇, 悠闲
a. 空闲的, 有闲的
examples: I often spend my leisure time listening to the radio.
Is there any leisure in China?
exampleZh: 我常常在我的闲暇时候听广播。
中国有什么闲暇吗？

defsEn: v. expel (gases or odors)
v. give off, send forth, or discharge
as of light, heat, or radiation, vapor, etc.
zh: vt. 发出, 放射, 发表(意见等), 散发, 发行
examples: The flower emitted a foul odor.
The alien emitted electricity, causing the van to move.

defsEn: n. personal knowledge or information about someone or something
n. a relationship less intimate than friendship
n. a person with whom you are acquainted
zh: n. 认识, 相识者
examples: I have some acquaintance with chemistry.
She is more of an acquaintance than a friend.
exampleZh: 我对化学略懂一二。
与其说她是我的朋友，不如说她只是一个我认识的人。

defsEn: r. to a remarkable degree or extent
zh: adv. 不寻常地, 异乎寻常地, (非正式)非常
examples: I feel unusually awake despite it being the middle of the night.
Unusually low temperatures account for the poor rice crop this year.

defsEn: n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
n. open disrespect for a person or thing
n. a willful disobedience to or disrespect for the authority of a court or legislative body
zh: n. 轻视, 轻蔑
examples: I have nothing but contempt for these people.
I feel nothing but contempt for such behavior.

defsEn: n. the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position
v. put at a disadvantage
hinder, harm
zh: n. 缺点, 不利, 坏处
examples: The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.
We can change our disadvantage to our advantage.
exampleZh: 两相比较，他那边的形势更不利一些。

defsEn: n. a piece of braid, usually on the sleeve, indicating military rank or length of service
n. a kind or category
n. a narrow marking of a different color or texture from the background
v. mark with stripes
zh: n. 斑纹, 条纹
examples: The bird had a dark stripe running down the medial part of each feather.

defsEn: s. preceding all others in spatial position
s. situated closest to the bow
r. prominently forward
zh: a. 最初的, 最重要的
adv. 在最前
examples: I told it to my mother first and foremost.
First and foremost, watch what you eat.

defsEn: v. utter aloud
often with surprise, horror, or joy
zh: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大声叫
examples: He exclaimed that I should not touch the gun.
After exclaiming about how lazy I was, my mother hit me.

defsEn: n. an emotion of great sadness associated with loss or bereavement
n. sadness associated with some wrong done or some disappointment
zh: n. 悲伤, 哀惜, 不幸
vi. 悲伤, 懊悔, 遗憾
examples: The loss of his mother brought him sorrow and regret.
His mother's passing brought him sorrow and regret.
exampleZh: 他母亲的离世带给他悲伤和遗憾。
他母亲的离世带给他悲伤和遗憾。

defsEn: v to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
v do something to an excessive degree
zh: v. 夸大, 夸张
examples: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
Do you not find that you exaggerate a bit?
exampleZh: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。

defsEn: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one
s. being one more than sixteen
zh: num. 十七, 十七个
examples: She will be seventeen next year.
A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
exampleZh: 她明年将满十七岁。
十七岁的男孩常常长得和他父亲一样高。

defsEn: s. suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival
zh: a. 嫉妒的, 羡慕的, 留心的, 戒备的
examples: You must not be jealous of others' success.
I suppose I felt a little jealous.
exampleZh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
我想我感到有点嫉妒。

defsEn: n. (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
zh: n. 祝贺, 问候
examples: Greetings for every person who will read this letter.
Greetings to you who come to Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia of education in Greek.

defsEn: n. refusal to accept some authority or code or convention
n. organized opposition to authority
a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another
zh: n. 谋反, 叛乱, 反抗
examples: He put down the rebellion in India.
I see this as an act of rebellion against your parents.

defsEn: n. low land that is seasonally flooded
has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog
n. a situation fraught with difficulties and imponderables
v. drench or submerge or be drenched or submerged
zh: n. 沼泽, 进退两难的困境
vt. 淹没, 击溃, 清除, 使陷于沼泽
vi. 陷于沼泽, 淹没
examples: I don't mean to swamp you.
We need to cross this swamp.
exampleZh: 我不想把你淹死。

defsEn: n. distinctive and stylish elegance
n. a quick run
n. a footrace run at top speed
n. the longer of the two telegraphic signals used in Morse code
zh: n. 冲撞, 破折号, 短跑
vi. 猛冲, 冲撞
vt. 泼溅, 使猛撞, 搀和, 使破灭, 使沮丧
examples: I prefer corn with a dash of pepper.
Would you like a dash of milk in your tea?

defsEn: s. carefully thought out in advance
zh: a. 深思熟虑的, 故意的, 从容的
v. 仔细考虑
examples: The government will deliberate on the matter tomorrow.
We must deliberate seriously on trade deficit.

defsEn: n. the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written
zh: n. 用法, 使用, 习惯, 惯用法, 习惯法
examples: In common usage, "economic freedom" often refers to unfettered economic exploitation.
To cite usage against rule, in a constructed language, is insane.

defsEn: n. an open skin infection
zh: a. 悲伤的, 痛的, 引起痛苦的
n. 痛处, 溃疡, 疮
examples: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
I had sore legs the next day.
exampleZh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。
第二天我的腿很酸。

defsEn: a. upright in position or posture
zh: a. 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的
vt. 使竖立, 使直立, 树立, 建立
vi. 勃起
examples: Sandbags can be used to erect a temporary wall to protect against floods.
Ziri erected a wooden cross in the middle of the clearing.

defsEn: n. a son of your brother or sister
zh: n. 侄子, 外甥
examples: She's waiting to pick up her nephew.
My nephew is more than twenty years older than me.
exampleZh: 她等着接侄子。
我的侄子比我大了二十来岁。

defsEn: n. any substance such as manure or a mixture of nitrates used to make soil more fertile
zh: n. 肥料, 促进发展者, 受精媒介物
examples: What kind of fertilizer do you use?
Ziri used a liquid fertilizer to supplement the soil.

defsEn: n. elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface
n. the perpendicular distance from the base of a geometric figure to the opposite vertex (or side if parallel)
zh: n. 高度, 海拔, 高处
examples: At that altitude the weather can change rapidly without warning.
At this altitude, the weather can change quickly and without warning.

defsEn: n. a light within the field of vision that is brighter than the brightness to which the eyes are adapted
n. an angry stare
v. be sharply reflected
v. shine intensely
zh: n. 闪耀光, 刺眼
vi. 发眩光, 瞪视
vt. 瞪眼表示
examples: The summer sun glared down on us.
He shot me down with a glare.
exampleZh: 夏日的阳光照在我们身上。

defsEn: n. United States blues musician who transcribed and published traditional blues music (1873-1958)
s. easy to reach
s. easy to use
s. skillful with the hands
zh: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的
examples: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.
She is handy with a needle.
exampleZh: 我会将这则资讯记下来，以便未来参考。
她擅长针线活。

defsEn: v. work together on a common enterprise of project
v. cooperate as a traitor
zh: vi. 合作, 勾结
examples: Who do you want to collaborate with?
They collaborate on a new project.

defsEn: n. a group of people or things arranged or following in order
n. the action of following in order
n. (ecology) the gradual and orderly process of change in an ecosystem brought about by the progressive replacement of one community by another until a stable climax is established
n. acquisition of property by descent or by will
zh: n. 连续, 继承权, 继位, 演替, 地层次序
examples: At the moment, there is not succession.
He came to the throne by succession.

defsEn: n. concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement
n. a building material that is a powder made of a mixture of calcined limestone and clay
used with water and sand or gravel to make concrete and mortar
n. something that hardens to act as adhesive material
n. any of various materials used by dentists to fill cavities in teeth
zh: n. 水泥, 胶结剂
vt. 胶合, 用水泥涂
vi. 黏牢
examples: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
Don't sit on the cement floor.
exampleZh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
别坐在水泥地上。

defsEn: v. repeat aloud from memory
v. render verbally, "recite a poem"
zh: v. 背诵, 朗读, 叙述
examples: His daughter is able to recite a lot of poems.
Please recite me at least a poem tonight.
exampleZh: 他的女儿能背诵很多诗。

defsEn: n. (American football) blocking a player's path with your body
zh: n. 冲突, 干涉
examples: I won't allow you to continue your interference in my daughter's life.
There is no guarantee that interference will not occur in a particular installation.
exampleZh: 我不允许你继续干涉我女儿的生活。

defsEn: n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)
n. the act of spoiling something by causing damage to it
n. the act of stripping and taking by force
v. become unfit for consumption or use
zh: n. 战利品, 赃物, 奖品, 变质, 次品
vt. 损坏, 破坏, 溺爱
vi. 腐坏, 掠夺
examples: You should not spoil a kid too much.
I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
exampleZh: 孩子不能太惯了。
我不想把结局提前透露给你。

defsEn: n. a special loved one
n. an Australian river
tributary of the Murray River
zh: n. 亲爱的, 可爱的人, 可爱的物
a. 可爱的, 亲爱的
examples: My sweet darling, I miss you so much.
Darling, do you remember our first kiss?

defsEn: n. reception room in an inn or club where visitors can be received
zh: n. 客厅, 会客室, 小店
a. 客厅的
examples: Sami took Layla to a tea parlor.
How far is the funeral parlor from the cemetery?
exampleZh: 萨米带莱拉去了一家茶馆。

defsEn: n. clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing
n. a supplementary component that improves capability
n. someone who helps another person commit a crime
s. furnishing added support
zh: n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 从犯, 同谋
a. 附属的, 补充的, 同谋的, 帮凶的, 非主要的, 副的
examples: Tom may be an accessory to murder.
The police think you're an accessory.

defsEn: s. having intervening factors or persons or influences
a. not direct in spatial dimension
not leading by a straight line or course to a destination
a. extended senses
not direct in manner or language or behavior or action
s. not as a direct effect or consequence
zh: a. 间接的, 非直截了当的, 不坦率的
examples: Would they really be so indirect?
Indirect communication is the primary form of communication used by girls.

defsEn: n. a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
n. a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger
n. the elasticity and hardness of a metal object
its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking
v. harden by reheating and cooling in oil
zh: n. (钢等的)硬度, 脾气, 心情, 中和剂, 倾向, 回火
vt. 使回火, 锻炼, 调和, 使缓和
vi. 回火
examples: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
She has a bit of a bad temper.
exampleZh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
她脾气有点坏。

defsEn: v. develop or come to a promising stage
zh: n. 花, 花开的状态, 兴旺期
vi. 开花, 兴旺, 发展
examples: This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.
The blossoms will be out in a few days.
exampleZh: 本周公园樱花盛开。
过两三天就要开花了。

defsEn: n. a craft capable of traveling in outer space
technically, a satellite around the sun
zh: n. 航天飞船
examples: The spacecraft began heading into deep space.
It is illegal to build a homemade spacecraft and fly to the moon.

defsEn: n. any sharply pointed projection
n. tubular extension at the base of the corolla in some flowers
n. a sharp prod fixed to a rider's heel and used to urge a horse onward
v. incite or stimulate
zh: n. 马刺, 刺激物, 鼓舞
vt. 刺激, 激励, 用马刺策(马)前进
vi. 用马刺驱马, 疾驰
examples: I try to spur you on to improve.
Ideas occur to me on the spur of the moment.

defsEn: n. the sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture
n. the act of signalling (e.g., summoning) by whistling or blowing a whistle
n. a small wind instrument that produces a whistling sound by blowing into it
n. acoustic device that forces air or steam against an edge or into a cavity and so produces a loud shrill sound
zh: n. 口哨, 汽笛, 啸啸声, 口哨声
vi. 吹口哨, 鸣汽笛, 发嘘嘘声
vt. 用口哨或吹哨传意, 用口哨演奏
examples: Do you know how to whistle?
A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.
exampleZh: 你会吹口哨吗？
汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。

defsEn: a. disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings
zh: a. 使人不愉快的, 使人厌恶的, 煞风景的
examples: An unpleasant feeling is always bad.
We had an unpleasant experience there.
exampleZh: 不愉快的感觉永远不好。
我们在那里有一个不愉快的经历。

defsEn: v. fasten by sewing
do needlework
v. create (clothes) with cloth
zh: vt. 缝纫, 缝合, 缝
vi. 缝纫
examples: Do you have a sewing needle?
Did you sew this by hand?
exampleZh: 你有没有缝衣针？
是用手缝的吗？

defsEn: v. dirty with mud
v. cause to become muddy
v. make turbid
zh: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的
vt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污
examples: Who left these muddy footprints on the front porch?
You muddy the waters in order to catch fish.

defsEn: n. the mechanical advantage gained by being in a position to use a lever
n. strategic advantage
power to act effectively
n. investing with borrowed money as a way to amplify potential gains (at the risk of greater losses)
v. supplement with leverage
zh: n. 杠杆作用, 杠杆装置, 杠杆效率
examples: This grants Algeria political leverage in the region.
We need leverage if we're going to lift this.

defsEn: s. moist as with undried perspiration and with clothing sticking to the body
s. covered with an adhesive material
zh: a. 粘的, 有粘性的, 顽固的
examples: Use the sticky tape to put the poster up.
This sticky liquid can be used as a glue.

defsEn: n. a funeral lament sung with loud wailing
s. having a sharp cutting edge or point
zh: a. 锋利的, 敏锐的, 强烈的, 敏捷的, 热心的, 渴望的
n. 挽歌, 痛哭
v. 唱挽歌, 痛哭
examples: You have a keen sense of direction.
Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
exampleZh: 你的方向感很好。
狗的嗅觉灵敏。

defsEn: a. of or pertaining to or of the nature of mathematics
s. beyond question
s. statistically possible though highly improbable
s. characterized by the exactness or precision of mathematics
zh: a. 数学的, 精确的
examples: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
Takeo is engrossed in solving mathematical problems.
exampleZh: 他擅长解答数学难题。
建夫专心致志地解决数学问题。

defsEn: n (mathematics) a number of the form a+bi where a and b are real numbers and i is the square root of -1
s not based on fact
unreal
zh: a. 想像的, 虚构的, 假想的
examples: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
You say Nessie is an imaginary being, but I think she exists.
exampleZh: 龙是人幻想出来的生物。
你说尼斯湖水怪是虚构的，但我觉得它真实存在。

defsEn: v. be compatible or in accordance with
v. follow through or carry out a plan without deviation
v. be a devoted follower or supporter
v. stick to firmly
zh: vi. 依附, 粘着, 坚持, 追随, 拥护
vt. 使粘附
examples: He adhered to the original plan.
I would never adhere to a secret society.
exampleZh: 他坚持原来的计划。

defsEn: n. a fundamental principle or practice
n. a prominent supporter
zh: n. 柱子, 栋梁, 台柱, 重要的支持者
examples: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
My daughter is the pillar of my life.
exampleZh: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。

defsEn: a. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance
s. relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
zh: a. 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不稳定的, 不舒服的
examples: I write everything down; I feel uneasy without my notebook.
She felt uneasy at the thought of her future.
exampleZh: 我无论是什么东西也要记进笔记本里；没有了笔记本，我就会浑身不自在。
想到自己的未来，她不安起来。

defsEn: n. a vehicle with wheels drawn by one or more horses
n. characteristic way of bearing one's body
n. a machine part that carries something else
zh: n. 马车, 客车, 举止, 运输
examples: Carriage and conduct reveal more than the face.
The first-class carriage is at the front of the train.

defsEn: n. alert carnivorous mammal with pointed muzzle and ears and a bushy tail
most are predators that do not hunt in packs
n. the grey or reddish-brown fur of a fox
n. English statesman who supported American independence and the French Revolution (1749-1806)
n. English religious leader who founded the Society of Friends (1624-1691)
zh: n. 狐狸, 狡猾的人
vi. 奸狡地行动, (书页)生斑, 变酸
vt. 欺骗, 使变酸, 为(鞋等)换面, 使生黄斑
examples: The quick brown fox did not jump over the lazy dog.
The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
exampleZh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸没有跃过懒洋洋的狗。
身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

defsEn: n. a person who carries a message
zh: n. 报信者, 使者
examples: A messenger took the letter to the White House.
Muslims accept Jesus as a messenger of God.

defsEn: n. the paved surface of a thoroughfare
zh: n. 路面, 人行道, 铺面路, 铺路材料
examples: I found a coin on the pavement.
Spread the goods on the pavement so that people can see them.

defsEn: s slightly wet
zh: a. 潮湿的, 多雨的, 感伤的, 含泪的
examples: This earth is moist owing to the recent rain.
I crave a slice of moist carrot cake.

defsEn: n. a wheeled vehicle with large wheels
used in farming and other applications
n. a truck that has a cab but no body
used for pulling large trailers or vans
zh: n. 牵引器, 拖拉机, 拉纸器
examples: I can't get my tractor started.
Could you teach me how to drive a tractor?
exampleZh: 我发动不了我的拖拉机。

defsEn: s. lacking in or deprived of strength or power
s. unable to function
without help
s. unable to manage independently
zh: a. 无助的, 无能为力的, 无依无靠的
examples: I may be drunk, but not helpless.
I feel helpless most of the time.

defsEn: n distance travelled per unit time
zh: n. 速度, 迅速
examples: The average wind velocity is very low.

defsEn: a. full of or characterized by loud and nonmusical sounds
s. attracting attention by showiness or bright colors
zh: a. 嘈杂的, 喧闹的
examples: How's the neighborhood? Quiet? Noisy at night?
He admonished them for being noisy.
exampleZh: 周围环境怎么样？静不静？夜晚闹不闹？
他告诫他们不要吵闹。

defsEn: a. happening or arising without apparent external cause
zh: a. 自然的, 自发的, 未经琢磨的
examples: I wish I could be more spontaneous.
He surprised her with a spontaneous trip.

defsEn: s. being of delicate or slender build
s. very narrow
s. having little width in proportion to the length or height
s. small in quantity
zh: a. 苗条的, 纤弱的, 微少的, 微薄的
examples: We have only a slender chance of success.
In that slender body, where does it all go?

defsEn: n. the best time of youth
n. a rosy color (especially in the cheeks) taken as a sign of good health
v. produce or yield flowers
zh: n. 花, 开花, 青春, 钢块
vi. 开花, 焕发青春, 茂盛
vt. 使茂盛, 把...轧成钢坯
examples: These flowers bloom earlier than the others do.
The roses in the garden are blooming.
exampleZh: 这些花比别的花早开花。
在花园里的玫瑰正盛开着。

defsEn: n. jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women)
zh: n. 项链
examples: Mademoiselle, would you like a platinum necklace to accompany your ring?
My nan gave me this necklace.
exampleZh: 小姐已经有一个戒指，要不要配一条铂金项链？
这条项链是我奶奶送给我的。

defsEn: n a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers
zh: n. 旅馆, 客栈
vi. 住旅馆
examples: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
I go into the middle of the inn.
exampleZh: 火警发生在他们住的旅馆。

defsEn: n. a toiletry that emits and diffuses a fragrant odor
v. fill or impregnate with an odor
v. apply perfume to
zh: n. 香水, 香气, (悦人的)气氛, 美名
vt. 洒香水于, 薰香, 使充满香气
examples: The perfume of roses filled the room.
When I put on this perfume, I feel a little bit more popular.
exampleZh: 玫瑰的香气在房间的每一个角落里飘荡着。

defsEn: n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines who ranks above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier general
zh: n. 陆军上校, 长官
examples: The Colonel said the situation is under control.
Colonel Moran will trouble us no more.

defsEn: n. a church congregation guided by a pastor
n. a group of birds
n. a group of sheep or goats
v. move as a crowd or in a group
zh: n. 兽群, 鸟群, 一群人, 大量, 棉束
vi. 成群而行, 聚集
vt. 用棉束填满
examples: Birds of a feather flock together.
Let the flock out to feed.
exampleZh: 物以类聚。

defsEn: n a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it
s rounded like an egg
zh: n. 椭圆形
a. 卵形的, 椭圆形的
examples: The oval office is in the White House.
An egg is not round but oval.

defsEn: n. small and light boat
pointed at both ends
propelled with a paddle
v. travel by canoe
zh: n. 独木舟, 轻舟
vi. 乘独木舟
vt. 用独木舟运
examples: We went down a river by canoe.
I want to buy a canoe.
exampleZh: 我们乘着独木舟向河的下游而行。

defsEn: n. a journey to some distant place
v. travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
zh: n. 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空
vi. 航海, 航行
vt. 航行越过, 飞过
examples: I wish you a pleasant voyage.
Mary went on a voyage around the world.
exampleZh: 祝你旅途愉快。
玛丽去环游世界了。

defsEn: n. United States meat-packer who began the use of refrigerated railroad cars (1839-1903)
n. an English satirist born in Ireland (1667-1745)
n. a small bird that resembles a swallow and is noted for its rapid flight
zh: n. 褐雨燕, 快速爬行的小蜥蜴, 蝙蝠蛾, 大滚筒
a. 迅速的, 快的, 敏捷的, 立刻的
adv. 迅速地, 敏捷地
examples: The stream is not very swift.
Will justice be swift in this case?
exampleZh: 水流不是很急。

defsEn: v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect
v. cause the ruin or downfall of
zh: vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱
vi. 松开
examples: Undo the wrapper carefully so as not to damage the jelly baby.
Let one undo my shoes, lest from afar an envious look should smite me.

defsEn: v. make timid or fearful
v. to compel or deter by or as if by threats
zh: vt. 威胁, 恐吓
examples: Tom didn't seem to be intimidated.
Mother intimidates you. You think that she is a big woman.
exampleZh: 汤姆似乎没有被吓到。

defsEn: n. a male grandchild
zh: n. 孙子, 外孙
examples: Perhaps my grandson will be the first person to land on Mars.
My grandson is still a baby.
exampleZh: 可能我的孙子会是登陆火星的第一人。
我的孙子还是个婴儿。

defsEn: n. a cord that is drawn through eyelets or around hooks in order to draw together two edges (as of a shoe or garment)
n. a delicate decorative fabric woven in an open web of symmetrical patterns
v. do lacework
v. draw through eyes or holes
zh: n. 饰带, 花边, 缎带, 鞋带
vt. 结带子, 饰以花边
vi. 系带子
examples: She has this pretty lace nightgown with straps.
She laced the cake with poison.
exampleZh: 她的这件吊带蕾丝睡衣很漂亮。

defsEn: n. a small piece of cloth or paper
n. a week at British universities during which side-shows and processions of floats are organized to raise money for charities
n. a boisterous practical joke (especially by college students)
v. play in ragtime
zh: n. 碎布, 抹布, 碎片, 碎屑, 少量, 破旧衣服
vt. 责骂, 揶揄, 戏弄
vi. 喧闹
examples: War is like a raging fire.
Grab a rag and help me clean up this mess.
exampleZh: 战争如火如荼。

defsEn: s. impervious to being affected
zh: n. 抵抗者, 反抗者
a. 抵抗的, 反抗的, 耐...的
examples: No animal is as resistant in the desert as a camel.
This car is resistant to rust.

defsEn: n. bowed stringed instrument that is the highest member of the violin family
this instrument has four strings and a hollow body and an unfretted fingerboard and is played with a bow
zh: n. 小提琴
examples: He plays the violin very well.
She plays the violin very well.
exampleZh: 他小提琴拉得很好。
她小提琴演奏得非常好。

defsEn: n. a person who has lied or who lies repeatedly
zh: n. 说谎者
examples: You may call him a liar, but you cannot call him a bad man.
A liar needs to have a good memory.
exampleZh: 你可以说他是个骗子, 但是你不能称他为坏人。
说谎的人需要很好的记忆力。

defsEn: v. bind by an obligation
cause to be indebted
v. provide a service or favor for someone
zh: vt. 强制, 施恩惠于, 使感激
vi. 施恩惠, 帮忙
examples: She was obliged to marry the old man.
She was obliged to give up the plan.
exampleZh: 她不得不和这个老男人结婚。
她不得不放弃这个计划。

defsEn: n. a man's sleeveless garment worn underneath a coat
v. place (authority, property, or rights) in the control of a person or group of persons
v. become legally vested
v. clothe oneself in ecclesiastical garments
zh: n. 背心, 汗背心
vt. 使穿衣服, 授予
vi. 穿衣服, 归属
examples: You need to reverse your vest. It's inside-out!
Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
exampleZh: 背心反了， 要翻一个面。
汤姆穿着一件防弹衣，所以子弹没把他杀死。

defsEn: v inquire about
v have a wish or desire to know something
v conduct an inquiry or investigation of
zh: v. 询问, 问明, 查究
examples: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
exampleZh: 委员会调查了事故的原因。
她有勇气去查询考试的结果。

defsEn: n. the sound like water splashing
n. a patch of bright color
n. the act of scattering water about haphazardly
v. mark or overlay with patches of contrasting color or texture
cause to appear splashed or spattered
zh: n. 飞溅, 污点, 一点儿, 溅泼声, 色斑
vi. 溅湿, 溅开, 飞溅
vt. 溅, 泼, 使溅起水, 洒, 使成斑驳状
examples: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.
Tom and I splashed each other.
exampleZh: 车子经过的时候把泥水溅到了我的身上。
汤姆和我溅了对方。

defsEn: n. a soiled or discolored appearance
n. (microscopy) a dye or other coloring material that is used in microscopy to make structures visible
v. color with a liquid dye or tint
v. produce or leave stains
zh: n. 污染, 污点, 着色剂
vt. 沾染, 染污, 着色
vi. 变脏
examples: His shirt was stained with sauce.
If you wash it, the stain will come out.
exampleZh: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。

defsEn: s socially incorrect in behavior
s (of persons) lacking in refinement or grace
a lacking civility or good manners
s (used especially of commodities) being unprocessed or manufactured using only simple or minimal processes
s belonging to an early stage of technical development
characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
zh: a. 粗鲁无礼的, 粗陋的, 粗暴的, 原始的, 未开化的, 大略的, 崎岖不平的, 狂暴的
examples: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
It is rude of him not to give me a call.
exampleZh: 在公开场合开你老板的玩笑是无礼的。
他不打电话给我，真没礼貌。

defsEn: v. put quickly or forcibly
v. cause to strike the air in flight
v. clap one's hands together
v. strike the air in flight
zh: n. 拍手, 拍手声, 霹雳声, 花柳病
v. 鼓掌, (使)啪地关上
examples: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.
All the students clapped their hands.
exampleZh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
所有的学生都拍手。

defsEn: n. a landowner who leases to others
zh: n. 房东, 地主
examples: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
exampleZh: 东家说要提高租金。
为什么这个月房东还不来收房租？

defsEn: v. make deeper
v. become deeper in tone
zh: vi. 深化
vt. 使加深, 使强烈
examples: The purpose of this text is to deepen the understanding of black culture.
Knowledge deepens our connection to the world.

defsEn: v. overcome by conquest
zh: vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜
vi. 得胜
examples: I came, I saw, I conquered.
Do you know who conquered Mt. Everest first?
exampleZh: 我来，我见，我征服。
你知道是谁第一个征服珠穆朗玛峰的吗?

defsEn: n. the action of fetching
v. be sold for a certain price
v. take away or remove
zh: n. 取得, 拿, 诡计, 魂
vt. 接来, 取来, 售得, 带来, 推出, 引出, 杀死, 吸引, 到达
vi. 取物, 前进
examples: Can you fetch the children from school?
Go downstairs and fetch me a bottle of wine!
exampleZh: 你能去学校接小孩吗？

defsEn: n. an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution
s. describing a circle
moving in a circle
zh: a. 圆形的, 循环的, 间接的
examples: I put the circular in the post box.
I put the circular in the mail box.

defsEn: s. void of thought or knowledge
s. without an occupant or incumbent
zh: a. 空的, 空白的, 空虚的, 空闲的, 茫然的, 空缺的
examples: He was standing there with a vacant look.
I live next to a vacant house.
exampleZh: 他站在那里,一脸茫然。

defsEn: n. the extent of something from side to side
zh: n. 宽度, 宽广, 广博
examples: What's the width of this road?
What is the height, length and width of the container?
exampleZh: 这条路的宽度是多少？

defsEn: n. the side or slope of a hill
zh: n. 山坡, 山腹
examples: The hillside had torrential flooding from the west.
I'm planning to stay at the Hillside Hotel.
exampleZh: 山坡让滔滔的洪水往西流。

defsEn: v exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
v lose interest or become bored with something or somebody
s physically and mentally fatigued
zh: a. 疲倦的, 萎靡的, 厌倦的, 厌烦的
vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦
vi. 疲乏, 生厌, 不耐烦
examples: He will soon be weary of the task.
But he was sick and weary; and he soon fell sound asleep.

defsEn: n. an applicant likely to be chosen
a. likely but not certain to be or become true or real
s. apparently destined
zh: a. 很可能的, 大概的, 可信的
n. 很有希望的候选人, 很可能的事情
examples: When will the most probable hypothetical accident occur?
It is probable that he will win the speech contest.
exampleZh: 最大可能假想事故什么时候会发生？

defsEn: a. deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
zh: a. 难得的, 稀罕的, 缺乏的
examples: Rain is scarce in this country.
The water was scarce in the desert.
exampleZh: 这个国家降雨量少。

defsEn: r. in these times
zh: n. 现在, 现时, 当今
adv. 时下, 现今
examples: Nowadays many people travel by car.
Nowadays it's not possible to protect oneself against weapons of mass destruction.
exampleZh: 现在很多人开车去旅行。
如今已经没什么能防范大规模杀伤性武器了。

defsEn: n. (Roman Catholic Church) an antiphon (usually from the Book of Psalms) immediately after the epistle at Mass
a. proceeding in small stages
a. (of a topographical gradient) not steep or abrupt
zh: a. 逐渐的, 渐增的
n. 弥撒升阶圣歌
examples: Gradual changes take place in our city every year.
Embracing the unknown can be a gradual process.

defsEn: n. a feeling of aversion or antipathy
v. have or feel a dislike or distaste for
zh: n. 嫌恶
vt. 讨厌, 不喜欢
examples: Although Hiroko dislikes cigarette smoke, she readily goes out drinking with friends.
I don't like teachers who dislike students that ask questions.
exampleZh: 虽然弘子不喜欢香烟的烟雾，她却乐意和朋友出去喝酒。
我讨厌不喜欢学生问问题的老师。

defsEn: n. (Christianity) the abode of righteous souls after death
zh: n. 天堂, 乐园, 伊甸园
examples: The island is a paradise for children.
This park is a paradise for little kids.
exampleZh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
这个公园是小孩子的天堂。

defsEn: n. a compound made artificially by chemical reactions
a. involving or of the nature of synthesis (combining separate elements to form a coherent whole) as opposed to analysis
a. systematic combining of root and modifying elements into single words
a. of a proposition whose truth value is determined by observation or facts
zh: n. 合成物质
a. 综合(性)的, 人造的, 合成的
examples: They want to create a synthetic life form.
The German language is a synthetic language.

defsEn: r. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
zh: adv. 完全地, 整个, 统统, 全部
examples: Her words were wholly void of meaning.
But if we were wholly rational, would we want children at all?
exampleZh: 她的话毫无意义。

defsEn: n. 14th President of the United States (1804-1869)
v. cut or make a way through
v. move or affect (a person's emotions or bodily feelings) deeply or sharply
v. sound sharply or shrilly
zh: vt. 刺穿, 穿透, 打眼于, 洞悉, (声音)响彻, (亮光)照进, 深深地打动
vi. 刺入, 穿入, 透入, 进入
examples: He watched a video on how to pierce his belly button safely.
The cold this morning pierced you to the bone.

defsEn: n. English physicist who studied electromagnetic radiation and was a pioneer of radiotelegraphy (1851-1940)
n. small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion
usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener
n. a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter
n. any of various Native American dwellings
zh: n. 小屋, 门房, 支部, 旅舍, 分会
vi. 临时住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿
vt. 安顿, 容纳, 提出, 把...射入, 存放
examples: I want to lodge a formal complaint.
Who's the best person to lodge a complaint with?

defsEn: a. relating to or located in the atmosphere
zh: a. 大气的
examples: Venus' atmospheric pressure is very high.
Without sufficient atmospheric pressure, body fluids will start to boil.
exampleZh: 金星的大气压力非常高。

defsEn: n. sweet juicy gritty-textured fruit available in many varieties
n. Old World tree having sweet gritty-textured juicy fruit
widely cultivated in many varieties
zh: n. 梨子, 梨树, 梨木
examples: This is a pear, not an apple.
My lunch was an apple and pears and pomegranate.
exampleZh: 这是只梨，不是苹果。
我午餐吃了苹果、梨子和石榴。

defsEn: a. having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude
a. of verbs
having neither person nor number nor mood (as a participle or gerund or infinitive)
s. total and all-embracing
zh: n. 无限, 神
a. 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的
examples: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
There's no doubt: the universe is infinite.
exampleZh: 宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。
宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。

defsEn: n. the act of pulling and releasing a taut cord
v. pull or pull out sharply
v. pull lightly but sharply with a plucking motion
v. strip of feathers
zh: n. 勇气, 猛拉, 动物内脏
vt. 摘, 猛拉, 拔, 拉, 扯, 采
vi. 拉, 拽
examples: I want to pluck your facial hair.
I have a crow to pluck with you.
exampleZh: 我想拔你的胡须。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or associated with the moon
zh: a. 阴历的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)
examples: Tomorrow, there will be a lunar eclipse.
A lunar eclipse will be visible tonight.

defsEn: v. express audibly
utter sounds (not necessarily words)
v. put into circulation
zh: a. 全然的, 绝对的, 完全的
vt. 发出声音, 做声, 发表, 发射, 流通
examples: He was too embarrassed to utter a word in front of the crowd.
So great was his emotion that he could not utter a word.
exampleZh: 他太难为情，在大众人前一句话也说不出来。

defsEn: a. open and genuine
not deceitful
zh: a. 诚实的, 正直的, 真挚的, 纯净的
examples: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
I don't think that he is sincere.
exampleZh: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。
我不觉得他很诚实。

defsEn: n. a long narrow excavation in the earth
n. any small natural waterway
v. forsake
v. make an emergency landing on water
zh: n. 沟渠
vt. 在...开沟
vi. 开沟
examples: I dare you to jump over this ditch.
What do you say we ditch this joint?

defsEn: r in the second place
zh: adv. 第二, 其次
examples: Secondly, is there any project scheduled to be released today?
Secondly, some of the Creoles may become independent "national languages" in their own right.
exampleZh: 其次，按照日程今天有将要发布的项目吗？

defsEn: n. a quantity of food (other than bread) formed in a particular shape
zh: n. 一条面包, 块, 游荡
v. 游手好闲, 虚度光阴
examples: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
A loaf of bread is better than the songs of birds.
exampleZh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。
面包比鸟的鸣唱好。

defsEn: n. the layer of air that supports a hovercraft or similar vehicle
n. a soft bag filled with air or a mass of padding such as feathers or foam rubber etc.
v. protect from impact
zh: n. 垫子, 橡皮软垫
vt. 加垫褥, 缓冲, 掩盖
examples: I might embroider that on a cushion.
She cushioned the ball with her head.

defsEn: n. a kind of arboreal rodent having a long bushy tail
n. the fur of a squirrel
zh: n. 松鼠, 松鼠毛皮
vt. 贮藏
examples: The squirrel advanced against the strong wind.
If you were a squirrel, what would you do?
exampleZh: 松鼠在前面顶着强风。
如果你是只松鼠，你会怎么做？

defsEn: v. move out of an unsafe location into safety
v. empty completely
v. move people from their homes or country
v. create a vacuum in (a bulb, flask, reaction vessel)
zh: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排泄
examples: The people were evacuated because of the flood.
People were evacuated because of the flood.
exampleZh: 人们因为洪水被疏散了。
人们因为洪水被疏散了。

defsEn: n. something that causes or entails suffering
zh: n. 艰难, 辛苦, 苦难
examples: The people's hardships are our hardships.
They bring up their children in hardship.
exampleZh: 人民的困难就是我们的困难。

defsEn: n. an arm of a sea or ocean partly enclosed by land
larger than a bay
n. an unbridgeable disparity (as from a failure of understanding)
n. a deep wide chasm
zh: n. 海湾, 深渊, 漩涡, 隔阂
vt. 吞没
examples: The second Gulf War caused a surge in the price of petroleum.
The quarrel left a gulf between the two families.

defsEn: n. sharp curved horny process on the toe of a bird or some mammals or reptiles
n. a grasping structure on the limb of a crustacean or other arthropods
n. a bird's foot
v. move as if by clawing, seizing, or digging
zh: n. 爪, 螯, 抓伤
v. 用爪抓, 挖, 搜刮
examples: Ziri saw a large claw mark on the oak tree.
I saw you stick your claws out.
exampleZh: 齐里看到橡树上有一个很大的爪痕。

defsEn: s. being or having the character of a miracle
zh: a. 令人惊异的, 了不起的, 不平常的
examples: What a marvelous person your brother is!
It is really marvelous of you to remember my birthday.
exampleZh: 你的弟弟真是个奇妙的人。
你还记得我的生日，那真是太好了。

defsEn: n. a heavy silvery toxic univalent and bivalent metallic element
the only metal that is liquid at ordinary temperatures
n. (Roman mythology) messenger of Jupiter and god of commerce
counterpart of Greek Hermes
n. the smallest planet and the nearest to the sun
n. temperature measured by a mercury thermometer
zh: n. 水银, 汞, 使者
examples: That one over there is Mercury.
Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
exampleZh: 那边那颗是水星。
水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

defsEn: n. certainty based on past experience
n. the state of relying on something
zh: n. 信任, 信赖, 受信赖的人(或事)
examples: We need to reduce our reliance on foreign oil.
The reliance on a data connection to function is a big bugbear.

defsEn: n. weedy annual native to Europe but widely distributed as a weed especially in wheat
n. a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules
the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
zh: n. 国际象棋
examples: I moved a chess piece on the board one forward.
You're a better chess player than me.
exampleZh: 我在棋盘上把一个棋子向前移动一步。
你比我更会下象棋。

defsEn: n. cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions
zh: n. 骆驼, 打捞浮筒
examples: The camel can go a long time without water and food.
Who would want to ride a camel?
exampleZh: 骆驼可以撑很久不吃不喝。

defsEn: s. sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
zh: a. 值得花时间的, 值得做的, 有真实价值的
examples: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.
The hard work was worthwhile because I passed the exam.
exampleZh: 我觉得这部电影值得一看再看。
努力是值得的，因为我考过关了。

defsEn: n. a partially opened flower
n. a swelling on a plant stem consisting of overlapping immature leaves or petals
v. develop buds
v. start to grow or develop
zh: n. 芽, 花蕾
vi. 发芽, 萌芽
vt. 使发芽
examples: The budding of the peach tree is very beautiful.
The trees have begun to bud.
exampleZh: 正在开花桃树很美。
树木开始抽芽。

defsEn: v resist or confront with resistance
v stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
zh: vt. 抵住, 顶住, 经得起
examples: She is unable to withstand the pressure.
Can the economy withstand another shock?
exampleZh: 她无法应付压力。

defsEn: n. equipment designed to serve a specific function
n. (anatomy) a group of body parts that work together to perform a given function
zh: n. 装置, 器具, 器官
examples: Clean the apparatus only with dry cloth.
The brain is an apparatus with which we think that we think.

defsEn: r only a very short time before
r almost not
zh: adv. 简直不, 一定不, 仅仅
examples: He can scarcely write his name.
There was scarcely any money left.
exampleZh: 他很难写他的名字。
几乎没剩下钱。

defsEn: n. any of various types of cabbage
n. any of various cultivars of the genus Brassica oleracea grown for their edible leaves or flowers
zh: n. 卷心菜
examples: The price of cabbage fell because of overproduction.
The cabbage that was this big becomes this small after being cooked.
exampleZh: 由于产量过剩，卷心菜的价格下降了。
这么大的白菜煮熟了就变这么小了。

defsEn: n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
v. move heavily or clumsily
zh: n. 木材, 破旧家俱, 废物, 隆隆声
vt. 砍伐木材, 乱堆
vi. 笨拙地移动, 喧闹地向前走, 隆隆地移动
examples: We need lumber to build a barn.
At least I have lumber, in case the gas runs out.

defsEn: n. (Old Testament) Adam's wife in Judeo-Christian mythology: the first woman and mother of the human race
God created Eve from Adam's rib and placed Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
n. the day before
n. the period immediately before something
zh: n. 前夕, 前夜
examples: I'm spending Christmas Eve with my family.
He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.
exampleZh: 我陪家人度过圣诞夜。
考试前夕，他特别焦虑。

defsEn: n. something of value given by one person to another to bind a contract
s. characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions
zh: n. 定金, 诚挚, 认真
a. 认真的, 热心的, 重要的
examples: He said in earnest that he would quit the company.
I'd like an earnest word with you.

defsEn: n. the quality of being simple or uncompounded
n. a lack of penetration or subtlety
n. absence of affectation or pretense
zh: n. 单纯, 简朴, 朴素, 坦率, 天真
examples: Darling, you have the simplicity of a child.
I focus on simplicity in my wardrobe.

defsEn: n. a biography of yourself
zh: n. 自传
examples: I want to write my autobiography.
In his autobiography, the author describes his mistake.

defsEn: n a way of access (upward and downward) consisting of a set of steps
zh: n. 楼梯, 梯子, 楼梯部分
examples: There are two staircases in my house.
Enter by means of the staircase!
exampleZh: 我的房子有两座楼梯。

defsEn: n. an open jar of glass or porcelain used as an ornament or to hold flowers
zh: n. 花瓶, 瓶
examples: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
I filled up the vase with water.
exampleZh: 花瓶在桌上留下了水迹。
我倒水进去花瓶里。

defsEn: n. a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation
zh: n. 感激之情
examples: We express our gratitude for Mr Smith's outstanding, challenging speech.
I would like to express my gratitude to her.
exampleZh: 我们对史密斯先生杰出的，给人启发的讲话表示感激。

defsEn: n. the male ruler of an empire
n. red table grape of California
n. large moth of temperate forests of Eurasia having heavily scaled transparent wings
zh: n. 皇帝, 君主
examples: In an empty place, an emperor has no power.
It is said that Peng Zu was the grandson of a celestial emperor.
exampleZh: 在空无一物的地方, 皇帝再大的权力也无用。
传说彭祖是天帝的孙子。

defsEn: n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
zh: n. 自助餐厅
examples: A cafeteria is a self-service style restaurant.
I'd like to work at the cafeteria.
exampleZh: 自助餐厅是一种自助式的餐厅。
我想在餐厅工作。

defsEn: a. existing or coming before
zh: a. 在前的, 前面的
examples: The sentence with the preceding number is false.
I'm not the one following you. You're the one preceding me.

defsEn: n. a form of socialism that abolishes private ownership
n. a political theory favoring collectivism in a classless society
zh: n. 共产主义
examples: Communism will never be reached in my lifetime.
Communism is the system practiced in the Soviet Union.
exampleZh: 在我有生之年，共产主义不可能达到。
共产主义是在苏联被实行的制度。

defsEn: n. a setting with precious stones so closely set that no metal shows
v. cover with a material such as stone or concrete to make suitable for vehicle traffic
zh: vt. 铺设, 安排, 铺满, 为...铺路
examples: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
The road to Hell is paved with good intentions.
exampleZh: 通往地狱的路，都是由善意铺成的。
通往地狱的路，都是由善意铺成的。

defsEn: v. bestow in large quantities
v. fill to overflow
zh: n. 堆, 许多, 累积
vt. 堆积, 装满
examples: She fell in a heap to the floor.
The workers heap up the soil to create a barrier.

defsEn: n. a precautionary measure warding off impending danger or damage or injury etc.
n. the trait of practicing caution in advance
zh: n. 预防, 留心, 警戒
vt. 预先警告
examples: As a precaution against infection, please put on the face mask provided to you.
As a last precaution, I put a flashlight into my pack.

defsEn: n. English painter and art critic (1866-1934)
n. English dramatist noted for his comic verse dramas (born 1907)
v. be excessively hot
v. cook on a hot surface using fat
zh: n. 油炸食物, 鱼苗
v. 油炸, 煎
examples: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
He fell out of the frying pan into the fire.
exampleZh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。
他真是刚出狼窝又入虎穴。

defsEn: n. the activity of flying a glider
v. move smoothly and effortlessly
v. fly in or as if in a glider plane
v. cause to move or pass silently, smoothly, or imperceptibly
zh: n. 滑动, 滑过, 流水
vi. 滑动, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝
vt. 使滑动
examples: The cat glided along, very refined, but ended up falling, which was very embarrassing.
A bird can glide through the air without moving its wings.
exampleZh: 这只猫咪气场全开，走着猫步，相当优雅，然后摔倒了，真是糗大了。

defsEn: a. lacking stability or fixity or firmness
s. highly or violently reactive
s. disposed to psychological variability
zh: a. 不稳定的
examples: The unstable machine shut down again.
Karl was unstable and on some kind of drug.

defsEn: n. a Boy Scout or Girl Scout
n. someone employed to discover and recruit talented persons (especially in the worlds of entertainment or sports)
n. someone who can find paths through unexplored territory
v. explore, often with the goal of finding something or somebody
zh: n. 守候, 侦察, 搜索, 侦察员, 侦察机
vi. 守候, 侦察, 巡视, 嘲笑
vt. 侦察, 跟踪, 发现, 监视, 嘲弄
examples: Boy Scouts need to do one good deed every day.
You can't be a Boy Scout, but you could be a Girl Scout.
exampleZh: 童子军每天都要完成一件好事。

defsEn: a. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
zh: a. 不够的, 不能胜任的, 不充足的
examples: There is insufficient light to take pictures.
Don't read under insufficient light, for it is bad for your eyes.
exampleZh: 拍照片光线不够亮。
不要在太暗的光线下看书，那对你的眼睛不好的。

defsEn: n (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately
n a garment (or part of a garment) designed for or relating to trousers
zh: pl. 裤子, 长裤
examples: I bought two pairs of trousers.
I asked her to shorten my trousers.
exampleZh: 我买了两条裤子。

defsEn: v. cause to be embarrassed
cause to feel self-conscious
zh: vt. 使困窘, 使局促不安, 阻碍
examples: I'm so embarrassed I could dig a hole and crawl into it.
She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
exampleZh: 我窘得想找个洞钻进去。
当她的孩子在公共场合行为表现不好的时候，她觉得很尴尬。

defsEn: v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
v. to begin moving, "As the thunder started the sleeping children began to stir"
v. stimulate sexually
zh: vt. 唤醒, 鼓励, 引起
vi. 醒来
examples: How to arouse a woman's desire?
Coffee does not arouse my interest.
exampleZh: 如何引起女人的渴望？
咖啡不能引起我的兴趣。

defsEn: v. take the load off (a container or vehicle)
zh: vi. 卸货
vt. 从...卸下, 摆脱...之负担, 倾销, 卸(货)
examples: Can I unload the high speed film?
Will you help me unload the truck?

defsEn: n. an affluent person
a person who is financially well off
s. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
zh: a. 丰富的, 富裕的
n. 支流, 富人
examples: Humanity is now affluent due to progression in science and technology.
In an affluent society most people have a high standard of living.
exampleZh: 由于科学技术的进步，人类现在很富裕。

defsEn: n. an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v. indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
zh: n. 呻吟, 叹息
vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 受压迫
vt. 呻吟地说
examples: The table was groaning with food.
The roof of the hut groaned under the weight of the snow.
exampleZh: 桌子上放满了食物。

defsEn: n. a light usually carried in the hand
consists of some flammable substance
v. burn maliciously, as by arson
zh: n. 火把, 启发之物
examples: You won't see anything without a torch.
Turn off your torch, they will see you.
exampleZh: 没有手电筒的话，你啥都看不到。

defsEn: n. grass mowed and cured for use as fodder
v. convert (plant material) into hay
zh: n. 干草
vt. 制干草, 供给干草
vi. 晒干草
examples: How much hay do you need per day?
We hit the hay early in order to get up at dawn.

defsEn: n. an adulterous woman
a woman who has an ongoing extramarital sexual relationship with a man
n. a woman master who directs the work of others
zh: n. 主妇, 女主人, 情妇
examples: I have a teacher and a mistress.
I'd rather be dead than be the mistress of anyone.

defsEn: v. become dusk
zh: n. 薄暮, 傍晚, 黄昏
a. 微暗的
v. (使)微暗
examples: At dusk, the sky was dyed with purple light.
Sami left his tent at dusk to go to the toilet.
exampleZh: 黄昏时分，天空染上了紫色的光。

defsEn: n. any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin
they are solid at normal temperatures and insoluble in water
v. cover with wax
v. go up or advance
v. increase in phase
zh: n. 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈
vi. 变大, 增大, 月亮渐满
vt. 上蜡于
examples: I need to get a wax.
There was candle wax on the table near the candle.

defsEn: n. convulsive gasp made while weeping
v. weep convulsively
zh: vi. 啜泣, 呜咽
vt. 哭诉, 哭得使
n. 啜泣, 呜咽
examples: I could hear her sobbing in her bedroom.
The girl was sobbing in the corner of the schoolroom.
exampleZh: 我能听到她在卧室里抽泣。
女孩在教室的角落啜泣。

defsEn: a. characterized by beauty of movement, style, form, or execution
zh: a. 优美的
examples: Ice skating can be graceful and beautiful.
The lady has a graceful manner.

defsEn: n. a political theory advocating state ownership of industry
n. an economic system based on state ownership of capital
zh: n. 社会主义, 社会主义运动
examples: I do not believe in socialism.
Socialism means a lot of different things to a lot of different people.

defsEn: n. a small figure of a person operated from above with strings by a puppeteer
n. a doll with a hollow head of a person or animal and a cloth body
intended to fit over the hand and be manipulated with the fingers
zh: n. 傀儡, 木偶
examples: The Foreign Minister was a puppet.
I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.
exampleZh: 外交部长是个没主见的人。
我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。

defsEn: n. the chair of state for a monarch, bishop, etc.
n. the position and power of an exalted person (a sovereign or bishop) who is entitled to sit in a chair of state on ceremonial occasions
v. sit on the throne as a ruler
zh: n. 王座, 君主
examples: He will succeed to the throne.
The prince succeeded to the throne.
exampleZh: 他会继承王位。
王子继承了王位。

defsEn: n. cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive
v. join or attach with or as if with glue
v. be fixed as if by glue
zh: n. 胶, 粘性物
vt. 粘合, 胶合
examples: Tom's eyes were glued to the screen.
Seal the box with glue, and not with tape.
exampleZh: Tom的眼睛被荧幕吸引住了。

defsEn: n. rotary engine in which the kinetic energy of a moving fluid is converted into mechanical energy by causing a bladed rotor to rotate
zh: n. 涡轮机
examples: Why are the sails on that wind turbine not turning?
Why aren't the sails on that wind turbine turning?

defsEn: a. not correct
not in conformity with fact or truth
s. (of a word or expression) not agreeing with grammatical principles
zh: a. 不正确的
examples: You have done it totally incorrect!
One can be incorrect without being an idiot.
exampleZh: 你全做错了！

defsEn: n all of the living human inhabitants of the earth
zh: n. 人类, 男性
examples: If mankind doesn't take care of the environment, the environment may eliminate mankind.
That can be said of mankind at large.
exampleZh: 如果人类不好好保护大自然，大自然说不定会反过来把人类毁灭。

defsEn: n. cases used to carry belongings when traveling
n. a worthless or immoral woman
n. the portable equipment and supplies of an army
zh: n. 行李
examples: Please take that baggage to the post office.
Please put your baggage on this scale.
exampleZh: 请将这些行李拿到邮局那边。
请把你的行李放在这秤上。

defsEn: n. a membranous covering attached to the immature fruiting body of certain mushrooms
v. to obscure, or conceal with or as if with a veil
zh: n. 面纱, 面罩, 借口, 幕, 帐, 遮蔽物
vt. 戴面纱, 隐藏, 遮蔽, 掩饰
vi. 蒙上面纱
examples: Through your veil we see your dove-like eyes.
I wear a hooded lace veil to church.

defsEn: s. worried and uneasy
s. ceaselessly in motion
a. lacking or not affording physical or mental rest
zh: a. 不安静的, 慌张的, 休息不充分的
examples: I've been feeling a little restless.
You've had a very restless night.
exampleZh: 我有点不安。
你度过了很不安宁的一夜。

defsEn: a. being full of or promoting cheer
having or showing good spirits
s. pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic

examples: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
She's always been a very cheerful person.
exampleZh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。
她是一直是个很欢快的人

defsEn: n. atmospheric phenomena accompanying the daily appearance of the sun
n. the daily event of the sun rising above the horizon
s. of an industry or technology
new and developing
zh: n. 日出, 黎明, 拂晓
examples: What a beautiful sunrise it is!
Tom began to work before sunrise.
exampleZh: 多美的日出啊！
汤姆在日出前开始工作。

defsEn: n. a drawing intended to explain how something works
a drawing showing the relation between the parts
v. make a schematic or technical drawing of that shows interactions among variables or how something is constructed
zh: n. 图表；图解
examples: Let me explain it with a diagram.
Would you like me to draw you a diagram?
exampleZh: 让我用一张图来说明。

defsEn: n. a flat device with narrow pointed teeth on one edge
disentangles or arranges hair
n. the fleshy red crest on the head of the domestic fowl and other gallinaceous birds
n. any of several tools for straightening fibers
n. ciliated comb-like swimming plate of a ctenophore
zh: n. 头梳, 鸡冠
vt. 梳头发, 梳毛
vi. (浪)涌起
examples: Comb your hair before you go out.
I like to comb my hair with this comb.
exampleZh: 在你出门之前，把你的头发梳一梳。

defsEn: n. the act of removing or getting rid of something
n. the bodily process of discharging waste matter
n. analysis of a problem into alternative possibilities followed by the systematic rejection of unacceptable alternatives
zh: n. 除去, 消除, 消灭
examples: You need to start an elimination diet.
It was a matter of elimination.

defsEn: n cases used to carry belongings when traveling
zh: n. 行李, 皮箱
examples: What should I do with this luggage?
He left his luggage at the station.
exampleZh: 这件行李怎么办？
他把他的行李留在车站。

defsEn: v. provide or equip with furniture
zh: vt. 供给, 提供, 装设
examples: She furnished the room with beautiful furniture.
His home is furnished in a very cozy way.
exampleZh: 她用漂亮的家具布置了房间。
他家的布局非常温馨。

defsEn: n. the resistance encountered when one body is moved in contact with another
n. effort expended in moving one object over another with pressure
zh: n. 摩擦, 摩擦治疗, 不和
examples: Trade friction might arise between the two nations at any moment.
Trade friction might arise between the nations at any moment.

defsEn: s in fortunate circumstances financially
moderately rich
s very lively and profitable
s marked by peace and prosperity
s presaging or likely to bring good luck
zh: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸运的
examples: The city is becoming more and more prosperous.
May you have a prosperous new year.
exampleZh: 这个城市越来越繁盛了。

defsEn: n. a metallic tapping sound
n. any of two families of small parasitic arachnids with barbed proboscis
feed on blood of warm-blooded animals
n. a light mattress
v. make a sound like a clock or a timer

vi. 滴答响, 活动
vt. 滴答地记录, 标记号于
examples: Time ticks by more slowly around a black hole.
I have a tick in the back of my knee.
exampleZh: 黑洞周围的时间要流逝得慢得多。

defsEn: n. an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something
n. any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity
n. the act of concealing the identity of something by modifying its appearance
v. make unrecognizable
zh: n. 假面目, 假装
vt. 假装, 隐瞒
examples: He disguised himself as a woman.
He got away disguised as a policeman.
exampleZh: 他打扮得像女人一样。
他伪装成警察逃跑了。

defsEn: n. the production of young from an egg
n. shading consisting of multiple crossing lines
n. a movable barrier covering a hatchway
v. emerge from the eggs
zh: n. 孵化, 舱口
vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划
vi. 孵化
examples: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
We need to get this hatch open.
exampleZh: 母鸡孵蛋，孵出小鸡。

defsEn: n. any large and important church
n. the principal Christian church building of a bishop's diocese
a. relating to or containing or issuing from a bishop's office or throne
zh: n. 大教堂
examples: There used to be a cathedral here.
The king and the queen went to the cathedral with the bishop.

defsEn: r. with one side forward or to the front
r. toward one side
zh: adv. 向旁边, 向侧面地
a. 旁边的, 向侧面的
examples: That woman looked at me sideways.
He edged sideways through the crowd.

defsEn: a. concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
zh: a. 自私的, 利己主义的, 自我中心的
examples: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
I am a selfish person, but I became very selfless after meeting you.
exampleZh: 我觉得她有点自私。
我是个很自私的人，但是遇到你之后变得特别地无私。

defsEn: n. someone in charge of other people
zh: n. 监护人, 管理人, 看守人
examples: The goal-keeper took his place in goal.
The keeper made a fantastic save.

n. a small valley between mountains
v. remove the interior of
a. not solid
having a space or gap or cavity
zh: n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷
a. 空的, 虚伪的, 空腹的, 凹的
vi. 形成空洞
vt. 挖空
examples: The fox hid in the hollow tree.
A water drop hollows a stone not by force but by falling often.
exampleZh: 狐狸躲在了空心树里面。
滴水穿石，不是靠力量，而是靠时间。

defsEn: n. the act of vibrating
n. a distinctive emotional aura experienced instinctively
zh: n. 振动, 颤动
examples: Cats sense vibrations with their whiskers.
Ziri felt vibrations penetrate his body.

defsEn: s full of or showing high-spirited merriment
s offering fun and gaiety
s quick and energetic
zh: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的
examples: I wish you a Merry Christmas.
Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
exampleZh: 祝你圣诞节快乐。
钞能力不等于幸福，但可以暂时解决很多麻烦。

defsEn: v. cause to become sober
a. not affected by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)
zh: a. 未醉的, 稳重的, 节制的, 严肃的, 不夸大的, 合理的, 朴素的
vt. 使醒酒, 使严肃
vi. 从醉里醒来, 变严肃
examples: I was as sober as a judge.
I was very sober at the time.
exampleZh: 我当时非常清醒。
我当时非常清醒。

zh: n. 同志, 伙伴

Run, comrade, the old world is behind you!
exampleZh: 同志们，让我们转换莫斯科为理想的共产主义城市。

defsEn: s. accompanying
s. similar especially in position or purpose
zh: a. 相当的, 一致的, 通信的

An increase in price will result in a corresponding decrease in demand.

examples: Did you see the rainbow this morning?
How long is the Rainbow Bridge?
exampleZh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？
彩虹桥有多长？

困了的话就说哦。

see的过去式

I saw the children walk across the street.
exampleZh: 我看到有个男人被车撞了。
我看孩子们过了马路。

vigorous and fresh

vi. 小睡, 疏忽
vt. 使拉毛, 打盹度过, 预测...为获胜马
examples: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.
While napping, I had a strange dream.

now

The president is presently in Miami.

总统目前在迈阿密。

v. shave with a razor

vt. 剃

I cut my finger with a razor blade.

我迫不及待地想要看到Tatoeba的新版本。

v. cause aversion in

vt. 使作呕
examples: I didn't mean to disgust anyone.
Sami the picture and he was immediately disgusted.

exampleZh: 今年的雨季来得早。
雨季何时会结束？

n. the act of laying out (as by making plans for something)

I'm sick and tired of hamburgers.

我吃腻了汉堡。

s. being ten more than seventy
zh: num. 八十, 八十个
examples: Eighty percent of all information on computers around the world is in English.
He lived to be eighty years old.
exampleZh: 全世界百分之八十电脑上的资讯都是用英语写的。
他活到了八十岁。

n. a simple machine that gives a mechanical advantage when given a fulcrum

vi. 使用杠杆

s. in a vertical position
not sloping
zh: a. 正直的, 诚实的, 公正的, 垂直的, 竖式的

defsEn: v. grant freedom to

examples: He liberated the people from bondage.
They died to liberate their land.
exampleZh: 他让人们摆脱了奴役。

defsEn: n. (baseball) a hit that flies straight out from the batter

zh: n. 班机, 划线者, 定期船, 衬里

defsEn: n. a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
zh: n. 图书馆员, 图书管理员
examples: The librarian told us to keep quiet.
The librarian will show you how to use the online catalog.

defsEn: n. one of lesser rank or station or quality

a. of low or inferior quality
a. having an orbit between the sun and the Earth's orbit
zh: a. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的
n. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)
examples: He is inferior to you in all respects.

她在数学上不如他。

defsEn: n. someone who proclaims a message publicly
n. reads news, commercials on radio or television
zh: n. 节目报告员, 宣告者

The mother of that child is an announcer.

n. a young animal without a mother
zh: n. 孤儿

vt. 使成孤儿

The orphans were taken to the orphanage.
exampleZh: 他十岁时成了孤儿。
孤儿们被带到这间育幼院。

n. music composed for dancing a reel
n. winder consisting of a revolving spool with a handle
attached to a fishing rod
n. a lively dance of Scottish Highlanders
marked by circular moves and gliding steps
zh: n. 卷轴, 一卷, 纺车, 旋转, 蹒跚
vt. 卷...于轴上, 绕, 使旋转
vi. 蹒跚地走, 旋转, 眩晕, 摇晃, 退缩
examples: Reel it in before it's too late!
The cat unravelled the reel of cotton.

defsEn: v. make larger
v. become larger or bigger
zh: vt. 扩大, 增大
vi. 扩大, 详述
examples: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.
You may enlarge the house with an addition.
exampleZh: 他试图扩大自己的势力范围。

v. suffuse with or as if with light
v. clean one's body by immersion into water
zh: vt. 沐浴, 用水洗
vi. 洗澡
examples: It is dangerous to bathe in this river.
This river is dangerous to bathe in.
exampleZh: 在这条河里游泳很危险。
在这河里游泳危险。

zh: n. 连接词, 联合, 结合

defsEn: n. intense feelings of suffering

zh: n. 极大的痛苦, 挣扎

defsEn: s. capable of being applied
having relevance
zh: a. 合适的, 可应用的

exampleZh: 此法适用于所有情况。

defsEn: v make psychologically or physically used (to something)

She is not accustomed to driving for a long time.
exampleZh: 我们已经习惯寒冷了。

vi. 收割, 得到报应
