恶有恶报。

defsEn: s. capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
zh: a. 能实行的, 可行的, 适宜的
examples: It's not feasible for you to finish this project.
Your idea is not at all feasible.

defsEn: pron. A reflexive form of the indefinite pronoun one.
Commonly writen as two words, one's self.
zh: pron. 自己, 亲自
examples: To be free means to free oneself from fear.
It is possible to fence oneself out from the outer world with a newspaper.

defsEn: v. be performed for the first time
v. perform a work for the first time
s. first in rank or degree
s. preceding all others in time
zh: n. 总理, 首相
a. 首位的, 最初的
examples: The premier paid a formal visit to the White House.
The Premier subscribed his name to the charter.

defsEn: n. any mixture of a soft and malleable consistency
n. a hard, brilliant lead glass that is used in making artificial jewelry
n. an adhesive made from water and flour or starch
used on paper and paperboard
v. hit with the fists
zh: n. 面团, 面食, 浆糊, 糊状物, 粘贴, 用拳重击
vt. 用浆糊粘, 张贴, 狠狠地打
examples: Tap an clip to paste it in the text box.
Add the tomato paste and a bay leaf.

defsEn: n. an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration
v. injure the underlying soft tissue or bone of
v. break up into small pieces for food preparation
v. damage (plant tissue) by abrasion or pressure
zh: n. 青肿, 挫伤, 擦伤
vi. 受伤, 擦伤
vt. 使受伤, 研碎
examples: The skin of peaches bruises easily.
I have a bruise on my forehead where I banged my head.
exampleZh: 桃子的皮很容易破。

defsEn: n. the largest inland sea
between Europe and Africa and Asia
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or located near the Mediterranean Sea
zh: n. 地中海, 地中海民族
a. 地中海的, 地中海民族的
examples: Life anywhere in the Mediterranean would suit me.
I like the Mediterranean Sea best.

defsEn: n. a period during which something or somebody is dominant or powerful
n. the period during which a monarch is sovereign
n. royal authority
the dominion of a monarch
v. have sovereign power
zh: v. 为王，为君；当政；统治
n. 为王，为君；当政；统治
examples: Better to reign in Hell, than serve in Heaven.
Her reign will be disastrous and brief.

defsEn: n. the group action of a collection of people or animals or vehicles moving ahead in more or less regular formation
zh: n. 队伍, 连续, 列队行进, 涌出
examples: The procession will make its start at the central square.
The royal procession moved through the grand hall with grace.

defsEn: n an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
zh: n. 呻吟, 悲叹
vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 悲叹
vt. 呻吟着说
examples: What do you have to moan about?
He let out a loud moan.

defsEn: v decrease in size, extent, or range
v make smaller
v wear off or die down
zh: vt. 减少, 缩小, 减轻
vi. 变小
examples: I need medicine to lessen the pain.
What can be done to lessen the risk?

defsEn: a. being or in accordance with current social fashions
s. patronized by
zh: a. 时髦的, 上流社会的, 流行的
examples: It's sort of fashionable, but the price is too high!
Libertarianism is fashionable in tech bro circles.
exampleZh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！
自由意志主义在科技男的圈子里很受追捧。

defsEn: n. the act of conquering
n. success in mastering something difficult
zh: n. 战胜, 征服, 战利品
examples: Conquest is a form of theft.
They extended their territory by conquest.

defsEn: s known widely and usually unfavorably
zh: a. 无耻的, 不名誉的, 声名狼藉的
examples: After that night they became infamous in the entire city.
I glare resentfully at the crimson letter, is this the infamous red-paper draft notice?

defsEn: n. storage space where wines are stored
zh: n. 地窖, 地下室, 藏酒
examples: Reception in the cellar is very poor.
Go down to the cellar and get some wine.
exampleZh: 地下室里的信号很差。

defsEn: n. a piece of meat roasted or for roasting and of a size for slicing into more than one portion
v. cook with dry heat, usually in an oven
s. (meat) cooked by dry heat in an oven
zh: n. 烤肉, 烘烤, 嘲笑
a. 烘烤的, 烤过的
vt. 烤, 炙, 烘焙, 嘲笑
vi. 烤, 炙, 烘焙
examples: Dad uses fire to roast a chicken.
Mary put some roasted pecans into her salad.
exampleZh: 爸爸用火烧鸡肉
玛莉在沙拉里放了一些烤山核桃。

defsEn: n. the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic
n. a kind act
zh: n. 仁慈, 亲切, 和蔼
examples: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
I am grateful to you for your kindness.
exampleZh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。
谢谢您的好意。

defsEn: n. the most outstanding work of a creative artist or craftsman
n. an outstanding achievement
zh: n. 杰作, 名著
examples: That painting is a masterpiece of impressionist art.
That was a masterpiece, I have to congratulate him.
exampleZh: 那幅画是印象派的大师级作品。

defsEn: a. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide
s. not to be trusted
zh: a. 滑的, 光滑的, 靠不住的, 圆滑的, 不稳固的
examples: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
The slippery snake slithered right out of his hand.
exampleZh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。
那条蛇滑溜溜的，一下子就从他的手中掉了出来。

defsEn: s having great beauty and splendor
s very good
of the highest quality
s characterized by grandeur
zh: a. 光亮的, 了不起的, 灿烂的, 壮丽的, 显著的, 杰出的
examples: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
He hit on a splendid idea.
exampleZh: 寒冷干燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!

defsEn: n. a dull persistent (usually moderately intense) pain
v. have a desire for something or someone who is not present
v. be the source of pain
zh: n. 疼痛
vi. 痛, 哀怜, 渴望
examples: I have a fever and I ache all over.
It's ached before, but never as badly as right now.
exampleZh: 我发烧了，全身酸痛。
痛过，但是没现在这么厉害。

defsEn: n. the allotment of some amount by dividing something
v. divide into parts
v. cover with strips of canvas
v. make into a wrapped container
zh: n. 包裹, 部分, 片
vt. 分配, 打包
a. 部分的
adv. 局部地
examples: She tied up the parcel with string.
The address on this parcel is wrong.
exampleZh: 她用绳子把包裹紧紧绑好了。
这个包裹上的地址是错的。

defsEn: a. morally bad in principle or practice
zh: a. 坏的, 邪恶的, 缺德的, 刻毒的, 恶劣的, 淘气的
examples: It is wicked of you to do such things.
What you give to the wicked, you always regret.
exampleZh: 你竟然做出那样的事来，你还是人吗？

defsEn: v. be an ornament to
zh: n. 装饰, 点缀品, 教堂用品
vt. 装饰, 修饰
examples: Further elaboration or ornament would only detract from the perfection of its simplicity.
It just works as an ornament.

defsEn: n. a painful or straitened circumstance
n. an injury resulting from getting some body part squeezed
n. a squeeze with the fingers
v. squeeze tightly between the fingers
zh: n. 捏, 拧, 撮, 少量, 收缩, 挤压, 夹痛, 苦恼, 逮捕, 指控, 匮乏, 紧急关头
vt. 捏, 拧, 掐, 挤压, 修剪, 使困苦, 使萎缩, 节制, 少量加入, 逮捕, 勒索
vi. 收缩, 节省, 挤压, 引起苦恼
examples: Add a tiny pinch of salt.
He pinched and scraped for many years to save money.
exampleZh: 加一丁点盐。
为了存钱，他省吃俭用了许多年。

defsEn: n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer
n. a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients
a. devoid of violence or disruption
zh: a. 有秩序的, 整齐的, 值班的
n. 护理员, 清道夫, 传令兵, 勤务兵
adv. 依次地, 顺序地
examples: Why can't you keep an orderly house?
An orderly lifestyle and a regular diet are the keys to health.

defsEn: n. people having common origins or traditions and often comprising a nation
n. the status of belonging to a particular nation by birth or naturalization
zh: n. 国籍, 国家, 民族性
examples: What's the nationality of that cameraman over there?
Everyone has the right to a nationality.
exampleZh: 那个摄影师是哪国人？
所有人都有享有国籍的权利。

defsEn: n the rays of the sun
n moderate weather
suitable for outdoor activities
n the quality of being cheerful and dispelling gloom
zh: n. 阳光, 光明, 晴天
examples: Sunshine is a warm burst of joy after a gloomy, rainy week.
A day full of sunshine and a heart full of wishes...
exampleZh: 阴雨连绵的一周后，阳光让人感到一阵温暖喜悦。
充满阳光的天和充满愿望的心...

defsEn: a. having three dimensions
zh: a. 立方体的, 立方的
examples: How many gallons are in a cubic foot?
The box is elongated but still cubic.

defsEn: n. a person whose occupation is making and altering garments
v. adjust to a specific need or market
zh: n. 裁缝, 成衣匠
vt. 缝制, 制作, 使适应
vi. 做裁缝
examples: Father always has the tailor make his suits.
The tailor is going to redo the hem of my pants.
exampleZh: 父亲总是让这位裁缝师为他做西装。
裁缝师要帮我重新修裤脚。

defsEn: v. make lighter or brighter
zh: vi. 变亮, 活跃
vt. 使生辉, 使快活
examples: I thought that would brighten up your day.
I brighten the path for many.

defsEn: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one
s. being one more than eighteen
zh: num. 十九, 十九个
examples: I was born in nineteen seventy-two.
She was nineteen at that time.

defsEn: prep. Mixed or mingled
surrounded by.
prep. Conjoined, or associated with, or making part of the
number of
in the number or class of.
prep. Expressing a relation of dispersion, distribution,
etc.
also, a relation of reciprocal action.
zh: prep. 在...当中, 在...之间, 在...之中
examples: He's the tallest amongst the boys.
He is the youngest amongst us four.
exampleZh: 他算是男孩子中最高的了。
他是我们四人中间最年轻的。

defsEn: n. an ability to understand the meaning or importance of something (or the knowledge acquired as a result)
zh: n. 理解, 包含
examples: There is a global problem of comprehension.
There's a global problem of comprehension.

defsEn: n. the pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces
zh: n. 几何学
examples: If geometry is the science of space, what is the science of time?
Geometry, about which I know nothing, seems like a very dull subject.
exampleZh: 如果说几何学是空间的科学，那时间的科学是什么？

defsEn: n. a circular rounded projection or protuberance
n. a round handle
n. an ornament in the shape of a ball on the hilt of a sword or dagger
zh: n. 把手, 瘤, 旋钮, 球形突出物
vt. 使有球形突出物
vi. 鼓起
examples: Turn the knob and open the door.
Turn the knob to roll down the window.
exampleZh: 转动门把，把门打开。

defsEn: n. a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription
n. a small flat compressed cake of some substance
zh: n. 平板, 门牌, 笔记簿, 碑, 匾, 药片
examples: The doctor has given her some tablets to take away the pain.
The tablets took away my pain.
exampleZh: 医生给了她一些止疼药片。
药片止住了我的疼痛。

defsEn: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven
s. being ten more than sixty
zh: num. 七十, 七十个
examples: The temperature today is seventy degrees Fahrenheit.
He lived to be seventy years old.
exampleZh: 今天气温是华氏七十度。
他活到了70岁。

defsEn: a. exhibiting or caused by radioactivity
zh: a. 放射性的, 有放射能的
examples: The issue of radioactive waste remains unresolved.
The problem of radioactive waste remains unresolved.

defsEn: n. a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands
n. an inflated ball used in playing volleyball
zh: n. 排球
examples: Volleyball is a lot of fun.
I know Tom is a good volleyball player.
exampleZh: 排球很有意思。
我知道汤姆是优秀的排球手。

defsEn: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles
s. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
s. of low or inferior quality or value
zh: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的
examples: Her dress was made of coarse wool.
Her skin is coarse from years of working outdoors.
exampleZh: 她的裙子是用粗糙的羊毛造的。

defsEn: n. forming words with letters according to the principles underlying accepted usage
zh: n. 拼, 拼字, 拼法
examples: Ugly spellings in their language fascinate you.

defsEn: n. the aggregation of a country's military aircraft
n. the operation of aircraft to provide transportation
n. the art of operating aircraft
zh: n. 航空, 航空学, 飞行术
examples: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
The history of the development of aviation is fascinating.
exampleZh: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。

defsEn: n. diurnal bird of prey typically having short rounded wings and a long tail
n. an advocate of an aggressive policy on foreign relations
v. hunt with hawks
zh: n. 鹰, 掠夺者, 鹰派成员
vi. 放鹰行猎, 像鹰一般地袭击, 清嗓, 咳嗽
vt. 捕捉, 咳出, 兜售, 叫卖, 散播
examples: One of the hawk's wings is broken.
The hawk grasp the bat with its sharp talons.
exampleZh: 鹰的一只翅膀断了。

defsEn: a. without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success
s. of a person unable to do something skillfully
s. certain to fail
s. (informal to emphasize how bad it is) beyond hope of management or reform
zh: a. 无希望的, 绝望的, 不可救药的
examples: By the way, my English is absolutely hopeless.
I may be a hopeless fool, but please be kind to me.
exampleZh: 顺道一提，我的英语是绝对没有希望了。

defsEn: v. cause to be firmly attached
v. become fixed or fastened
v. attach to
zh: vt. 拴紧, 使固定, 系, 集中于, 强加于
vi. 扣紧
examples: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
Can you fasten the belt with one hand?
exampleZh: 无论何时都要扣好安全带。

defsEn: n. the process of gradually becoming inferior
n. a gradual decrease
as of stored charge or current
n. the organic phenomenon of rotting
n. an inferior state resulting from the process of decaying
zh: n. 衰退, 腐败
v. (使)衰退, (使)腐败
examples: The decay of the shrine is due, in part, to acid rain.
According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
exampleZh: 庙宇的毁坏有一部分要归因于酸雨。
根据牙医，蛀牙并不总是甜食所引起的。

defsEn: n. adult female chicken
n. adult female bird
n. flesh of an older chicken suitable for stewing
n. female of certain aquatic animals e.g. octopus or lobster
zh: n. 母鸡, 雌禽
examples: He likes me! - The cook's hen said.
Our hens laid a lot of eggs yesterday.
exampleZh: 他喜欢我！—厨师的母鸡说。
我们养的母鸡昨天生了很多蛋。

defsEn: n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar
v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction
v. use cautiously and frugally
zh: n. 蜜饯, 果酱
vt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恒
examples: Please conserve water during the summer.
We need to conserve our strength.

defsEn: r. in a special manner
zh: adv. 特别地, 专门地
examples: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
This machine is specially engineered to work in extreme weather.
exampleZh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

defsEn: s. existing for a long time
s. capable of withstanding wear and tear and decay
s. very long lasting
zh: a. 持久的, 耐用的
examples: Linen thread is durable and has a beautiful silver color.
Granite is a durable rock commonly used in kitchen countertops.

defsEn: n. navigational instrument for finding directions
n. the limit of capability
n. drafting instrument used for drawing circles
v. bring about
accomplish
zh: n. 指南针, 范围, 音域
vt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解
examples: The compass points to the north.
Tom doesn't know how to use a compass.
exampleZh: 指南针指向北边。
汤姆不会使用指南针。

defsEn: n the time at which something is supposed to begin
zh: n. 着手, 开头, 最初
examples: It was clear from the outset that the discussion would end again in argument.
From the outset, this was planned as an unusual kind of workshop.

defsEn: n. wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs
zh: n. 鸽子, 易上当受骗的人, 年轻女子
examples: He used pigeons in his experiment.
These pigeons do not fear people. They can land on people's shoulders.
exampleZh: 他的实验用了鸽子。
这些鸽子不怕人，能落在人的肩膀上。

defsEn: v. form the boundary of
be contiguous to
a. confined by bonds
a. held with another element, substance or material in chemical or physical union
a. secured with a cover or binding
often used as a combining form
zh: n. 跃, 回跳, 范围, 边界
a. 受约束的, 装有封面的, 有义务的, 关联的, 被束缚的, 准备去...的, 便秘的
vi. 跳跃, 弹起
vt. 使跳, 限制, 形成...的疆界
bind过去式和过去分词
examples: They bound the thief to a tree.
He's bound to notice your mistake.
exampleZh: 他们把小偷绑在树上了。
他必定会觉察到你的错误。

defsEn: n. an increase in rate of change
n. the act of accelerating
increasing the speed
n. (physics) a rate of increase of velocity
zh: n. 加速, 促进, 加速度
examples: If not, how do you explain the acceleration?

defsEn: n. the distance (measured in the direction of propagation) between two points in the same phase in consecutive cycles of a wave
n. a shared orientation leading to mutual understanding
zh: n. 波长
examples: We're not on the same wavelength.
I guess we're not on the same wavelength.

defsEn: n. a clawed foot of an animal especially a quadruped
v. scrape with the paws
v. touch clumsily
zh: n. 爪
v. 以蹄扒地, 用爪子抓, 拼命抓, 向...乱抓, 笨拙地使用, 费力地前进
examples: Cookie, sit! Paw! Down! Roll over! Good girl!
The dog put his paws on the door handle and it opened.

defsEn: n. confused movement
n. the shape of something rotating rapidly
v. cause to spin
v. fly around
zh: n. 回旋, 旋转, 急走, 眩晕
vt. 使旋转, 使回旋, 卷走
vi. 回旋, 旋转, 急走, 发晕
examples: The children whirled about the garden.
The dancer whirled around the hall.

defsEn: v. remove or make invisible
zh: vt. 删除
examples: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
exampleZh: 我希望我能知道如何删除我的Facebook帐号。
从申请单中删除他的名字。

defsEn: n. a strong flame that burns brightly
n. a light-colored marking
v. shine brightly and intensively
v. burn brightly and intensely
zh: n. 火焰, 烈火, 光辉
vi. 燃烧, 发光
vt. 使燃烧, 宣布, 在树皮上刻痕
examples: The firemen quickly extinguished the blaze.
The firefighters could not contain the blaze.
exampleZh: 消防队很快就把大火扑熄。

defsEn: n. a woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects
v. work as a carpenter
zh: n. 木匠
examples: The carpenter brought his tools along.
I work as a carpenter in a furniture factory.
exampleZh: 木匠带了工具。

defsEn: s in regular succession without gaps
zh: a. 继承的, 连续的
examples: Have there been several successive souls in me, or am I one unconscious being?
Successive owners have tinkered the place since then, but they cannot quite spoil it.

defsEn: r. with the terms of the relation reversed
zh: adv. 相反, 逆, 颠倒, 反题, 反

defsEn: n. small round bread leavened with baking-powder or soda
zh: n. 饼干
examples: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
She opened a packet of biscuits.
exampleZh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒饼干。
她打开了一包饼干。

defsEn: n. an advanced student or graduate in medicine gaining supervised practical experience (`houseman' is a British term)
v. deprive of freedom
v. work as an intern
zh: n. 实习生, 被拘留者
vi. 作实习医师(教师、实习生)
vt. 拘留, 扣留
examples: I feel like an intern again.
Tom was just an intern at that time.

defsEn: n. the act of granting rights
zh: n. 一致, 和谐
examples: In accordance with your request, I enclose a picture of myself.
In accordance with his advice, I called off the deal.

defsEn: n. a booming or crashing noise caused by air expanding along the path of a bolt of lightning
v. move fast, noisily, and heavily
v. utter words loudly and forcefully
v. be the case that thunder is being heard
zh: n. 雷, 雷声
vi. 打雷, 轰隆地响, 怒喝
vt. 大声喊出, 轰隆地发出
examples: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
I heard it thunder in the distance.
exampleZh: 一道闪电划破天空。
我听到了远处的雷声。

defsEn: n. a steep descent of the water of a river
zh: n. 瀑布
examples: I saw a beautiful waterfall there.
They found a hidden waterfall in the middle of the jungle.
exampleZh: 我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。

defsEn: n. a dark oil consisting mainly of hydrocarbons
zh: n. 石油
examples: The end of the era of petroleum is in sight.
A petroleum platform exploded in the bay.

defsEn: n. a holiday taken by a newly married couple
n. the early (usually calm and harmonious) period of a relationship
business or political
v. spend a holiday after one's marriage
zh: n. 蜜月, 蜜月假期
vi. 渡蜜月
examples: We want to spend our honeymoon in Australia.
A honeymoon in Canada costs a lot of money.

n. any of various soft sweet desserts thickened usually with flour and baked or boiled or steamed
zh: n. 布丁
examples: Did you just eat forty servings of pudding?
If you want pudding, you must eat your meat.
exampleZh: 你刚刚吃了四十份布丁吗？

defsEn: a. (often followed by `to') in the habit of or adapted to
s. commonly used or practiced
usual
zh: a. 惯常的, 习惯了的
examples: You will soon get accustomed to living here.
You will soon get accustomed to living in this country.
exampleZh: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。
你很快就会习惯这个国家的生活模式了。

defsEn: n. a female grandchild
zh: n. 孙女, 外孙女
examples: Keep your granddaughter away from my dog.
I have a granddaughter about your age.

defsEn: a. characterized by charm, good taste, and generosity of spirit
s. disposed to bestow favors
zh: a. 亲切的, 慈善的
examples: In the name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Be gracious and steer clear of your rudeness that you always have.

defsEn: n. the dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width
n. indistinct articulation
n. used of a line or mark
n. resistance to flow

Check the thickness of the brake discs.

defsEn: n. transporting goods commercially at rates cheaper than express rates
n. the charge for transporting something by common carrier
v. transport commercially as cargo
v. load with goods for transportation
zh: n. 船货, 运费, 货运
vt. 装货, 使充满, 以货运运送, 租(或出租)(船等)
examples: How much freight did you carry last trip?
How much is the freight on this box?

defsEn: v. make more cheerful
v. reduce the weight on
make lighter
v. become more cheerful
v. become lighter

vi. 发亮, 打闪, 变轻
examples: It was just a joke. Lighten up!
To lighten the mood, I told a joke.

defsEn: n. a wife who manages a household while her husband earns the family income
zh: n. 主妇, 家庭妇女
examples: A housewife should strive to be economical.
There was a short pause and the housewife said...

defsEn: a. relating to physical reality rather than with thoughts or the mind
r. toward the outside
zh: a. 向外的, 表面的, 外服的
adv. 向外, 在外, 表面
examples: A ghost is an outward and visible sign of an inward fear.
Despite this outward success, all is not as well as it seems.

defsEn: v. affect with wonder
zh: vt. 使吃惊
examples: She was amazed to hear the news.
I was amazed at the fluency with which the boy spoke French.
exampleZh: 她听到那个消息后惊呆了。
那个男孩的一口法语流利得有点儿不可置信。

defsEn: a. on the negative side or lower end of a scale
s. involving disadvantage or harm
zh: n. 负号, 不足
a. 减的, 负的, 阴性的
prep. 减, 缺
examples: How many is nine minus six?
Minus one plus one is zero.
exampleZh: 九减六等于多少？

defsEn: n. one of a pair of long straps (usually connected to the bit or the headpiece) used to control a horse
n. any means of control
v. stop or slow up one's horse or oneself by or as if by pulling the reins
v. stop or check by or as if by a pull at the reins
zh: n. 缰绳, 统治, 支配
vt. 驾驭, 以缰绳控制, 控制
vi. 勒住马

They gave their children free rein of the farm.

defsEn: v. lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions
zh: vt. 误导
examples: I didn't want to mislead anyone.
You told me you had a nice ass. Was that a misleading statement then?
exampleZh: 我不想误导任何人。

defsEn: n. a substance as germanium or silicon whose electrical conductivity is intermediate between that of a metal and an insulator
its conductivity increases with temperature and in the presence of impurities
zh: n. 半导体

Semiconductors were the top United States export to South Korea.

defsEn: n. (law) a broad legal concept including anything that disturbs the reasonable use of your property or endangers life and health or is offensive
zh: n. 讨厌的东西, 讨厌的人, 损害
examples: You can be a real nuisance when you want to.
I hate to be a nuisance.

defsEn: s. characterized by conscious design or purpose
zh: a. 故意的, 与目的有关的
examples: This appeared to be an intentional murder.
Battery is the intentional touching or striking of another person against their will.

defsEn: n. being undiluted or unmixed with extraneous material
n. the state of being unsullied by sin or moral wrong
lacking a knowledge of evil
zh: n. 纯净, 纯正, 纯粹
examples: She considered purity to be truly important.
White is a symbol of purity.

defsEn: a. situated in or suitable for the outdoors or outside of a building
zh: n. 外部, 表面, 外貌
a. 外部的, 外在的, 表面的
examples: There's sincere kindness and exterior kindness.
You can repaint the house exterior.

defsEn: n. low footwear that can be slipped on and off easily
usually worn indoors
zh: n. 拖鞋, 制轮器
vt. 用拖鞋打
examples: Your pair of slippers are very cute.
He even hit me with a slipper.
exampleZh: 你的这双拖鞋很萌。

defsEn: n. an examination consisting of a few short questions
v. examine someone's knowledge of something
zh: n. 考查, 课堂测验, 恶作剧, 智力测验
vt. 戏弄, 考查, 恶作剧
examples: We had a history quiz this morning.
We will have a math quiz tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我们今天早上有历史小考。
我们明天会有一个数学小测。

defsEn: n. a schedule listing events and the times at which they will take place
n. a schedule of times of arrivals and departures
zh: n. 时间表
examples: The timetable says the train will arrive soon.
Can I have a timetable, please?

defsEn: s being ten more than forty

Put on your coat lest you should catch a cold.

defsEn: n someone new to a field or activity
n a person who founds or establishes some institution

examples: Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
Beginners should learn spoken English first.
exampleZh: 汤姆是个初学者，但他赶上得很快。
初学者应先学习口说英语。

defsEn: a. lacking in usefulness or value
zh: a. 无价值的, 无益的, 无足轻重的

Without you, my life would be worthless.

defsEn: n. a passage or expression that is quoted or cited
n. a statement of the current market price of a security or commodity
n. the practice of quoting from books or plays etc.

examples: Can you give me a quotation?
Could you give me a quotation?

defsEn: n. a dissolute man in fashionable society
n. a long-handled tool with a row of teeth at its head
used to move leaves or loosen soil

v. level or smooth with a rake

v. 搜索, 掠过, (用耙子)耙, (使)倾斜

s. signifying nothing
s. of little importance or influence or power
of minor status

There is no such thing as an insignificant detail.

defsEn: v. catch up with and possibly overtake
zh: vt. 赶上, 突然降临于, 压倒, 代替
examples: You can overtake them safely after the bend.
Try to overtake them before the bend.

defsEn: n. an edge tool having two crossed pivoting blades

n. a gymnastic exercise performed on the pommel horse when the gymnast moves his legs as the blades of scissors move
zh: pl. 剪刀

There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
exampleZh: 我需要一把剪刀。
书桌上有一把剪刀。

defsEn: s. wanting to eat or drink more than one can reasonably consume

You need to be less greedy.

defsEn: n. a clergyman who watches over a group of people
v. watch over like a shepherd, as a teacher of her pupils
v. tend as a shepherd, as of sheep or goats
zh: n. 牧羊人, 牧羊犬, 牧师, 保护者
vt. 看守, 领导, 指导, 牧羊
examples: It is necessary for the shepherd to lead the sheep to the pasture.
The shepherd, even when he become a gentleman, smells of the lamb.

defsEn: n a reference book that is published regularly once every year
s occurring or payable every year
r without missing a year
zh: a. 每年的, 一年一度的
adv. 一年一次, 每年
examples: I prefer to have a yearly eye exam.
It's time for your yearly check-up.

defsEn: v. proclaim on, or as if on, a trumpet
v. play or blow on the trumpet
v. utter in trumpet-like sounds
zh: n. 喇叭, 小号, 喇叭声
vi. 吹喇叭
vt. 用喇叭吹出, 吹嘘

I play both the trumpet and the piano.

n. a content word that denotes an action, occurrence, or state of existence

examples: This verb is normally used only in the third person.
Some verbs in some languages can have up to one hundred different meanings.
exampleZh: 这个动词通常只用在第三人称。
在一些语言中，部分动词可能会有上百种不同的意思。

defsEn: a. not to be dispensed with
essential
s. unavoidable
zh: n. 不可缺少之物
a. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
examples: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
If someone is indispensable to a company, then that company is not well-organized.
exampleZh: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。
若是有人对公司来说是不可或缺的，那么这家公司组织得不好。

v. color with dye

vt. 染, 染色
vi. 被着色

Have you ever dyed your hair?
exampleZh: 我想染我的头髪。
你染过头发吗？

n. a formal military gesture of respect

v. greet in a friendly way

vt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬

I salute both of you for your professionalism.

s. denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia
zh: n. 东方人, 亚洲人
a. 东方诸国的, 亚洲的, 东方的
examples: I have an interest in oriental ceramics.
For me, an Oriental is not a foreigner.
exampleZh: 我对东方陶瓷有兴趣。

defsEn: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
zh: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群
vi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一块, 云集, 攀
vt. 挤满, 爬, 攀

We were attacked by swarms of bees.
exampleZh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。
我们被一大群蜜蜂攻击。

zh: n. 打扰, 中断, 障碍物

defsEn: n. a fastener (as a buckle or hook) that is used to hold two things together
n. the act of grasping
v. hold firmly and tightly
v. grasp firmly
zh: n. 扣子, 钩, 紧握
v. 扣紧, 紧握

The boy clasped the puppy to his chest.

You must not despise someone because they are poor.

exampleZh: 假期期间销售业绩畅旺，但之后就下滑了。

Mummy! Give me my alphabet book!

马麻！把认字书给我！

v challenge
s disposed to venture or take risks

zh: a. 大胆的

n. optical properties

lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives

s. being out or having grown cold
zh: a. 熄灭的, 灭绝的, 耗尽的

Treat the men well and the ore will come.

defsEn: n. an adult female hog
v. place (seeds) in or on the ground for future growth
v. introduce into an environment
zh: n. 母猪, 懒胖女人
vt. 播种, 散布, 使密布
vi. 播种
examples: As you sow, so shall you reap.
As a man sows, so he shall reap.
exampleZh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。
种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

defsEn: n. an inclination of the top half of the body forward and downward
n. small porch or set of steps at the front entrance of a house
v. descend swiftly, as if on prey
v. sag, bend, bend over or down
zh: n. 佝偻, 屈从, 弯腰
vi. 弯下, 屈从, 弯腰, 堕落
vt. 使屈从, 使弯曲
examples: I had to stoop to go into the room.
They crossed the road and stooped to pass through a gap in the hedge.

defsEn: n. distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice
zh: n. 白兰地酒
examples: She poured brandy into the glasses.
Put a dash of brandy in my tea.
exampleZh: 她把白兰地倒进玻璃杯里。

defsEn: s being ahead of time or need
r ahead of time
in anticipation
zh: adv. 预先
examples: Let me know beforehand instead of springing it on me at the last minute.
Remember what I told you beforehand.
exampleZh: 事先打个招呼，别叫我临时抓瞎。

defsEn: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
s using or containing too many words
zh: a. 沉闷的, 冗长乏味的
examples: I found it tedious to do that.
It is very tedious work, but very easy.

defsEn: n. one of the quantities in a mathematical proportion
s. properly related in size or degree or other measurable characteristics
usually followed by `to'
s. having a constant ratio
zh: a. 比例的, 相称的
n. 比例项
examples: The electricity cost is proportional to the total resistance of the circuit.
The tax you pay is proportional to the income you have.

defsEn: s. more desirable than another
zh: a. 更可取的, 更好的, 更合意的
examples: I think death is preferable to shame.
It would be preferable for you to surrender.
exampleZh: 我觉得士可杀不可辱。

defsEn: n. someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
n. the ship's officer who is in charge of provisions and dining arrangements
n. an attendant on an airplane
zh: n. 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员
examples: You are the steward of your own destiny.

defsEn: n. merriment expressed by a brightness or gleam or animation of countenance
v. reflect brightly
v. be lively or brilliant or exhibit virtuosity
zh: n. 闪耀, 火花, 活力, 发泡
vi. 闪耀, 冒火花
vt. 使闪耀
examples: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.
I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
exampleZh: 结冰的道路在阳光下闪闪发亮。
我数着星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。

defsEn: v use up, consume fully
v pay out
zh: vt. 花费, 消耗, 用光
examples: According to the budget, she could expend no more on supplies.
The energy expended in a fight should be saved.

defsEn: n. an involuntary intake of breath through a wide open mouth
usually triggered by fatigue or boredom
v. utter a yawn, as from lack of oxygen or when one is tired
zh: n. 哈欠
vi. 打哈欠, 裂开
vt. 打着哈欠说
examples: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
When you yawn, cover your mouth with your hand.
exampleZh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

defsEn: v. consider bad or wrong
v. deem wrong or inappropriate
zh: v. 不赞成
examples: Do you approve or disapprove of my project?
I disapprove of what you say.

defsEn: pron. & a. Alt. of Whichsoever
zh: pron. 无论那一个, 任何一个
examples: You can buy whichever you like, but not both.
Whichever way we choose will involve danger.
exampleZh: 你喜欢哪个就买哪个,但不能两个都买。
不管我们选哪条路，都会有危险。

defsEn: s. containing or characterized by a great deal of water vapor
zh: a. 潮湿的, 湿润的, 多湿气的
examples: Hot and humid weather puts me in a bad mood.
Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.
exampleZh: 天气一闷热，我的心情就不好。
炎热潮湿的天气使我们变得懒散。

defsEn: n. the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
zh: n. 方言, 同源语
examples: Do you speak the Shanghai dialect at school?
Speakers of the dialect are in the majority in this region.
exampleZh: 你在学校里说上海话吗？
这一带的方言使用者数量居多。

defsEn: n. a metal pot for stewing or boiling
usually has a lid
n. the quantity a kettle will hold
n. a large hemispherical brass or copper percussion instrument with a drumhead that can be tuned by adjusting the tension on it
zh: n. 茶壶, 罐
examples: The pot calls the kettle black.
She put a kettle on the gas.
exampleZh: 五十步笑百步。

defsEn: v. feel happiness or joy
zh: vt. 使欢喜
vi. 欣喜, 高兴, 庆祝
examples: I rejoice to see you in good health.
We have no reason to rejoice.

defsEn: n. a small shallow dish for holding a cup at the table
zh: n. 茶碟, 茶托
examples: Put your cup on the saucer.
It's a cup without a saucer.

defsEn: v. cover as if with clothing
zh: vt. 给...穿衣, 盖上, 赋予
examples: Better to clothe you than to feed you.
The one who came will clothe them.

defsEn: r to an extreme degree
zh: adv. 极端地, 极度地, 非常
examples: I rejoice exceedingly when I punish an enemy.
She is exceedingly sensitive to the cold.

defsEn: n. a physiological need to drink
v. feel the need to drink
zh: n. 口渴, 渴望
vi. 口渴, 渴望
examples: We drown in information but thirst for knowledge.
I have a thirst for knowledge.

defsEn: v. correct by punishment or discipline
s. flat and uninspiring
a. very restrained or quiet
a. brought from wildness into a domesticated state
zh: a. 驯服的, 柔顺的, 被开垦的, 顺从的, 乏味的, 平淡的
vt. 驯养, 驯服, 制服, 失去锋芒
vi. 变得驯服
examples: How can you possibly tame a tiger?
Can you help me tame this horse?

defsEn: v gain knowledge or skills
v get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally
v commit to memory
learn by heart
v be a student of a certain subject
v impart skills or knowledge to
v find out, learn, or determine with certainty, usually by making an inquiry or other effort
s having or showing profound knowledge
s highly educated
having extensive information or understanding
a established by conditioning or learning
zh: a. 有学问的, 学术上的
learn的过去式和过去分词
examples: I never learned to speak my native language properly.
I have already learned a lot about this world.

defsEn: a. violating principles of justice
zh: a. 不公平的
examples: We live in an unjust world.
An unjust peace is better than a just war.

defsEn: v attribute or credit to
zh: vt. 归因于, 归咎于
examples: He ascribes his failure to bad luck.
What value should I ascribe to that statement?
exampleZh: 他把他的错误归咎于坏运气。

defsEn: n. sheet glass cut in shapes for windows or doors
zh: n. 窗玻璃, 方框, 方格, 窗格
vt. 嵌窗玻璃于
examples: A pane is a piece of glass in a window.
The pane of my cell phone broke.

defsEn: v become active
v force or drive out
v cause to be agitated, excited, or roused
v cause to become awake or conscious
zh: n. 觉醒, 奋起, 干杯
vt. 唤醒, 鼓舞, 激动, 使振奋, 惊起
vi. 醒来, 奋起
examples: He was roused by a loud knocking at the door.
The cry roused me from my sleep.
exampleZh: 他被啪啪的敲门声吵醒了。

defsEn: n. a deaf person who is unable to speak
n. a device used to soften the tone of a musical instrument
s. expressed without speech
zh: n. 哑子, 哑音字母, 弱音器
a. 哑的, 无声的, 沉默的
vt. 减弱...的声音
vi. 排泄
examples: Deaf-mute people talk using sign language.
She was blind, deaf, and mute.
exampleZh: 聋哑的人用手语说话。
她又盲又聋又哑。

defsEn: n. a college or university building containing living quarters for students
n. a large sleeping room containing several beds
zh: n. 宿舍
examples: I left the notes in the dormitory. I'll go back and get them now.
He has to go to the dormitory immediately.
exampleZh: 我把笔记放在宿舍了，现在回去拿。

defsEn: s past due
not paid at the scheduled time
zh: a. 过期的, 未兑的, 迟到的, 早就成熟的
examples: This joke was long overdue to be translated.
This is a friendly reminder about an overdue invoice.

defsEn: r spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position
r to a later time
zh: adv. 以上, 向上
examples: It will take upwards of a decade to capture the market.
Turning his gaze upwards, he looked at the sky.

defsEn: v. make unable to perform a certain action
v. injure permanently
zh: vt. 使失去能力, 使残废, (律)使无资格
examples: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
Antonio went to the electrical room to disable the alarm.
exampleZh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

defsEn: v. press tightly together or cram
zh: n. 群, 人群, 群集, 众多
a. 拥挤的
vi. 群集, 蜂拥
vt. 在...群集, 使拥塞
examples: He was surrounded by a throng of reporters.
People thronged the theater to see the star.
exampleZh: 他被一大群记者包围着。

defsEn: n. a stiff fiber (coarse hair or filament)
natural or synthetic
n. a stiff hair
v. rise up as in fear
v. have or be thickly covered with or as if with bristles
zh: n. 刚毛, 猪鬃
vi. 直立, 发怒, 充满
vt. 使直立
examples: The dog's hair bristled up with anger.
New York bristles with towering buildings.
exampleZh: 狗生气地炸毛了。
纽约充满着高楼大厦。

defsEn: v. overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof
v. prove to be false or incorrect
zh: vt. 反驳, 驳斥；驳倒
examples: I won't try to refute your theses.
Tom refuted that assertion with a counterexample.
exampleZh: 我不打算反驳你的论点。
汤姆用一个反例反驳了那个说法。

defsEn: v. share the feelings of
understand the sentiments of
v. be understanding of
zh: vi. 同情, 怜悯, 同意, 体谅
examples: I sympathize with you from the bottom of my heart.
I cannot help but sympathize with him any time I see him.

defsEn: n. a diversion that occupies one's time and thoughts (usually pleasantly)
zh: n. 消遣, 娱乐, 游戏
examples: My favorite pastime is strolling along the shore.
Mary's favourite pastime was reading philosophy books, while Tom, he preferred masturbating.
exampleZh: 我闲时最喜欢到海边散步。
玛丽最喜欢的消遣是读哲学书；至于汤姆，他比较喜欢自慰。

defsEn: v. sink below the surface
go under or as if under water
v. cover completely or make imperceptible
v. put under water
zh: vt. 使浸水, 使陷入, 淹没
vi. 潜入水中
examples: The submarine submerged in the water.
An osprey can completely submerge itself when it dives after a fish.

defsEn: n. a Germanic character of runic origin
zh: n. 刺, 棘, 荆棘
examples: I have a thorn in my finger.
There is no rose without thorns.
exampleZh: 我的手指头有一根刺。
没有不带刺的玫瑰。

defsEn: n. a small smooth rounded rock
zh: n. 小圆石, 小鹅卵石, 水晶透镜, 碎石花纹
examples: She stooped to pick up a pebble.
If I sow this pebble, will a mountain grow?
exampleZh: 她捡起了一块鹅卵石。

defsEn: n. a spirited graceful and intelligent riding horse native to Arabia
a. relating to or associated with Arabia or its people
a. of or relating to Arabian horses
zh: a. 阿拉伯的, 阿拉伯人的
examples: The Arabs lived across the Arabian Peninsula before the birth of Islam.
Islam emerged in the Arabian Peninsula in the seventh century.

defsEn: a. relating to or existing in the mind or thoughts
r. toward the center or interior
zh: a. 内心的, 向内的, 本来的
examples: It's both an outward and an inward process.
We have become an intolerant, inward-looking society.

defsEn: n. an angry dispute
n. an arrow that is shot from a crossbow
has a head with four edges
v. have a disagreement over something
zh: n. 吵架, 反目, 怨言, 方头凿
vi. 吵架, 争论, 挑剔
examples: He always quarrels with his wife.
Don't quarrel with him any more.
exampleZh: 他总是与他的妻子吵架。
你别再跟他争吵了。

defsEn: s. more distant in especially degree
r. to or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage (`further' is used more often than `farther' in this abstract sense)
r. in addition or furthermore
further, they should be here already"
zh: a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的
vt. 促进, 增进, 助长
adv. 更进一步地, 更远地, 此外
examples: She can swim further than I can.
Our school is further away than the station.
exampleZh: 她能游得比我远。
去我们学校比去火车站要远。

defsEn: s. avoiding waste
zh: a. 节俭的, 经济的, 合算的
examples: This car is very economical on gas.
This is the most economical and convenient tourist destination.
exampleZh: 这辆车很省油。

defsEn: n. people who are fearful and cautious
a. showing fear and lack of confidence
zh: a. 胆小的, 羞怯的
examples: She is timid like a rabbit.
A mouse is a timid creature.
exampleZh: 她像兔子一样胆小。
老鼠是胆小的生物。

defsEn: n. an edge tool with a heavy bladed head mounted across a handle
v. terminate
zh: n. 斧头
vt. 用斧削或砍, 削减
examples: He cut down the tree with an ax.
Cut up the wood with an ax.

defsEn: n. a long narrow opening
n. a narrow fissure
v. make a clean cut through
v. cut a slit into
zh: n. 裂缝, 投币口, 狭长裂口
vt. 切开, 扯裂, 使有狭缝
vi. 纵切, 纵裂
examples: Her skirt has a slit on one side.
Tom always slits the envelope with a knife.

defsEn: n. (Christian theology) a state of sanctification by God
the state of one who is under such divine influence
n. elegance and beauty of movement or expression
n. a disposition to kindness and compassion
n. (Greek mythology) one of three sisters who were the givers of beauty and charm
a favorite subject for sculptors
zh: n. 优雅, 风度, 慈悲, 恩惠, 体面, 赦免, 恩典, 谢恩祷告
vt. 使优美
examples: Grace goes upstairs to the extension telephone.
There but for the grace of God go I.
exampleZh: 格雷斯去楼上的分机电话。

defsEn: n. the branch of pure mathematics dealing with the theory of numerical calculations
zh: n. 算术, 算术知识
examples: How many arithmetic books are left?
So, have you learnt arithmetic? - Sure!
exampleZh: 有多少本算数书留着？

defsEn: a. capable of being measured
s. of distinguished importance
zh: a. 可测量的, 不久的, 重要的
examples: The results should be measurable and the process repeatable.
To set attainable, measurable goals is very important to successful language learning.

defsEn: n. a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions
now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints)
zh: n. 公升
examples: A liter of water will not last long.
I drink at least two liters of water a day.

defsEn: n. a periodical that is published every quarter (or four issues per year)
a. of or relating to or consisting of a quarter
r. in diagonally opposed quarters of an escutcheon
r. in three month intervals
zh: a. 季度的, 按季度的, 每季的
adv. 按季, 每三个月, 每季一次
n. 季刊
examples: Our quarterly results will serve as the best appraisal of our approach.

defsEn: n. a person employed to carry luggage and supplies
n. United States writer of novels and short stories (1890-1980)
n. United States composer and lyricist of musical comedies (1891-1946)
n. United States writer of short stories whose pen name was O. Henry (1862-1910)
zh: n. 大楼管理员, 门房, 搬运工人, 侍者, 服务员
examples: I work as a porter for this transportation company.
The night porter will open the door for you.

defsEn: v. give life or energy to
v. show signs of life
zh: vt. 加快, 激发, 使有生气, 鼓舞, 使复活
vi. 加快, 变活跃, 进入胎动期
examples: I quickened my steps to catch up with her.
I quickened my pace, hoping to lose him.

defsEn: a. full of or producing joy
zh: a. 欢喜的, 高兴的, 令人高兴的
examples: I saw a joyful smile on his face.
Loving and being loved are the most joyful things in the world.
exampleZh: 在他的脸上我看到了快乐的笑容。
爱和被爱是世上最幸运的事。

defsEn: n. a science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks
zh: n. 地质学, 地质情况
examples: I'm a specialist in the field of geology.
She is an expert in the field of geology.

defsEn: n. a person who shows fear or timidity
n. English dramatist and actor and composer noted for his witty and sophisticated comedies (1899-1973)
zh: n. 懦弱的人, 胆小的人
examples: Cowards die many times before their deaths.
Look at me when I talk to you, you coward!
exampleZh: 胆小鬼在真正断气之前已经死过很多次。

defsEn: n. (physics) the theory that space and time are relative concepts rather than absolute concepts
n. the quality of being relative and having significance only in relation to something else
zh: n. 有关系, 相关性, 相对性
examples: Einstein's theory of relativity is Greek to me.
We associate Einstein with the theory of relativity.
exampleZh: 我完全看不懂爱因斯坦的相对性理论。

defsEn: n. an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)
n. a small machine that is used for mathematical calculations
zh: n. 计算者, 计算器
examples: The calculator on the table is mine.
The batteries in my calculator are dead.
exampleZh: 桌上的计算器是我的。
我计算机的电池没电了。

defsEn: s. having won
zh: a. 胜利的, 得胜的, 战胜的
examples: Democracy will be victorious in the long run.
The victorious army withdrew from the country.

defsEn: n a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)
zh: n. 宇宙飞船
examples: It is rumoured that a spaceship has been seen near Shanghai.
Where will the spaceship touch down?
exampleZh: 谣传一架宇宙飞船在上海附近被见到了。

defsEn: n. stately heavy-bodied aquatic bird with very long neck and usually white plumage as adult
v. sweep majestically
zh: n. 天鹅, 天鹅星座, 有才华的诗人
vi. 闲荡, 蜿蜒而行
examples: Gabriel watched a family of swans gliding gracefully on the lake.
There is a swan in the water there.
exampleZh: 加布里埃尔看着一群天鹅在湖面上优雅地游着。

defsEn: s abounding in rocks or stones
s showing unfeeling resistance to tender feelings
s hard as granite
zh: a. 多石的, 无情的
examples: The stony beach was painful to walk on.
He had a stony face, etched by time.

defsEn: a. (especially of weather) affected or characterized by storms or commotion
s. characterized by violent emotions or behavior
zh: a. 暴风雨的, 粗暴的, 激烈的
examples: It was a stormy day, and the snow was falling fast.
It was stormy the day before yesterday, and rainy yesterday.
exampleZh: 这天刮着暴风雪，雪下得很大。

defsEn: n. a pauper who lives by begging
v. be beyond the resources of
v. reduce to beggary
zh: n. 乞丐
vt. 使贫穷, 使成乞丐
examples: The beggar on the street asks: "Do you have any extra euros?"
I gave the beggar all the money I had.
exampleZh: 街上的乞丐问：“你还有多余的钱吗？”
我把身上的钱全都给了那个乞丐。

defsEn: a. productive or conducive to producing in abundance
zh: a. 结果实的, 多实的, 产量多的
examples: The year she spent in Germany was incredibly fruitful.
We had quite a fruitful meeting.

defsEn: v. put in a dangerous, disadvantageous, or difficult position
zh: n. 怪人, 同性恋者
a. 奇怪的, 不舒服的, 可疑的
vt. 搞糟
examples: He is really a queer fellow!
And now I come to the queer part of the business.
exampleZh: 他可真是个怪人！

defsEn: n. a difficult problem
n. a coarse sieve (as for gravel)
v. pierce with many holes
v. set a difficult problem or riddle
zh: n. 谜, 谜语, 粗筛
vt. 解谜, 给...出谜, 筛, 寻根究底地检验, 充满于
vi. 出谜
examples: This riddle will have to wait for now.
If he could not answer the riddle, he would be eaten.

defsEn: n. a violently fast stream of water (or other liquid)
zh: n. 奔流, 倾盆大雨, 倾注, 迸发
examples: A torrent of rain fell all night.
And they digged in the torrent, and found living water.

defsEn: n. a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks
a. of or relating to locomotion
zh: n. 火车头, 机车
a. 运转的, 火车头的, 移动的
examples: The locomotive is at the end of the train.
He works like a locomotive conductor.

defsEn: n. the greatest possible degree
zh: n. 极限, 最大限度, 极度
a. 极度的, 最远的
examples: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
We should do our utmost to establish world peace.
exampleZh: 这件事至关重要。

defsEn: n. a fabric made of yarns containing an elastic material
a. capable of resuming original shape after stretching or compression
springy
s. able to adjust readily to different conditions
zh: n. 松紧带, 橡皮筋
a. 有弹性的, 能伸缩的, 可通融的
examples: This material stops being elastic under extreme cold.
I have a lot of elastic bands.

defsEn: s. indicating a lack of maturity
zh: a. 天真的, 孩子气的
examples: It is time you left off your childish ways.
I like the childish feel of this game.
exampleZh: 是你该放弃你幼稚手段的时候了。

defsEn: n. a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten
v. make an alloy of
zh: n. 合金
vt. 将...铸成合金, 减低成色
vi. 合铸
examples: Cast iron is an alloy of iron and carbon.
Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

defsEn: n. the quality of shining with a bright reflected light
n. the occurrence of a small flash or spark
v. be shiny, as if wet
zh: n. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀
vi. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀

This ring has lost its glitter.

指环没了光泽。

defsEn: n a cruelly rapacious person
n a living organism characterized by voluntary movement

showing lack of human sensibility

He is a brute to his children.

defsEn: s. smooth and unconstrained in movement
zh: a. 流利的, 流畅的

She is fluent in English and French.
exampleZh: 我认为自己的法语相当流利。
她能说流利的英语和法语。

defsEn: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n open disrespect for a person or thing

v reject with contempt

A woman scorned can be extremely dangerous.

v. make watertight
zh: n. 防水材料

Don't forget to pack waterproof clothes.

s. lacking strength

certainly

adv. 无疑地, 确定地

Doubtless you have heard the news.

defsEn: n. a message transmitted by telegraph
zh: n. 电报, 一封电报

Your telegram arrived just as I was about to telephone you.
exampleZh: 当你到的时候发一份电报给我们。
我正想打电话给你，你的电报就送来了。

Owing to the storm, they arrived late.
exampleZh: 运动会因为下雨延后了。
因为风暴，他们晚到了。

defsEn: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
s done with delicacy and skill
zh: a. 熟练的, 巧妙的
examples: Bill is skillful in arguing and debating.
Either skillful or lazy. But not both.
exampleZh: 比尔擅长辩论。

defsEn: n. the top edge of a vessel or other container
n. a circular projection that sticks outward from the crown of a hat
v. be completely full
v. fill as much as possible

Fill the glass to the brim.

defsEn: v. make (to feel) fresh
v. make fresh again

vi. 提起精神, 恢复精神, 吃点心, 喝饮料

vi. 刷新, 重新整理
examples: I feel completely refreshed after spending a week in the country.
I get an error when I refresh the page.

How much horsepower does a horse have?

We were astonished to hear what had happened.
exampleZh: 看到我姐姐的照片时，我惊讶地发现她变老了许多。
我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。

defsEn: r. toward the west

a. 向西的
adv. 向西的

This phone has a rotary dial.

defsEn: n. the chest considered as the place where secret thoughts are kept

v. hide in one's bosom

vt. 怀抱
examples: I will keep it in my bosom.
He was happy in the bosom of his family.

The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。

zh: n. 零售商, 店主, 老板

defsEn: n. an employee who performs manual or industrial labor
